n-m-h1-ineq-03.title: Ingabe u-"Uma a<b, khona 1/a > 1/b" Njalo Uyiqiniso? Ukwakha Izibonelo Eziphikisayo
n-m-h1-ineq-03.goal: Zakhele izibonelo eziphikisayo ukuhlola ukuthi isimangalo esihlanganisa isakhiwo sokungalingani siyiqiniso nini, bese uthola isimo lapho isimangalo sibamba khona.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.material: UMina wathi, "Uma a<b, khona 1/a > 1/b. Uma 2<5, khona 1/2 > 1/5, futhi uma 3<7, khona 1/3 > 1/7. Ngihloliwe eziningana, futhi zonke zilungile." (U-a no-b bayizinombolo ezingeyona u-0.)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa izibonelo ezihambisana nesimangalo nalezo eziphikisana naso
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.1: Ukuthola lokho izibonelo eziphikisayo ezihlangana ngakho
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezibonisa ukuthi isimangalo sikaMina asilungile. Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo ezigcwele ezingeyona u-0 a, b ukuze a<b kodwa 1/a > 1/b akubambi. (Inani eliphelele u-50 ubuningi)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zama amapheya amaningana wena. Shintsha izimpawu zika-a no-b, bala u-1/a no-1/b, bese uqhathanisa osayizi.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi yisiphi isakhiwo izibonelo uMina azihloliwe ezihlanganyela ngaso, bese uthola amapheya angenaso leso sakhiwo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c1: U-a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo ezingeyona u-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c3: Sebenzisa izinombolo ezigcwele ezinenani eliphelele elingu-50 ubuningi.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c5: Kulelipheya, 1/a > 1/b kusabamba, ngakho akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.explain: Uma a=−2 no-b=5, khona 1/a=−1/2 no-1/b=1/5, ngakho 1/a < 1/b. Kuzo zonke izibonelo eziphikisayo, u-a wayeyi-negative futhi u-b eyi-positive.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isimo esilungile lapho 1/a > 1/b kufanele kubambe uma a<b futhi a, b abayona u-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa eceleni komunye izimpawu zika-a no-b ezibonelweni eziphikisayo owazenza esinyathelweni esidlule nasezibonelweni uMina azihloliwe.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, yenza ipheya lezinombolo elihambisana nalo bese uqhathanisa u-1/a no-1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.a: Noma o-1 eyi-positive, njengo-a=−2, b=5, isimangalo siyahluleka.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.b: Uma b=5 no-a=−2, kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo. Ukuba u-b eyi-positive akwanele.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.c: Kunesibonelo esiphikisayo sezinombolo ezigcwele (−2, 5). Inkinga yiphawu, hhayi uhlobo lwenombolo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.explain: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab) futhi b−a>0, ngakho uma ab>0 iyi-positive futhi 1/a>1/b. Uma ab<0 iyi-negative futhi isimangalo siyahluleka.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala u-1/a − 1/b njengefrakshini e-1, bese usebenzisa lokho okunquma uphawu lwayo ukuchaza ukuthi kungani impendulo yesinyathelo 2 ilungile.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Thola isihlukanisi esivamile bese ubhala u-1/a − 1/b njengefrakshini e-1.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xhumanisa lokho izimpawu zenombolo ephezulu nesihlukanisi ezixhomeke kukho nesimo a<b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi inombolo ephezulu njalo iyi-positive?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uphethe ngokuthi umphumela uncike ephawini lika-ab?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.0: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab). Njengoba a<b, b−a iyi-positive, ngakho uphawu lunqunywa ngu-ab. Uma ab>0, khona 1/a>1/b, futhi uma ab<0, khona 1/a<1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.1: Ukuhlanganisa kunikeza u-(b−a)/(ab). Inombolo ephezulu b−a iyi-positive, ngakho 1/a − 1/b > 0 kuphela uma u-ab eyi-positive, okungukuthi, uma u-a no-b banophawu olufanayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.2: Inombolo ephezulu b−a iyi-positive ngoba a<b. Ngakho umphumela uncike ekutheni umphumela ka-a no-b uyi-positive noma i-negative.

n-m-h1-comb-05.title: Sidinga ukwazi ini ukuze sinqume ukuthi kunezindlela ezingaki zokwabela amabhola ezibhokisini?
n-m-h1-comb-05.topic: Ukubala: ukunquma ukuthi yini okufanele ihlukaniswe enkingeni
n-m-h1-comb-05.goal: Enkingeni yokubala, thola ulwazi olunquma ukuthi imiphumela efanayo iphathwa njengemunye yini (ingabe izinto ziyahlukaniswa, ingabe izibhokisi ezingenalutho ziyavunyelwa), bese uqinisekisa ukuthi inani lishintsha ngalolo lwazi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.material: U-Mina uyabuza, "Zingaki izindlela zokwabela amabhola angu-3 ezibhokisini ezi-2?", futhi abangane bakhe banikeza izimpendulo ezihlukile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi inkinga ayinakho ulwazi oluthile.
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.0: Thola ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze unqume impendulo eyodwa
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.1: Yazi ukuthi inani lishintsha kuye ngesilinganiso sokuphatha izinto njengezifanayo
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani uma isimo sishintsha
n-m-h1-comb-05.prereq.0: Ukubhala amacala ngomdwebo wesihlahla noma ithebula
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinto okufanele uzazi ukuze unqume impendulo eyodwa yale nkinga.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi uhlelo "amabhola angu-3 ebhokisini elilodwa, angu-0 kwelinye" libukeka njengemiphumela ehlukile emingaki uma izibhokisi ziyahlukaniswa nalapho zingahlukaniswa.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.1: Shintsha izingcezu zolwazi ngasinye, hlola ukuthi inani olithola ngokubala ngqo lishintsha yini, bese uthola ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olungalushintshi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi izibhokisi ezimbili ziyahlukaniswa komunye nomunye yini (ingabe izibhokisi zinezinombolo)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.b: Impahla ayinamthelela enanini. Ukuthi izinto ziyahlukaniswa yini yilolu lwazi oluguqula inani.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi amabhola angu-3 ayahlukaniswa komunye nomunye yini (ingabe anemibala ehlukile)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi ibhokisi livunyelwe ukuba ngelingenalutho yini
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.e: Ukuthi yimuphi umbala odwetshwe ngaphakathi kwezibhokisi
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.e: Ukuthi umbala ongaphakathi webhokisi usebenza njengendlela yokuwahlukanisa sekuvele kuhlanganiswe ukuthi izibhokisi ziyahlukaniswa yini. Lolu lwazi lodwa alukwazi ukunquma inani.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.explain: Izinto ezintathu kufanele zinqunywe. Ukuthi izibhokisi namabhola ziyahlukaniswa yini kunquma ukuthi imiphumela yesimo esifanayo iphathwa njengemunye noma emibili, futhi ukuthi izibhokisi ezingenalutho ziyavunyelwa yini kuguqula abafanele ngokwabo. Impahla nombala ongaphakathi akunamthelela enanini.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.prompt: Amabhola angu-3 wonke abukeka afana, izibhokisi ezimbili zinezinombolo ezihlukile ngakho ziyahlukaniswa, futhi izibhokisi ezingenalutho ziyavunyelwa. Zingaki izindlela?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khulisa inani lamabhola ebhokisini 1 kusukela ku-0 ngalunye, bese ubhala ethebuleni ukuthi mangaki angena ebhokisini 2.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi njengoba amabhola wonke afana, ukuhlelwa lapho ibhokisi libamba inani elifanayo lamabhola kubalwa njengokukodwa.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.a: Lelo yinani uma izibhokisi zingahlukaniswa. Ngezibhokisi ezinezinombolo ezihlukile, (3, 0) no-(0, 3) yimiphumela ehlukile.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kubala kuphela amacala anamabhola angu-1, 2, noma 3 ebhokisini 1. Icala elinamabhola angu-0 ebhokisini 1 liphuliwe.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.d: Lelo yinani uma amabhola ehlukaniswa. Amabhola kule nkinga wonke afana.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuhlukanisa emacaleni lapho ibhokisi 1 linamabhola angu-0, 1, 2, 3, asele aya ebhokisini 2, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-4. (Isibonelo, 0 ebhokisini 1 kusho 3 ebhokisini 2, futhi 3 ebhokisini 1 kusho 0 ebhokisini 2, okuyimiphumela ehlukile.)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.prompt: Uma amabhola angu-3 enemibala ehlukile futhi ehlukaniswa (izibhokisi ziyahlukaniswa futhi izibhokisi ezingenalutho ziyavunyelwa), zingaki izindlela? Chaza futhi ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene kanjani nezindlela ezingu-4 zangaphambilini.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nika amabhola amagama (obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ophuzi) bese ubhala phansi, ngalunye, isinqumo sokuthi ibhola ngalinye liya kuliphi ibhokisi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.1: Phakathi kwezindlela ezingu-4 zangaphambilini, bhala uhlelo (2 ebhokisini 1, 1 ebhokisini 2) usebenzisa amabhola anamagama, bese ubala ukuthi izindlela ezingaki.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uma amabhola ehlukaniswa, ingabe ubhale ukuthi ibhola elilodwa lingaya ezibhokisini ezingaki?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubale ukuthi umphumela onjengo-(2, 1) kwezindlela ezingu-4 zangaphambilini uhlukana ube izindlela ezingaki uma amabhola ehlukaniswa?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ungasho yini ukuthi kungani inani likhula?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.0: Uma amabhola ehlukaniswa, ibhola ngalinye linezibhokisi ezi-2 ongaya kuzo, futhi amabhola angu-3 anqunywa elandelana, ngakho 2×2×2=8 izindlela. Ngamabhola afanayo, (3, 0) kuyindlela e-1, kodwa uma amabhola ehlukaniswa, (2, 1) uhlukana abe izindlela ezingu-3, ngakho 1+3+3+1=8.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.1: Ibhola ngalinye linezinketho ezimbili, ibhokisi 1 noma ibhokisi 2, ngakho 2^3=8 izindlela. Izindlela ezingu-4 zamabhola afanayo zihlukana zibe izindlela ezingu-1, 3, 3, 1 uma amabhola ehlukaniswa, futhi lokhu kungeza kube ngu-8.

n-m-h1-comb-06.title: Ukuchazela umfowethu omncane ukuthi ahlele kanjani izinhlamvu zika-BANANA
n-m-h1-comb-06.topic: Ama-permutation: ukuchaza ukuthi kungani sihlukanisa kuma-permutation anezinto ezifanayo
n-m-h1-comb-06.goal: Qonda ukuthi kungani sihlukanisa kufomula yama-permutation anezinto ezifanayo, bese ubhala kabusha isixazululo esikhombisa kuphela ifomula ngamagama umfowenu omncane wesikole esiphakeme angawaqonda.
n-m-h1-comb-06.material: U-Hyunsu uxazulule "inani lezindlela zokuhlela izinhlamvu eziyisithupha ze-BANANA emgqeni" kanje: 6! ÷ (3!×2!) = 720 ÷ 12 = 60 izindlela. Umfowabo omncane, umfundi wonyaka wesibili wesikole esiphakeme, obone lesi sixazululo uthi, "Angiqondi ukuthi kungani sihlukanisa, noma kungani kungu-3! no-2!." (I-BANANA inenhlamvu e-1 ye-B, ama-A angu-3, nama-N angu-2.)
n-m-h1-comb-06.thinking.0: Funda ukuthi ingxenye ngayinye yesibalo ibala ini
n-m-h1-comb-06.thinking.1: Bhala kabusha isixazululo ukuze sifanele izilaleli
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi zingaki izindlela zokuhlela izinhlamvu uma zihlukaniswa ngokuzinombolo, njengo-A₁A₂A₃.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.hint.1: Usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinezinombolo, yenza izindlela eziningana zokuhlela ezibukeka zifana no-BANANA.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.a: Inani lokuhlelwa ngemva kokuba izinhlamvu ezifanayo phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezi-6 sezivele zasuswa
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.a: 6! ayihlanganisi isinyathelo sokusuka izinhlamvu ezifanayo. 6! yinani oyithola ngokuphatha zonke eziyisithupha njengezihlukile.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.b: Inani lokuhlelwa elibaliwe ngokuphatha ama-A amathathu nama-N amabili njengezinhlamvu ezihlukanisekayo
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.c: Inani elibala kuphela ukuhlelwa okunesimo esihlukile ku-BANANA
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.c: Inani lokuhlelwa okunezimo ezihlukile yilo nani esilifunayo (60). 6! ibala, ngokwehlukana, nokuhlelwa okubukeka kufana.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.d: Inani lezindlela zokukhetha izinhlamvu ezi-3 kwezi-6
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu akumayelana nokukhetha; kuwukuhlelwa kwazo zonke ezi-6 emgqeni.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.explain: Uma sizithatha njengezinhlamvu eziyisithupha ezihlukile u-A₁, A₂, A₃, N₁, N₂, B, ukuzihlela kunika 6!=720 izindlela. Kodwa empeleni ama-A awakwazi ukuhlukaniswa komunye nomunye, namaN, ngakho isimo esifanayo sibaliwe izikhathi eziningana.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha isixazululo sika-Hyunsu ngemishwana engu-3 kuya ku-4 ukuze umfowabo omncane asiqonde. Chaza ukuthi kungani isibalo siphuma kanjalo, futhi unikeze isibonelo esisodwa.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ukwenza umuntu ongayazi ifomula aqonde, qala usho umqondo othi "uma sithatha zonke izinhlamvu njengezihlukile".
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala uhlelo olulodwa lwe-BANANA olunezinombolo kuma-A amathathu, bese ubhala ukuhlelwa okuba yigama elifanayo uma izinombolo zishintshwa.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uma usebenzise amagama umfowenu angawazi (permutation, factorial), ingabe uwachazile?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe unikeze isibonelo esikhombisa ukuthi ukushintsha izinhlamvu ezifanayo kunika igama elifanayo?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani izihlukanisi zingu-3! no-2!?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.0: Kunama-A amathathu, ngakho ekuqaleni siyenza sengathi ama-A ayizinhlamvu ezihlukile futhi sibale 6! izindlela. Kodwa ukushintsha ama-A kunika igama elifanayo. Kunezindlela ezingu-3!=6 zokushintsha izindawo zama-A amathathu, ngakho igama ngalinye libaliwe izikhathi ezi-6. Yingakho sihlukanisa ngo-3!, futhi sihlukanisa nama-N ngo-2! ngenxa yesizathu esifanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.1: Uma sidwebela ama-A amathathu ku-BANANA, njenge-A ebomvu, i-A eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ne-A ephuzi, zonke ziba yizinhlamvu ezihlukile futhi sibala 6! izindlela. Kodwa uma sesula imibala, ukuhlelwa lapho ama-A eshintshwa komunye nomunye kuba yigama elifanayo. Kunezindlela ezingu-3!=6 zokushintsha ama-A, ngakho amaqembu okuhlelwa okungu-6 ayigama elifanayo, futhi yingakho sihlukanisa ngo-3!. Ama-N eza ngamaqembu angu-2, ngakho sihlukanisa ngo-2!.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.2: Uma sinika izinhlamvu izinombolo futhi sizithatha zonke njengezihlukile, kunezindlela ezingu-6!=720, kodwa uma sisusa izinombolo igama ngalinye libalwa izikhathi ezingu-12. Ngakho sihlukanisa u-720 ngo-12 ukuthola izindlela ezingu-60. U-12 uyisiphumo sika-3!, sokushintsha ama-A, no-2!, sokushintsha ama-N.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.prompt: Usebenzisa indlela efanayo, zingaki izindlela zokuhlela izinhlamvu ezinhlanu AABBC emgqeni?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlamvu kuleli gama ezibalwa kaningi nokuthi inhlamvu ngayinye iphindwa kangaki.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hambisanisa lokho okwenziwe ku-BANANA nezinhlamvu ezifanayo kuleli gama.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.a: Lelo yinani uma u-A no-B bonke bephathwa njengezinhlamvu ezihlukile. Alibonisi ukuthi ukushintsha izinhlamvu ezifanayo kunika igama elifanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.b: Ama-A kuphela ahlukaniswe ngo-2! futhi ama-B awazange. Ama-B, nawo angama-A amabili ayafana, kufanele ahlukaniswe ngenxa yesizathu esifanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.c: Lelo yinani lika-5×4. Alibali inani lezindlela zokuhlela izinhlamvu.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.explain: Uma zonke izinhlamvu ezinhlanu ziphathwa njengezihlukile, kunezindlela ezingu-5!=120, futhi igama ngalinye libalwa kaningi izindlela ezingu-2! zokushintsha ama-A nezindlela ezingu-2! zokushintsha ama-B, ngakho 5!÷(2!×2!)=120÷4=30 izindlela.

n-m-h1-comb-08.title: Amathuba okuthi isamba sezinombolo ezimbili singaphindwa nokuthi siyaphindwa ngempela afana?
n-m-h1-comb-08.topic: Ukubala: ukubala ngokuphindwayo nokungaphindwayo, nesisekelo sokwenza isilinganiso esiphelele
n-m-h1-comb-08.goal: Bala amapheya anesamba esingaphindwayo noma esiphindwayo ngokuhlukanisa ngokuphindwayo nokungaphindwayo, bese uqonda umehluko phakathi kweqiniso lokuthi izibonelo ezimbalwa azikwazi ukufakazela isimangalo esiphelele nendlela ekhombisa ngokuphelele usebenzisa uhlamvu.
n-m-h1-comb-08.material: UMinho uthi, "Uma sikhetha izinombolo ezimbili ezihlukene kuzinombolo zemvelo ezingu-1 kuya ku-n, ezingaphindwayo nezindwayo ziyalingana cishe ngesigamu, ngakho inani O lamapheya anesamba esingaphindwayo nenani E lamapheya anesamba esiphindwayo nalo liyalingana (O=E)." (Ukulandelana akuhlukaniswa; bala amapheya ezinombolo ezimbili ezikhethiwe.)
n-m-h1-comb-08.thinking.1: Hlulela ukuthi zingaki izibonelo ezanele njengobufakazi
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha amanani amathathu ahlukene ka-n kusukela ku-4 kuya ku-12, futhi kwelinye ngalinye, bala ngqo bese ufaka inani lezinombolo ezingaphindwayo o, inani lezinombolo ezindwayo e, inani lamapheya anesamba esiphindwayo E, nenani lamapheya anesamba esingaphindwayo O.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s1.hint.0: Uqala ngenani elincane njengo-n=4, bhala wonke amapheya ezinombolo ezimbili akhethwe ku-1, 2, 3, 4 bese uhlola ukuthi isamba ngasinye siyaphindwa noma asiphindwa.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qala unqume ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili kumele zibe yini ngokuphindwayo ukuze isamba siphindwe, bese ubala usebenzisa amanani ezingaphindwayo nezindwayo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s1.fail.c1: U-n kumele abe yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-4 kuya ku-12.

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.prompt: Kwabe kathathu, kwakukhona amapheya amaningi anesamba esingaphindwayo (O>E). Kufanele sihlulele kanjani isimangalo sikaMinho nalo mphumela?

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.a: Kwabe kathathu O≠E, ngakho uMinho akalungile, futhi singasho nokuthi kunoma yimuphi u-n kukhona ngokuqinile izamba eziningi ezingaphindwayo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.a: Kukhonjisiwe ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi isimangalo sikaMinho asilungile. Kodwa ngemiphumela emithathu kuphela awukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izamba eziningi ezingaphindwayo kuwo wonke u-n.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.b: Amanani ezinombolo ezingaphindwayo nezindwayo cishe ayafana, ngakho singathatha lo mehluko njengephutha futhi sisho ukuthi isimangalo sikaMinho (O=E) silungile.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.b: Isimangalo sikaMinho ngukuthi u-O no-E "balingana". Uma u-O no-E obabale ngqo behlukile, isimangalo asilungile ku-n lowo. Awukwazi ukusindisa isimangalo ngokubiza umehluko ngokuthi "iphutha".
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.c: Kumanani amathathu engiwakhethile, O≠E, ngakho ayizibonelo eziphikisayo zesimangalo sikaMinho (O=E), kodwa ukusho ukuthi kuwo wonke u-n kukhona izamba eziningi ezingaphindwayo, kumele kukhonjiswe ngokwehlukile usebenzisa uhlamvu.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.d: Njengoba u-n ekhula, umehluko O−E phakathi kuka-O no-E uyancipha futhi ekugcineni uba ngu-O=E.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.d: Ku-n=4, 6, 8, O−E ngu-2, 3, 4, okukhula empeleni. Awukwazi ukuqinisekisa ngezibonelo ezimbalwa ukuthi kwenzekani ngemva kokuba u-n mkhulu.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.explain: Njengoba isimangalo siphelele (wonke u-n), isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa singakhombisa ukuthi isimangalo singamanga. Veza inani O lamapheya anesamba esingaphindwayo nenani E lamapheya anesamba esiphindwayo ngokuya ngo-k, thola u-O−E, bese ukhombisa ukuthi kunezamba eziningi ezingaphindwayo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili ezikhethiwe kumele zibe yini ngokuphindwayo ukuze isamba singaphindwa.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.hint.1: Veza u-O no-E ngokuya ngo-k, yenza lula umehluko wabo, bese uhlola uphawu lwawo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani ukukhetha eyodwa engaphindwayo neyodwa ephindwayo kunikeza u-O?

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi njengoba u-k eyinombolo yemvelo, u-O−E uhlala muhle?

Ukuze isamba siphindwe sikhetha ezimbili ezingaphindwayo noma ezimbili ezindwayo, ngakho E=C(k,2)+C(k,2)=k(k−1). O−E=k²−k(k−1)=k, futhi njengoba u-k eyinombolo yemvelo uhlala muhle, ngakho kunezamba eziningi ezingaphindwayo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.1: U-O ungu-k×k=k² izindlela, ukhetha eyodwa kwezingu-k ezingaphindwayo neyodwa kwezingu-k ezindwayo. U-E ungu-k(k−1) izindlela, isamba sezindlela ezingu-k(k−1)/2 zokukhetha ezimbili ezingaphindwayo nezindlela ezingu-k(k−1)/2 zokukhetha ezimbili ezindwayo. Umehluko O−E=k>0, ngakho kunezamba ezingu-k ezengeziwe ezingaphindwayo.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.2: U-O ungu-k×k=k² izindlela, ukhetha eyodwa kwezingu-k ezingaphindwayo neyodwa kwezingu-k ezindwayo, futhi u-E ungu-k(k−1) izindlela. Ngakho u-O uhlala mkhulu kuno-E ngo-k.

n-m-h1-geo-02.goal: Nquma ukuthi isethi yezimo ezinikeziwe inquma isiyingi esisodwa yini, chaza ukuthi kungani izimo zigqagqana uma zingakwenzi, futhi uhlole ngokwenza izibonelo zakho.

Phakathi kwamasethi ezimo ezingezansi, ufuna ukukhetha lawo amvumela umngani wakhe adwebe isiyingi esifanayo ngokukhethekile. (Isiyingi yisibalo esinephoyinti lenkabe e-1 nebanga lomjikelezo eliyi-positive.)

n-m-h1-geo-02.thinking.2: Ukwenza isibonelo esiphikisayo (iziyingi ezihlukile ezifeza izimo ezifanayo)
n-m-h1-geo-02.prereq.2: Umugqa obambanayo ohlukanisa uhhafu wengxenye yomugqa

n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.r.a: Uphutheleke ukuthi uma amaphoyinti amathathu elale emugqeni o-1, akukho siyingi esidlula kuwo wonke.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.o.b: Idlula emaphoyintini amabili (0,0), (6,0), futhi inkabe yayo ilele emugqeni x=3.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.r.b: Uphutheleke ukuthi umugqa lapho inkabe kufanele ilale khona ufana nomugqa osevele unqunyiwe ngamaphoyinti amabili.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.o.d: Idlula emaphoyintini amabili (0,0), (6,0), futhi inkabe yayo ilele emugqeni y=x.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.o.e: Idlula emaphoyintini amabili (0,0), (6,0), futhi ibanga layo lomjikelezo lingu-5.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.r.e: Uphutheleke ukuthi noma ibanga lomjikelezo linikeziwe, kungaba namaphoyinti amabili angenzeka enkabeni.
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s1.explain: c: Kunesiyingi e-1 kuphela esidlula emaphoyintini amathathu angekho emugqeni o-1 (inkabe (3,4), ibanga lomjikelezo 5). d: Inkabe kufanele ilale emugqeni obambanayo ohlukanisa uhhafu x=3 wamaphoyinti amabili, futhi ukuhlangana kwayo no-y=x, (3,3), kuwukuphela. Ku-a, amaphoyinti amathathu asemugqeni o-1, ngakho akukho siyingi esidlula kuwo; ku-b, u-x=3 ungumugqa obambanayo ohlukanisa uhhafu osevele unqunywe ngamaphoyinti amabili, ngakho akuyona ulwazi olusha futhi kunamaziyingi angapheli. Ku-e, inkabe ingaba (3,4) noma (3,−4).
n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s2.prompt: Zingaki iziyingi ezifeza izimo "zidlula emaphoyintini amabili (0,0), (6,0) futhi zinenkabe emugqeni x=3"? Chaza ukuthi kungani.

n-m-h1-geo-02.s.s3.hint.0: Thatha isixhumanisi sika-x senkabe sibe ngu-3, bese ubhala isikwele sebanga elisuka enkabeni liye ku-(0,0).

n-m-h1-geo-09.title: Ibanga Elimfushane Kakhulu Elisuka Endaweni Liya Engxenyeni Yomugqa
n-m-h1-geo-09.goal: Yakha izibonelo lapho ukusebenzisa ifomula yebanga lendawo-nomugqa ngqo engxenyeni yomugqa kunikeza impendulo engalungile, bese uchaza umthetho wamacala anjalo.
n-m-h1-geo-09.material: Epulangeni lama-coordinate kunengxenye yomugqa u-AB exhuma amaphoyinti amabili u-A(0,0) no-B(4,3). Umugqa u-AB (hhayi ingxenye) ungu-3x−4y=0. (Funda u-√13 njengo-"root 13" no-√50 njengo-"root 50.")
n-m-h1-geo-09.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ibanga lapho ifomula isebenza khona
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.prompt: Liyini ibanga elimfushane kakhulu elisuka endaweni P(7,1) liye endaweni engxenyeni u-AB?
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi isisekelo se-perpendicular esuka ku-P siya emugqeni u-AB sisengxenyeni u-AB yini.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.hint.1: Thola kokubili ibanga eliya emugqeni namabanga aya ezindaweni zokugcina ezimbili, bese uqhathanisa.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.b: Leli yinani elivela ku-formula yebanga lendawo-nomugqa. Leli nani libanga eliya emugqeni u-AB, futhi akunakusho ukuthi lilingana nebanga eliya engxenyeni.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.c: Leli yibanga eliya endaweni yokugcina u-A. Hlola ukuthi ukhethe eseduze kwezimbili zokugcina yini.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.d: Kubonakala sengathi uthathe umehluko wama-x-coordinate njengebanga.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.explain: Ibanga eliya emugqeni u-AB ngu-|21−4|/5=17/5, kodwa isisekelo se-perpendicular esuka ku-P siya emugqeni sisingaphandle kwengxenye (ngale kuka-B). Ngakho indawo eseduze kakhulu engxenyeni iyindawo yokugcina u-B, ngebanga √(9+4)=√13≈3.61. Lokhu kukhulu kuno-17/5=3.4.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amaphoyinti ama-3 u-P(a,b). Kumele abe yimaphoyinti anama-coordinate aphelele ukuze ibanga elisuka ku-P eliya emugqeni u-AB lihluke ebangeni elimfushane kakhulu eliya engxenyeni u-AB.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa umdwebo, cabanga ukuthi u-P kumele abe ohlangothini luphi ukuze isisekelo se-perpendicular esuka ku-P siya emugqeni siwele ngaphandle kwengxenye.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ubudlelwano bama-coordinate esibonelweni osivele usazi, njengo-(7,1), bese uthola amaphoyinti afanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.fail.k2: Kule ndawo, isisekelo se-perpendicular sisengxenyeni u-AB (noma endaweni yokugcina), ngakho amabanga amabili ayalingana.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.explain: Uma indawo yokuphonswa kuka-P endaweni yomugqa wengxenye ingaphambi kuka-A (4a+3b<0) noma ngale kuka-B (4a+3b>25), isisekelo se-perpendicular singaphandle kwengxenye. Kuleli cala indawo eseduze kakhulu iyindawo yokugcina, ngakho ibanga lihluke ebangeni eliya emugqeni.

n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi isisekelo se-perpendicular besisengxenyeni yamaphoyinti owenzile yini.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi indawo engxenyeni eseduze kakhulu no-P iphi uma isisekelo se-perpendicular singaphandle kwengxenye.

n-m-h1-geo-05.title: Umugqa Odlula Ephoyinteni Ebangeni Elimisiwe Elisuka Kumvelaphi
n-m-h1-geo-05.goal: Akha imigqa enelisa isimo sebanga elisuka ephoyinteni liye emgqeni efomini jikelele u-ax+by+c=0, futhi usebenze ukuthi isimo sebanga sishintsha kanjani inani lemigqa.
n-m-h1-geo-05.material: Sifuna ukuthola imigqa u-ax+by+c=0 edlula ephoyinteni (5,0) futhi ese-bangeni elimisiwe elisuka kumvelaphi. Umugqa umelwa nge-coefficients zawo (a,b,c). Isibalo esingu-2 izikhathi noma u-3 izikhathi sesinye sibalwa njengomugqa ofanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.thinking.0: Ukuguqula isimo sibe yisibalo ukwakha imigqa
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s1.prompt: Yenza imigqa engu-2 ehlukile edlula ephoyinteni (5,0) futhi ese-bangeni elingu-3 elisuka kumvelaphi. Bhala ama-coefficient (a,b,c).
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi ubudlelwano buphi phakathi kuka-a no-c obuvela uma ufaka iphoyinti (5,0).
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka u-c efomulini yebanga ukuthola ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b, bese ukhetha amanani ezinombolo ezigcwele.

n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, shintsha ibanga elisuka kumvelaphi libe ngu-5. Yimingaki imigqa edlula ephoyinteni (5,0) futhi ese-bangeni elingu-5 elisuka kumvelaphi?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuthola ibanga elisuka ephoyinteni (5,0) liye kumvelaphi.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ibanga eliphakathi kwemvelaphi nomugqa odlula ephoyinteni (5,0) lingaba likhulu kunalelo nani yini.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.a: Kubonakala sengathi ubone isibalo siphikisana ngenkathi uxazulula nge-slope njengo-y=m(x−5), futhi waphetha ngokuthi akukho mugqa.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.c: Kubonakala sengathi uthuthele inani lasebangeni elingu-3. Uma ibanga lishintsha, inani lingashintsha nalo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.d: Kunemigqa eminingi edlula ephoyinteni, kodwa isimo sebanga sikhawulela isiqondiso.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.explain: Ibanga elisuka ephoyinteni (5,0) liye kumvelaphi lingu-5. Phakathi kwemigqa edlula kuleli phoyinti, owuthe kude kakhulu nemvelaphi ngumugqa owodwa u-x=5, i-perpendicular engxenyeni exhuma imvelaphi no-(5,0), futhi ngumugqa wodwa ese-bangeni elingu-5.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.prompt: Uma umisa umugqa njengo-y=m(x−5) futhi uxazulule isimo sebanga, uphuthelwa umugqa wenkinga edlule (icala lebanga elingu-5). Chaza ukuthi yimuphi umugqa ophuthelwayo nokuthi kungani.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi kukhona yini umugqa ongenakukhiqizwa ngo-y=m(x−5) noma u-m ewuphi inombolo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ngqo ibanga eliphakathi kwemvelaphi nomugqa onjalo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usho ukuthi yimuphi umugqa ongabhalwa ngefomu u-y=m(x−5)?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uchaze ukuthi kungani ifomu jikelele u-ax+by+c=0 lingamela nalowo mugqa?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uxhumanise lokhu nokuthi kungani inani lemigqa lihluka ebangeni elingu-3 nasebangeni elingu-5?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.model.0: Umugqa ophuthelwayo ngu-x=5. Umugqa oqondile, ohambisana ne-y-axis, awunayo i-slope, ngakho awukwazi ukubhalwa ngefomu u-y=m(x−5). Kodwa ibanga elisuka kumvelaphi liye ku-x=5 lingu-5, ngakho lowo ngqo ngumugqa onelisa isimo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.model.1: Uma uyibhala nge-slope u-m, umugqa oqondile u-x=5 uyashiywa ngoba i-slope yawo ayichazwanga. Lo mugqa useqhelweni elingu-5 elisuka kumvelaphi futhi udlula ku-(5,0), ngakho uyimpendulo, futhi ungabhalwa ngefomu u-ax+by+c=0 (a=1, b=0, c=−5).

n-m-h1-comb-09.title: Ukuhlukanisa izimo ezinikeza n(n−1) nokukhetha isixazululo sesibalo
n-m-h1-comb-09.topic: Ukubala: ukuthola u-n ngesibalo nebanga lesixazululo
n-m-h1-comb-09.goal: Hlukanisa amacala anokulandelana (isiqondiso) nangenakho ukuze uhlukanise n(n−1) no-n(n−1)/2, futhi esimweni osenzayo, xazulula isibalo bese ukhetha isixazululo usebenzisa umbandela wokuthi isixazululo kumele sibe yinombolo yemvelo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.material: Cabanga ngezimo eziningana ezibala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abahlukene abangu-n (u-n uyinombolo yemvelo engu-2 okungenani). Ezinye zibalwa njengo-n(n−1) kanti ezinye njengo-n(n−1)/2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.thinking.2: Hlola ukuthi isixazululo sesibalo sihambisana nesimo yini
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izimo ezingezansi lapho inani eliphelele lezindlela libalwa njenge-n(n−1).
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.hint.0: Esimweni ngasinye, kubantu ababili abafanayo u-A no-B, hlola ukuthi (A, B) no-(B, A) ziyimiphumela ehlukile yini.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi lapho kunokulandelana, uphindaphinda inani lezindlela zokukhetha owokuqala kubantu abangu-n ngenani lezindlela zokukhetha owesibili.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.a: Khetha umongameli o-1 nesekela likamongameli e-1 kubantu abangu-n.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.b: Bonke abantu abangu-n bayabingelelana ngezandla kanye ngamunye.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.b: Ukubingelelana ngezandla kwenziwa ngabantu ababili ndawonye, ngakho (A, B) no-(B, A) ukubingelelana okufanayo. Ukukubala kabili kusho ukuthi kumele uhlukanise ngo-2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.c: Khetha abafundi abangu-2 bomsebenzi wokuhlanza kubantu abangu-n.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.c: Abafundi bomsebenzi wokuhlanza banendima efanayo, ngakho (A, B) no-(B, A) umphumela ofanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.d: Umuntu ngamunye kwabangu-n uthumela umlayezo oyedwa wombhalo kuwo wonke omunye umuntu.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.e: Xhuma onke amapheya phakathi kwamadolobha angu-n ngomgwaqo owodwa ngamunye.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.e: Umgwaqo oxhuma amadolobha A no-B ungumgwaqo owodwa futhi awunasiqondiso. (A, B) no-(B, A) ngumgwaqo ofanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.explain: Kumongameli nesekela likamongameli, ngisho nabantu ababili abafanayo banezindima ezihlukile, ngakho kungu-n(n−1). Ukuthumela umlayezo wombhalo nakho kuhlukile uma u-A ethumela ku-B nalapho u-B ethumela ku-A, ngakho kungu-n(n−1). Abanye abanakho ukulandelana noma isiqondiso, ngakho ukubala kabili kusho ukuhlukanisa ngo-2, kunikeza u-n(n−1)/2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza isimo sakho lapho izinto ezimbili zikhethwa ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa ukulandelana (isiqondiso), bese wenza inani eliphelele lezindlela libe ngu-45. Misa futhi uxazulule isibalo ku-n, bese ubhala nokuthi kungani esinye sezixazululo zesibalo kumele silahlwe.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma isimo sokukhetha abantu ababili, bese uhlola ukuthi ukushintshanisa abantu ababili abafanayo kunikeza umphumela ofanayo yini.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hlela kabusha isibalo sibe yi-quadratic, thola zombili izixazululo, bese ufunda isixazululo ngasinye ngamazwi esimo (inani labantu, njll.).
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Ngenze isimo lapho ... Isibalo singu-... Izixazululo ngu-..., ngakho ...
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Esimweni osenzile, ingabe uhlole ukuthi ukulandelana noma isiqondiso akudingeki ngempela?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umise isibalo futhi wathola zombili izixazululo?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani isixazululo esilahliwe singenakwenzeka kuleso simo?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.model.0: Isimo ngukuthi bonke abantu abangu-n ekilasini lethu bayabingelelana ngezandla kanye ngamunye. Ukubingelelana ngezandla akunakulandelana, ngakho n(n−1)/2=45, n²−n−90=0, (n−10)(n+9)=0, ngakho n=10 noma −9. Inani labantu alinakuba libi, ngakho silahla u-−9 futhi n=abantu abayi-10.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.model.1: Amaqembu angu-n adlala wodwa ngomunye ngokulandelana kwe-league, imidlalo engu-45 sebeyonke. Umdlalo awunasiqondiso, ngakho nC2=45 no-n(n-1)=90. n=10 noma n=-9, kodwa inani lamaqembu kumele libe yinombolo yemvelo, ngakho u-−9 omubi akavunyelwe futhi kungamaqembu ayi-10.

n-m-h1-func-04.thinking.0: Buyekeza isinqumo sakho njengoba ulwazi lukhula
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa lokho owaziyo okwamanje kuphela.
n-m-h1-func-04.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-04.title: I-rational function engancishiswa, nomugqa: izindawo zokudibana zishintsha kanjani?
n-m-h1-func-04.goal: Qinisekisa, ngenkathi uchibiyela isahlulelo sakho njengoba ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi ukunciphisa inkulumo ye-rational kuyenza ibukeke njengomugqa kodwa umbandela we-domain uyasala.
n-m-h1-func-04.material: Sifuna ukuthola inani lezindawo zokudibana zegrafu yomsebenzi f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) nemigqa.
n-m-h1-func-04.prereq.1: Amanani enza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, ne-domain
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, hlola ukuthi isahlulelo sakho kuze kube manje siphikisana nalo yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka inani lika-x elitholakale enkulumweni encishisiwe esihlukanisini senkulumo yokuqala bese uhlola ukuthi liba ngu-0 yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2), futhi inombolo engaphezulu yahlukaniswa ngezici ibe (x−2)(x+2).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Umugqa ovundlile y=k uhlangana negrafu ka-f emaphoyinti amangaki, kuye ngo-k?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngemva kokunciphisa, uthatha ifomu x+2, ngakho kubukeka sengathi uhlangana nomugqa ngamunye ovundlile endaweni eyodwa. Kodwa ukunciphisa kuvunyelwe kuphela uma x≠2. Kulolu lwazi olulandelayo sihlola ukuthi lo mbandela ushintsha umphumela yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Uhlangana endaweni eyodwa ncamashi kuwo wonke u-k
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uhlulele kuphela ngenkulumo encishisiwe. Lesi yisahlulelo esingakahloli i-domain.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Usola ukuthi kungase kube khona umbandela ophuthelwe lapho kunciphiswa.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Yinkulumo ye-quadratic, ngakho uhlangana emaphoyinti ama-2 kuwo wonke u-k
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ubheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi inombolo engaphezulu i-quadratic. Bheka isihlukanisi nokunciphisa ndawonye.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukufaka u-x=2 kwenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, ngakho u-f(2) akachazwanga. Igrafu ayinayo indawo ene-x=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Pho yiliphi inani lika-k elinikeza umugqa ovundlile y=k ongahlangani?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Enkulumweni encishisiwe y=x+2, lapho x=2, y=4, ngakho indawo (2, 4) ayikho egrafini. Ngakho akahlangani no-y=4. Kwamanye amanani ka-k, x=k−2≠2, ngakho uhlangana endaweni eyodwa.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuzange ubonise ulwazi lokuthi indawo ishodayo ku-x=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Njengoba x=2, ucabange ukuthi k=2. Uxubile izindima ze-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Manje cabanga ngomugqa y=mx odlula ku-origin negrafu ka-f. Kusuka ku-x+2=mx, x=2/(m−1) (m≠1).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ku-m onani likaphi u-y=mx negrafu ka-f akuhlangani?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma m=1, x+2=x ayinasixazululo, ngakho imigqa iyahambisana futhi ayihlangani. Uma m=2, x=2, ngakho kufanele ihlangane endaweni engekho (2, 4), kodwa leyo ndawo ayikho, ngakho ayihlangani. Kufanele uhlale uhlola ukuthi isixazululo ositholile asiyona x=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uhlole kuphela ukuthi x+2=mx ayinasixazululo uma m=1. Awuhlolanga ukuthi u-x owutholile usebangeni yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ubheke kuphela icala lapho u-x owutholile engu-2. Cabanga futhi ngecala lapho kungekho sixazululo nhlobo.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ngibheke kuphela umugqa onciphisiwe ngacabanga ukuthi uhlala uhlangana, kodwa kusukela kulwazi lokuthi iphoyinti alikho ku-x=2, ngafunda ukuthi y=4 no-y=2x ayihlangani nalo. Isixazululo esitholwe esibalweni esenziwe sibe lula ngokunciphisa kufanele sihlolwe futhi ngokuphambene nesimo sebanga somsebenzi wokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani y=2x negrafu ka-f ayihlangani, uxhumanisa inqubo yokuxazulula isibalo nenani lika-x.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka leli nani lika-x esibalweni sokuqala (x²−4)/(x−2).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthole ukuthi isixazululo x sesibalo siyini?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi lesi sixazululo sesebangeni yini?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.model.0: Ukuxazulula x+2=2x kunika x=2, kodwa u-f unesihlukanisi esingu-0 ku-x=2, ngakho akachazwanga. Ngakho noma kubonakala sengathi kunesixazululo, iphoyinti alikho kugrafu yangempela, ngakho ayihlangani.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.model.1: Ukuthola indawo yokuhlangana nesibalo esinciphisiwe kunika x=2, kodwa leli nani lisuswe ebangeni lomsebenzi wokuqala. Iphoyinti (2, 4) alikho kugrafu, ngakho ayihlangani nomugqa y=2x.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha umsebenzi ografu yawo ingumugqa oqondile onephoyinti elilodwa elingekho.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.hint.0: Hlukanisa inombolo engaphezulu yesibalo ngasinye bese uhlola ukuthi kukhona ingxenye enciphisa nesihlukanisi yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isibalo esisele ngemva kokunciphisa si-linear (umugqa) yini, nokuthi u-x owenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0 unani lini esibalweni esinciphisiwe.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.a: Lijika elinomugqa osondelayo ku-x=1, lapho isihlukanisi singu-0. Hlola ukuthi inombolo engaphezulu nayo iba ngu-0 ku-x ofanayo yini.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.c: Inombolo engaphezulu ayinakho ukuhlukaniswa futhi akukho okunciphayo. Akuyona umugqa.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.d: Iyanciphisa, kodwa isibalo esinciphisiwe 1/(x−1) lijika, hhayi umugqa.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.explain: y=(x²−9)/(x+3)=x−3 (x≠−3), ngakho iphoyinti (−3, −6) kuphela elingekho emgqeni y=x−3. Ku-d, noma ngemva kokunciphisa, y=1/(x−1) (x≠−1), ngakho akuyona umugqa.

n-m-h1-func-01.title: I-composite function eyenziwe lula inkulumo yayo: ingabe i-domain ayishintshanga?
n-m-h1-func-01.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-01.goal: Ngemva kokwenza lula inkulumo ye-composite function, hlola ukuthi umbandela we-domain we-inner function usasele yini, bese uthola futhi uphinde ubhale iphutha ekuxazululweni.
n-m-h1-func-01.material: Ku-f(x)=x² (domain: zonke izinombolo zangempela) no-g(x)=√(x−2), uMinsu waxazulula i-composite function f∘g ngale ndlela elandelayo.
n-m-h1-func-01.thinking.0: Hlukanisa inkulumo eyenziwe lula ne-domain yomsebenzi wokuqala
n-m-h1-func-01.thinking.1: Thola izibonelo zokuhlanganisa lapho umbandela uyanyamalala
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile ekuxazululweni kukaMinsu.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi ukulandelana kokuthola u-f∘g kungukubala u-g kuqala bese ufaka leso siphumo ku-f.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amanani ambalwa afana no-x=0 no-x=5 ku-g kuqala bese uhlola ukuthi ukubala kungaqedwa yini.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho i-domain ka-f∘g yizo zonke izinombolo zangempela.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-3 awulungile. Ukubala (f∘g)(x)=f(g(x)), u-g(x) kumele kuqala anqunywe njengenombolo yangempela. Noma inkulumo yenziwa lula ibe ngu-x−2, i-domain x≥2 ka-g ayinyamalali. Umugqa wesi-4 umphumela olandela umugqa wesi-3.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwama-composite function alandelayo f∘g, khetha onke lapho umkhawulo we-domain usasele ngisho nangemva kokwenza lula inkulumo.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, qala ufune u-x ongeke afakwe ku-g.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qoqa u-x kuphela lapho u-g(x) echaziwe, futhi uhlole nokuthi leli nani lingafakwa yini ku-f.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.a: Ubone kuphela ukuthi kubukeka njengo-x+3 ngemva kokwenza lula futhi waphutha umbandela we-domain ka-g. Hlola ukuthi u-x ungomunye lapho umsebenzi wangaphakathi uchaziwe yini.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.b: g(x)=x² uchaziwe kuwo wonke u-x, futhi inani x² elifakwe ku-f lingu-0 okungenani, ngakho akukho mkhawulo. Bheka nokuthi inkulumo eyenziwe lula ngu-|x|.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.c: Yenziwa lula ibe ngu-x, kodwa waphutha umbandela wokuthi u-g akachazwanga ku-x=0.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.d: Yomibili imisebenzi ichaziwe kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela, futhi ukuyihlanganisa akwenzi mkhawulo omusha.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.explain: Ku-a, umbandela x≥−3 usalele kumsebenzi wangaphakathi g, futhi ku-c, x≠0. Ku-b, √(x²)=|x| uchaziwe kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela. U-d akanawo umkhawulo. Noma inkulumo yenziwa lula, u-x lapho umsebenzi wangaphakathi ungachazwanga ususwa ku-domain ye-composite function.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.prompt: Lungisa indlela yokuxazulula kaMinsu, bhala i-domain ka-f∘g, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani (f∘g)(0) ingenqunyiwe.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ngemva kokuthola inkulumo x−2, bhala futhi ukuthi u-f∘g uchaziwe ku-x muni.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi inani eliphakathi ekubaleni u-g(0) liyingempela yini.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise ukuthi inkulumo x−2 nomsebenzi f∘g kungase kungafani?
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.model.0: Inkulumo ka-f∘g ngu-x−2, kodwa ngenxa ye-domain ka-g ichaziwe kuphela ku-x≥2. Ku-x=0, g(0)=√(−2) akayona yangempela, ngakho (f∘g)(0) ayichazwanga.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.model.1: (f∘g)(x)=x−2 (lapho x≥2). U-0 akayona u-2 okungenani, ngakho akayona ingxenye ye-domain, futhi inani −2 alikwazi ukuvela.

n-m-h1-func-02.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-02.title: Ukuthola i-inverse ye-rational function nokuyiqhathanisa nenkulumo yokuqala
n-m-h1-func-02.goal: Thola ngqo i-inverse ye-rational function bese uyiqhathanisa nenkulumo yokuqala, bese wenza izinkulumo eziningana ezinesici esiboniswe ukuqhathanisa futhi uchaze isakhiwo sazo.
n-m-h1-func-02.material: Sifuna ukuthola i-inverse function f⁻¹(x) yomsebenzi f(x)=(2x+3)/(x−2) (x≠2). Shintshanisa u-x no-y bese uxazulula u-y.
n-m-h1-func-02.thinking.2: Chaza usebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-asymptote no-y=x
n-m-h1-func-02.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-inverse function nendlela yokuyithola (shintshanisa u-x no-y bese uxazulula u-y)
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kusuka ku-y=(2x+3)/(x−2), bhala inkulumo enoshintshaniswe u-x no-y, susa isihlukanisi, bese uqoqa amagama ane-y ohlangothini olulodwa.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.hint.1: Faka inani lika-f(3) enkulumweni oyikhethile bese uhlola ukuthi u-3 uyabuya yini.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe i-inverse function njengefana ne-reciprocal. Hlola ngenani elilodwa ukuthi f(f⁻¹(x))=x yini.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi ukushintsha uphawu kuphela kunikeza u-f⁻¹. Faka u-f(3)=9 kule nkulumo bese uhlola ukuthi u-3 uyaphuma yini.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.d: Uhambise uphawu ngephutha ngenkathi uhlela kabusha u-y ngemva kokushintshanisa u-x no-y. Hlola ngokufaka u-f(3)=9.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuxazulula u-x=(2y+3)/(y−2) ku-y kunika u-xy−2x=2y+3, y(x−2)=2x+3, ngakho y=(2x+3)/(x−2). I-inverse function iphenduka ibe inkulumo efanayo nomsebenzi wokuqala. Hlola: f(3)=9, f⁻¹(9)=3.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ama-rational function amabili ahlukene anesici sika-f esinyathelweni sokuqala (lokho okuvezwe uma uthola i-inverse function bese uyiqhathanisa nenkulumo yokuqala), bese ufaka izinombolo eziphelele a, b, c, d zika-f(x)=(ax+b)/(cx+d). (Ziyizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−6 kuya ku-6, u-c akayona u-0, futhi ad−bc akumele kube ngu-0. Isiphindwe esiyinkonstanti somsebenzi ofanayo sibalwa njengesisodwa.)
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.hint.0: Enkulumweni evamile y=(ax+b)/(cx+d), shintshanisa u-x no-y, xazulula u-y, bese uqhathanisa ama-coefficient ngamunye nomphumela wesinyathelo sokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beka umphumela we-inverse function wenkulumo evamile eduze nenkulumo ka-f, bese ubhala ukuthi yimuphi umbandela odingekayo kuma-coefficient ukuze izinkulumo ezimbili zilingane.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c1: A, b, c, d kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−6 kuya ku-6.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma u-c engu-0, akuyona i-rational function.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma ad−bc=0, kuyi-constant function futhi ayinayo i-inverse function.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c4: I-inverse function yale nkulumo ayilingani no-f. Bala u-f(f(x)) noma uthole i-inverse function bese uqhathanisa.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.explain: I-inverse function ngu-f⁻¹(x)=(−dx+b)/(cx−a). Ukuze ilingane no-f, sidinga a=−d. Izibonelo: (x+1)/(x−1), (2x+3)/(x−2), 4/x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.prompt: Ezimisweni ezimbili owenzile, thola ama-asymptote (x=○, y=○) ngamunye, uwaqhathanise, bese ubhala ukuthi ama-asymptote anakho okufanayo uma f=f⁻¹.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kwinkulumo ngayinye owenzile, thola inani lika-x elenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0 nenani u-y asondela kulo lapho u-x ekhula kakhulu.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ama-coordinate wendawo edibana yama-asymptote amabili bese uqhathanisa indawo yayo nomugqa y=x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthole ama-asymptote x=−d/c, y=a/c futhi wawaqhathanisa?
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uxhume lokhu neqiniso lokuthi amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ ayafana ngokuhlangothi ku-y=x?
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.model.0: Isibonelo, (x+1)/(x−1) inama-asymptote x=1, y=1, no-(2x+3)/(x−2) inawo x=2, y=2. Amanani amabili ayalingana, ngakho indawo edibana yama-asymptote isebangeni ku-y=x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.model.1: Amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ ayafana ngokuhlangothi ku-y=x, ngakho uma f=f⁻¹, igrafu ka-f uqobo iyafana ngokuhlangothi ku-y=x. Ngakho amanani ama-asymptote x=p no-y=p kumele alingane.

n-m-h1-func-03.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-03.title: Ingabe amaphoyinti lapho u-f nomsebenzi wawo oyinverse behlangana khona wonke asemgqeni y=x?
n-m-h1-func-03.goal: Thola umbandela odingekayo ukusho ukuthi zonke izindawo zokudibana zamagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ zisebangeni ku-y=x, bese wenza isibonelo esiphikisayo ukuchaza ukuthi kungani lowo mbandela udingeka.
n-m-h1-func-03.material: U-f uhambisana ngokusodwa-nokusodwa kusuka kusethi yazo zonke izinombolo zangempela kuya kusethi yazo zonke izinombolo zangempela, ngakho unayo i-inverse function f⁻¹. UJiyeon uthi ukuthola amaphoyinti lapho amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ ehlangana khona, udinga kuphela ukuxazulula isibalo f(x)=x. Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi sidinga ukwazi ini ngo-f ukuze leso sitatimende sihlale liyiqiniso.
n-m-h1-func-03.thinking.2: Phikisana ngokuthi izindawo zokudibana zisemgqeni ku-y=x uma umbandela usebenza
n-m-h1-func-03.prereq.0: Igrafu ye-inverse function iyafana ngokuhlangothi ku-y=x
n-m-h1-func-03.prereq.1: Incazelo yomsebenzi okhulayo (uma a<b khona f(a)<f(b))
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi "wonke amaphoyinti lapho amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ ehlangana khona asemgqeni y=x", yikuphi kokulandelayo okudingeka sikwazi ngo-f?
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha umbandela ngamunye ngesikhathi, bese ufuna phakathi kwemisebenzi yeline u-f onelisa lowo mbandela kodwa ohlangana ngaphandle komugqa y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ kumsebenzi weline okhulayo f(x)=2x+1 nomsebenzi weline owehlayo f(x)=−x+3.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.a: Dweba kokubili u-f no-f⁻¹ kumsebenzi f(x)=−x, odlula ku-origin. Bona ukuthi amagrafu amabili ahlangana yini ngaphandle ku-y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukuhlangana nomugqa y=x kusho ukuthi kukhona indawo yokudibana ku-y=x; akusho ukuthi azikho ezinye izindawo zokudibana. Hlola ngo-f(x)=−x+3.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.c: Phakathi kwemisebenzi yeline enamagrafu axhumene, ikhona lapho u-f no-f⁻¹ bengumugqa ofanayo. Hlola ngomsebenzi weline onokuthambeka okubi.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.o.d: U-f umsebenzi okhulayo (njengoba u-x ekhula, u-f(x) ukhula)
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.explain: Uma u-f engumsebenzi okhulayo, zonke izindawo zokudibana zika-f no-f⁻¹ zisemgqeni y=x. Eminye imibandela yonke inezibonelo eziphikisayo. U-f(x)=−x+3 unegrafu exhumene futhi uhlangana no-y=x, kodwa u-f no-f⁻¹ bangumugqa ofanayo, ngakho bahlangana nangaphandle ku-y=x. U-f(x)=−x udlula ku-origin kodwa uyehluleka ngesizathu esifanayo.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.prompt: Ake u-f(x)=mx+n (m≠0), bese wenza imisebenzi emibili ehlukene yeline ukuze amagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ ahlangane endaweni (t, f(t)) engekho emgqeni y=x, bese ufaka u-m, n, t. (Izinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9)
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole i-inverse function ka-f(x)=mx+n bese umisa inkulumo ethi u-f no-f⁻¹ banenani elifanayo ku-x ofanayo.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ukuthambeka okuhlukahlukene, thola izinkulumo ze-f no-f⁻¹, xazulula u-x lapho izinkulumo ezimbili zilingana, bese uhlola ukuthi indawo isemgqeni y=x yini.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ziyizinombolo eziphelele ebangeni futhi u-m akayona u-0.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.fail.c1: M, n, t kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9 futhi u-m akumele abe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ku-x=t, u-f(t) no-f⁻¹(t) abalingani. Bala u-f⁻¹(t)=(t−n)/m bese uqhathanisa.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.explain: I-inverse function ka-f(x)=mx+n ngu-(x−n)/m, futhi amagrafu amabili ahlangana ngaphandle ku-y=x kwelicala lapho m=−1 futhi u-f no-f⁻¹ bengumugqa ofanayo. Isibonelo: f(x)=−x+2, indawo (0, 2).
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani, uma u-f engumsebenzi okhulayo, zonke izindawo zokudibana zamagrafu ka-f no-f⁻¹ zisemgqeni y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.hint.0: Uma indawo yokudibana (a, b) isegrafini ka-f futhi nasegrafini ka-f⁻¹, bhala ukuthi u-f(a) no-f(b) ngamunye yini.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.hint.1: Thatha u-a<b bese usebenzisa incazelo yomsebenzi okhulayo ku-f(a) no-f(b).
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.model.0: Uma indawo yokudibana ingu-(a, b), khona f(a)=b no-f(b)=a. Uma a<b, u-f ukhula ngakho f(a)<f(b), okunika b<a, okuphikisanayo. U-a>b ufana, ngakho ekugcineni a=b.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.model.1: Kusuka ku-f(a)=b no-f(b)=a, uma a<b khona njengoba u-f ekhula f(a)<f(b), okungukuthi, b<a, okungenakwenzeka. Ngokufanayo a>b akunakwenzeka, ngakho a=b futhi indawo yokudibana isemgqeni y=x.

n-m-h1-func-05.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-05.title: Isibalo se-irrational esixazululwa ngokwenza isikwele: ingabe isixazululo singethenjelwa?
n-m-h1-func-05.goal: Hlola ukuthi izimpande zishintsha kanjani uma uxazulula isibalo se-irrational ngokwenza isikwele, khetha izixazululo ezingethenjelwa, bese wenza isibalo esinjalo wena.
n-m-h1-func-05.material:
Abafundi abahlanu baxazulule isibalo se-irrational √(x+6)=x ngezindlela ezihlukile.
· Gayoung: Wenze isikwele izinhlangothi zombili wathola x+6=x², okungukuthi, x²−x−6=0, wathola x=3 noma x=−2, wathi zombili ziyizimpande.
· Narae: Wafaka u-x=3 no-x=−2 owatholwa ngokwenza isikwele esibalweni sokuqala wathi kuphela x=3 iyimpande.
· Daon: Njengoba uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwesibalo sokuqala lungu-0 noma ngaphezulu, waqala wabhala x≥0, wathi phakathi kwamanani atholwe ngokwenza isikwele, x=3 kuphela, ogculisa x≥0, uyimpande.
· Rahee: Wadweba amagrafu e-y=√(x+6) ne-y=x, wafunda ama-x-coordinate ezindawo zokuhlangana, wathi x=3 kuphela iyimpande.
· Maru: Wacabanga ukuthi uma izinhlangothi zombili zilingana khona-ke izikwele zazo zilingana, ngakho isibalo esenziwe isikwele nesibalo sokuqala sinezimpande ezifanayo, wathi zombili x=3 no-x=−2 ziyizimpande.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izindlela zesixazululo okungethenjelwa ukuthi isiphetho sazo silungile.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka x=3 no-x=−2 ezinhlangothini zesobunxele nesokudla zesibalo sokuqala √(x+6)=x bese uqhathanisa amanani.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kusuka ku-A²=B², bhala kokubili A=B no-A=−B, bese ucabanga ukuthi yiliphi lawo elivumelana nesibalo sokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.a: Narae: wafaka amanani atholwe ngokwenza isikwele esibalweni sokuqala wahlola
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.b: Gayoung: wathatha amanani womabili asuka ekwenzeni isikwele njengezimpande njengoba enjalo
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi izimpande zesibalo esenziwe isikwele ziyizimpande zesibalo sokuqala. Faka amanani amabili esibalweni sokuqala bese uhlola ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili ziyalingana yini.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.c: Daon: njengoba uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-0 noma ngaphezulu, waqala wabhala isimo x≥0 bese wenza isikwele
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.d: Rahee: wafunda ama-x-coordinate ezindawo zokuhlangana zamagrafu yemisebenzi emibili
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.e: Maru: wacabanga ukuthi uma izinhlangothi zombili zilingana khona-ke izikwele zazo zilingana, ngakho izimpande ziyafana
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.r.e: Awuhlolanga ukuthi isiqondiso esisuka kusibalo esenziwe isikwele sibuyela esibalweni sokuqala siyasebenza njalo yini. Uma A=B khona-ke A²=B², kodwa hlola ukuthi kwenzekani ohlangothini oluphambene.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.explain: Uma A=B khona-ke A²=B², kodwa uma A²=B² khona-ke A=B noma A=−B. Ngakho ngemva kokwenza isikwele kufanele uhlole izimpendulo, noma unamathisele isimo B≥0 kusukela ekuqaleni. Izindawo zokuhlangana zamagrafu nazo zisebenzisa ngokuzenzakalelayo isimo esifanayo. Ku-x=−2, √4=2 kuyilapho uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-−2, ngakho akuyona impande.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani x=−2, etholwe ngokwenza isikwele, ingeyona impande yesibalo sokuqala, usebenzisa amanani ezinhlangothi zesobunxele nesokudla uma kufakwa x=−2.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=−2 ngokwehlukana ezinhlangothini zesobunxele nesokudla zesibalo sokuqala √(x+6)=x bese ubala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa isibalo esenziwe isikwele 4=4 namanani amabili avela esibalweni sokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi impande yesikwele ayikwazi ukuba ngekho kahle?
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.model.0: Ukufaka x=−2, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-√4=2 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-−2, ngakho amanani amabili ahlukile. Impande yesikwele ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu kodwa uhlangothi lwesokudla alunhle, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba yimpande.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.model.1: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-√(−2+6)=2 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-−2. 2 no-−2 aziyalingani, ngakho akuyona impande. Ukwenza isikwele kususa uphawu futhi kwenze 4=4, ngakho kubonakale njengempande.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.prompt: Kusibalo se-irrational √(x+a)=x+b, faka izinombolo eziphelele a, b ukuze isibalo se-quadratic esitholwe ngokwenza isikwele izinhlangothi zombili sibe nezimpande ezimbili eziphelele futhi eyodwa kuphela yazo iyimpande yesibalo sokuqala. (Izinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−6 kuya ku-12; ungafaki isibalo esifanayo no-√(x+6)=x ongenhla.)
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.hint.0: Yenza isikwele ukuze ubhale isibalo se-quadratic ku-x, bese ucabanga ukuthi i-discriminant kufanele ibe yinombolo ephi ukuze izimpande ezimbili zibe yizinombolo eziphelele.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.hint.1: Zama amanani ambalwa ka-a no-b, bese kumpande ngayinye oyithola, yifake esibalweni sokuqala uhlole ukuthi x+b ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−6 kuya ku-12.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.ok.c3: Izimpande zesibalo esenziwe isikwele ziyizinombolo eziphelele ezimbili ezihlukile futhi eyodwa yazo akuyona impande yesibalo sokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Xazulula isibalo esenziwe isikwele x+a=(x+b)² bese uhlola ukuthi izimpande ziyizinombolo eziphelele ezimbili futhi eyodwa kuphela inayo x+b≥0.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.explain: Kusuka ku-x+a=(x+b)², sithola x²+(2b−1)x+b²−a=0. I-discriminant ingu-4(a−b)+1, ngakho uma lokhu kuyinombolo eyisikwele ephelele enkulu kuno-1, kuvela izimpande ezimbili eziphelele, futhi impande encane kuphela inayo x+b<0. Isibonelo: (3, 1) inika √(x+3)=x+1, futhi impande 1 kuphela iyasebenza.

n-m-h1-func-06.topic: Imisebenzi namagrafu: ama-composite function nama-inverse function, imisebenzi ye-rational ne-irrational, imikhawulo ye-domain
n-m-h1-func-06.title: Ukwenza nokuthola yonke imisebenzi ye-irrational egculisa izimo
n-m-h1-func-06.goal: Yenza izibalo ezingenzeka wena uma ibanga nephoyinti emsebenzini we-irrational kunikeziwe, bese ubala amacala angenzeka ngaphandle kokushiya kunoma yimuphi ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi ayizinombolo eziphelele.
n-m-h1-func-06.material: Sifuna ukwenza umsebenzi we-irrational y=a√(x−b)+c (a, b, c yizinombolo eziphelele, a≠0). Izimo: ① ibanga ngu-y≤3 ② igrafu idlula ephoyintini (7, −1), futhi leli phoyinti akuyona indawo yokuqala yebanga (x=b<7). Futhi, −9≤a≤9, −10≤b≤10, −9≤c≤9.
n-m-h1-func-06.prereq.1: Uma impande yesikwele i-rational, inombolo engaphansi kophawu lwempande iyisikwele esiphelele
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.prompt: Kusuka esimweni ① (ibanga ngu-y≤3), khetha lokho ongaphetha ngakho mayelana no-a no-c.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi kwenzekani ku-y uma x iba nkulu uma a inhle nalapho a ingenhle, ngokufaka amanani.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa icala lapho iphoyinti lokuqala (b, c) legrafu liyiphoyinti eliphezulu kakhulu nalelo lapho liyiphoyinti eliphansi kakhulu.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.a: Uma a>0, khona-ke y≥c, ngakho igrafu ikhuphuka ngaphandle komkhawulo. Hlola ukuthi lokho kuyahambisana nebanga elingu-y≤3.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.b: b inquma lapho isifunda siqala khona. Ayifani nenani eliphezulu lebanga.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.d: Uma c ingaphansi kuka-3, inani eliphezulu lebanga lingu-c, ngakho alifinyeleli ku-3. Hlola ukuthi ibanga lingu-y≤3 ngqo.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.explain: Uma a<0, khona-ke y iba incane njengoba √(x−b) iba nkulu, ngakho y inenani layo eliphezulu c ku-x=b. Ukuze ibanga libe ngu-y≤3, c kufanele ibe ngu-3.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi emibili ehlukile ye-irrational egculisa kokubili izimo ① no-②, bese ufaka u-a, b, c kuyo ngayinye.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ngemva kokunquma u-c esimweni ①, faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti (7, −1) esibalweni ukuthola ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qala uthole inani lika-a√(7−b), bese uzama izinombolo ezifana no-1, 4, 9, 16 ku-7−b bese uhlola ukuthi a iyinombolo ephelele yini.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke ziyizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kwebanga elivunyelwe, futhi a ayiyona u-0.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a kufanele ibe yinombolo ephelele engeyona u-0 (−9 kuya ku-9), b yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-−10 kuya ku-10, no-c yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ibanga alingu-y≤3. Hlola isiqondiso segrafu nenani layo eliphezulu.

n-m-h1-func-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kusuka ku-a√(7−b)=−4, veza u-√(7−b) ngokuya ku-a.
