n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.explain: Uma k=1 inkulumo ingu-3, futhi uma k=3 ingu-2x² − 4x + 3 = 2(x−1)² + 1 > 0, ngakho iyasebenza. Ku-k=0 inani lingu-−5 ku-x=4, futhi ku-k=4 lingu-0 ku-x=1, ngakho ayisebenzi.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani u-k=1 kumele ahlolwe ngokwehlukile. Bhala nokuthi kungani icala k<1 lingasebenzi.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi kwenzekani egameni le-x² nelegama le-x uma k=1.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi uphawu lwe-coefficient ye-x² luyini uma k<1, nokuthi kwenzekani kunani lenkulumo uma u-x eyinombolo enkulu kakhulu.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.placeholder: isib., Uma k=1, isibalo singu-..., ngakho ...
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngqo ukuthi isibalo siba yini uma k=1?
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze, usebenzisa izimpawu, ukuthi kungani k<1 ikhishiwe?
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi kungani isimo se-discriminant sodwa singeneli?
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.model.0: Uma k=1, ama-coefficient emagameni e-x² no-x womabili angu-0 futhi isibalo siba ngu-3>0. Kuleso simo akuyona ukungalingani kwe-quadratic, ngakho i-discriminant ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa, futhi ukuhlola ngqo kubonisa ukuthi ihlala ibamba. Uma k<1, i-coefficient ka-x² ingu-negative, ngakho isibalo siba ngu-negative njengoba u-x ekhula.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.model.1: U-k=1, lapho k−1=0, akunikezi isibalo se-quadratic. Ngakho ayibanjwa isimo se-discriminant, kodwa isibalo singu-3 ongaguquki, ohlala eyi-positive. Uma k<1, kuyi-parabola evulekela phansi, ngakho ngesinye isikhathi iya ngaphansi kuka-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.model.2: Uma u-k engu-1, ama-coefficient aba ngu-0 futhi u-3>0 kuphela osala, okuyiqiniso kuwo wonke u-x. UHayun akabhekanga leli cala. Uma u-k mncane kuno-1, i-coefficient ka-x² ingu-negative, ngakho ku-x omkhulu kakhulu inani lingu-negative.

n-m-h1-ineq-05.title: Ukuchazela Umnikazi Wesitolo Amanani Anenzuzo
n-m-h1-ineq-05.goal: Dlulisa isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic ngamagama abansuku zonke kothile ongazazi amafomula, bese ubhala ngqo ukuthi kwenzekani emanani omngcele.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.material: Esitolo, lapho into e-1 ithengiswa ngo-p izinkulungwane zama-won (p>0), inzuzo yansuku zonke ingu-(−p² + 14p − 24) izinkulungwane zama-won. Umfundi ubhalela umnikazi wesitolo umbiko. Umnikazi akazazi kahle izibalo futhi ufuna ukwazi, "Ngakho kufanele ngithengise ngentengo ephi?"
n-m-h1-ineq-05.thinking.0: Ukuhumusha isethi yezixazululo ibe ulimi lwesimo
n-m-h1-ineq-05.prereq.1: Incazelo yesixazululo sokungalingani namanani aso omngcele
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala embikweni womfundi oyiphikisa amaqiniso.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa isitatimende emgqeni ngamunye, umugqa o-1 ngesikhathi, nokungalingani emgqeni owandulelayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi amagama anjengo-"okungenani," "okungaphezu," "ngaphezulu kuka," "ngaphansi kuka" asho into efanayo nezimpawu zokungalingani esethini yezixazululo yini.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.0: Ukuze uthole inzuzo, −p² + 14p − 24 > 0, futhi lokhu kufana no-p² − 14p + 24 < 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho, mnumzane, uma umisa intengo ku-2 izinkulungwane zama-won noma ngaphezulu futhi ku-12 izinkulungwane zama-won noma ngaphansi, uzothola inzuzo.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.3: Uma uyimisa ngaphezu kuka-12 izinkulungwane zama-won, empeleni uzolahlekelwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 awulungile. Isixazululo singu-2<p<12, futhi izimpawu zokungalingani azinaphawu lokulingana. Uma p=2 noma p=12, inzuzo ingu-0 ngqo, ngakho akuyona intengo eyenza inzuzo. Imigqa 1, 2, no-4 ilungile.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa 3 bese uwubhala kabusha njengencazelo yemishwana emi-2 kuya kwemi-3 umnikazi angayisebenzisa ngokushesha. Awudingi ukusebenzisa amafomula noma u-p. Qiniseka ukuthi ufaka ibanga lamanani nokuthi inzuzo iyini ezihlokweni zombili zalelo banga.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala, njengomusho wakho wokuqala, lokho umnikazi angathanda kakhulu ukukuzwa kuqala lapho ebuza u-"Ngakho intengo ephi?"
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani amabili ezihloko esibalweni, bala inzuzo, bese ufaka lowo mphumela olimini lomnikazi.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.placeholder: isib., Uma umisa intengo phakathi kuka-..., khona ... Kodwa ku-... ngqo, ...
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ibanga lamanani anenzuzo ukuze umnikazi akwazi ukulifunda futhi alisebenzise ngokushesha?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolile ngokubala ukuthi inzuzo ingu-0 ezintengweni zombili zezihloko?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe udlulisele okuqukethwe okufanayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izimpawu zefomula?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.0: Uma umisa intengo ngaphezu kuka-2 izinkulungwane zama-won futhi ngaphansi kuka-12 izinkulungwane zama-won, uthola inzuzo. Ku-2 izinkulungwane noma 12 izinkulungwane zama-won ngqo, inzuzo ingu-0, ngakho uphuma ulingana kuphela. Uma uthengisa ngaphezu kuka-12 izinkulungwane zama-won, ulahlekelwa imali.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.1: Thengisa ngaphezu kuka-2 izinkulungwane zama-won nangaphansi kuka-12 izinkulungwane zama-won. Uma uthengisa ngo-2 izinkulungwane noma 12 izinkulungwane zama-won, awuthole nzuzo (0 won).
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.2: Uma umisa intengo phakathi kuka-2 izinkulungwane no-12 izinkulungwane zama-won, uzothola inzuzo. Kodwa ezihlokweni zombili, 2 izinkulungwane no-12 izinkulungwane zama-won, akukho nzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.modelNote.2: Leli yilo icala lapho u-"phakathi" asetshenziswa ukusho ukukhipha izihloko zombili; kunembile uma inzuzo engu-0 ezihlokweni zombili nayo ibhalwa.

n-m-h1-ineq-06.title: Ukwenza Ukungalingani Kwe-Quadratic Okunephoyinti Elilodwa Lesixazululo
n-m-h1-ineq-06.goal: Yazi ukuthi isethi yezixazululo ishintsha kanjani ngophawu lokungalingani uma isibalo se-quadratic siyisikwele esiphelele, bese wakha ukungalingani kwe-quadratic okunesixazululo esiyiphoyinti elilodwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.material: Sifuna ukuxazulula ukungalingani kwe-quadratic x² − 6x + 9 ≤ 0. Ingxenye ye-quadratic yalesi sibalo inesimo esihlukaniswa kalula.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.1: Ukwakha isibalo esihambisana nezimo wena uqobo
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.2: Ukushintsha uphawu lokungalingani nokuqhathanisa amasethi ezixazululo
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa isibalo bese usibhala ngohlobo lwe-(x−3)².
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngebanga lamanani isikwele esingawathatha, bese ufaka u-x=3 no-x=0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.b: Kungenzeka uguqule u-(x−3)² ≤ 0 waba ngu-x−3 ≤ 0 ngokukhipha isikwele. Ukwenza isikwele kushintsha izimpawu, ngakho awukwazi ukushintsha kanjalo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.c: Leyo yimpendulo ye-"≥ 0," hhayi u-"≤ 0." Isikwele sihlala singu-0 noma ngaphezulu, kodwa ngophawu lokungalingani oluphambene kuhlukile.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.d: Ukufaka u-x=3 kunika u-0 ≤ 0, okusebenzayo. Ucabange ukuthi inkulumo ye-quadratic ihlala iphozithivu, noma awuzange ubheke ngokwehlukana icala lapho i-discriminant ingu-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.explain: x² − 6x + 9 = (x − 3)², futhi isikwele singu-0 noma ngaphezulu. Ngakho ukuze u-(x−3)² ≤ 0 usebenze, u-(x−3)² = 0, okungukuthi, x = 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo ezigcwele u-b, c ukuze isixazululo sika-x² + bx + c ≤ 0 sibe inombolo egcwele eyiphozithivu e-1 kuphela. (|b| ≤ 40)
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qaphela ukuthi u-b no-c babeyini enkulumweni yesinyathelo 1, yenza izinkulumo ezimbalwa zesimo esifanayo, futhi uhlole ukuthi ngayinye iyifomu u-(x−p)² yini.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khulisa u-(x−p)² bese ubhala ukuthi u-b no-c bavezwa kanjani ngokuya ngo-p, bese uzama amanani ahlukile ka-p.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c1: U-b no-c kufanele babe yizinombolo ezigcwele ezinu-|b| ≤ 40.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Inkulumo inephoyinti e-1 kuphela njengesixazululo sayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Le nkulumo ayinaphoyinti e-1 kuphela njengesixazululo sayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.explain: Uma x² + bx + c = (x − p)², bese b = −2p no-c = p². Uma u-p eyinombolo egcwele eyiphozithivu, isixazululo singu-x = p kuphela. (b, c) = (−2, 1), (−4, 4), (−10, 25), njalonjalo konke kuyasebenza.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.prompt: Ezingeni lokungalingani okutholwe ku-x² − 6x + 9 ngokushintsha uphawu lokungalingani kuphela, ≥ 0, > 0, < 0, bhala isethi yesixazululo ngayinye, futhi uchaze ngomugqa owodwa ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlunga ukuthi u-(x−3)² ungaba yinegethivu yini nokuthi ulingana no-0 ku-x muphi.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukungalingani okuthathu ngakunye ngokufaka u-x=3 no-x=0, bese ubhala amasethi esixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uqinisekise ukuthi amasethi esixazululo okungalingani okuthathu ahlukile wonke?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unikeze isizathu sokuthi isikwele singu-0 noma ngaphezulu futhi silingana no-0 ku-x=3 kuphela?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.0: U-(x−3)² uhlala engu-0 noma ngaphezulu futhi ulingana no-0 ku-x=3 kuphela. Ku-≥ 0 zonke izinombolo zangempela, ku-> 0 zonke izinombolo zangempela ngaphandle kuka-x=3, futhi ku-< 0 akukho sixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.1: ≥0: zonke izinombolo zangempela. >0: zonke izinombolo zangempela ezinu-x≠3. <0: akukho sixazululo (isethi engenalutho). Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isikwele asikwazi ukuba yinegethivu futhi singu-0 ku-x=3 kuphela.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.2: < 0 ayinaso isixazululo, > 0 zonke izinombolo ngaphandle kuka-3, futhi ≥ 0 zonke izinombolo zangempela. Isizathu ngukuthi u-(x−3)² ≥ 0, ngokulingana kuphela uma u-x=3.

n-m-h1-ineq-07.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Sohla lwe-x − y
n-m-h1-ineq-07.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni esathola uhla ngokukhipha ukungalingani okubili uhlangothi nohlangothi, ulilungise ngendlela elungile, futhi uhlukanise ukuthi ukubala uhlangothi nohlangothi kuvunyelwe nini ezambeni, emehlukweni, nasemiphumeleni.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.material: USumin wathola "uhla lwe-x−y uma 1<x<3 no-2<y<5" njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuthi umphumela wesixazululo unengqondo yini
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.2: Ukuhlukanisa ukuthi ukubala uhlangothi nohlangothi kuvunyelwe nini
n-m-h1-ineq-07.prereq.0: Izakhiwo eziyisisekelo zokungalingani (ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngenombolo enegethivu kuphikisa uphawu lokungalingani)
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaSumin.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi ukungalingani okuvelayo kunengqondo yini, futhi ulandele indlela eholela kukho emuva.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amanani amaningana ka-x no-y afanelana nezimo, bala u-x − y, futhi uqhathanise nomphumela wesixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.0: Thola uhla lwe-x − y uma 1 < x < 3 …① no-2 < y < 5 …②.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.1: Ukukhipha ② ku-① uhlangothi nohlangothi ezinhlangothini ezifanayo kunika u-1 − 2 < x − y < 3 − 5.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho uhla lwe-x − y ngu-−1 < x − y < −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 ngumugqa wokuqala ongalungile. Ukungalingani okuqonde ohlangothini olufanayo kungengezwa uhlangothi nohlangothi kodwa akumele kukhishwe. Uma u-y emkhulu, u-x−y uba mncane, ngakho umkhawulo ophezulu u-5 luka-y kufanele uye emkhawulweni ophansi luka-x−y. Imigqa 3 no-4 ithatha nje ukubala komugqa 2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.prompt: Bhala uhla olulungile lwe-x − y futhi uchaze ukuthi ulithole kanjani. Bese ufaka ipheya e-1 yamanani ka-x no-y afanelana nezimo futhi uhlole ukuthi umphumela uphakathi kohla.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ungathola kanjani uhla lwe-−y kuqala. Yiluphi inombolo ongaphindaphinda ngayo ukungalingani ka-y?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi u-x no-y basondele kumaphi amanani uma u-x−y emncane kakhulu nalapho emkhulu kakhulu.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.placeholder: isb., Njengoba ..., u-x−y mkhulu kuno-... futhi mncane kuno-.... Ukuhlola: x=..., y=...
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uchaze ngomugqa owodwa ukuthi uthole kanjani u-−4 no-1?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ufake amanani afanelana nezimo ukuhlola ukuthi umphumela uphakathi kohla?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi kungani ukukhipha kungasebenzi (uma u-y emkhulu, u-x−y uba mncane)?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.0: Ukuphindaphinda uhlangothi ngalunye lwe-② ngo-−1 kuphikisa izimpawu zokungalingani, kunika u-−5 < −y < −2. Ukuyengeza ku-① uhlangothi nohlangothi kunika u-1−5 < x−y < 3−2, okungukuthi, −4 < x−y < 1. Ukuhlola: uma x=2, y=3, bese x−y=−1, okuphakathi kohla.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.1: U-x−y mncane kakhulu uma u-x emncane futhi u-y emkhulu, ngakho usondele ku-1−5=−4, futhi mkhulu kakhulu uma u-x emkhulu futhi u-y emncane, ngakho usondele ku-3−2=1. Ngakho −4 < x−y < 1, futhi uma x=1.5, y=4, bese ungu-−2.5, ophakathi kohla.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.2: Ukubuka u-x−y njengo-x + (−y), thola uhla lwe-−y, −5 < −y < −2, futhi wengeze ukuthola u-−4 < x−y < 1. Ukufaka u-x=2.5, y=2.5 kunika u-0, ophakathi kohla.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.prompt: Khetha wonke amacala lapho, ku-a<x<b no-c<y<d, ungabala uhlangothi nohlangothi ukuthola uhla.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ngenketho ngayinye, khetha uhla oluthile lwezinombolo, bala uhlangothi nohlangothi, futhi uqhathanise umphumela namanani angempela.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza uhla oluhlanganisa izinombolo ezinegethivu futhi uhlole ukuthi inani elincane kakhulu lomphumela livela kuphi.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.a: Uhla lwe-xy uma ukuhlobana kuka-x no-y kokubili kuphozithivu
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.b: Ukuthola uhla lwe-x − y ngokukhipha izinhlangothi ezifanayo uhlangothi nohlangothi
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.b: Ukukhipha izinhlangothi ezifanayo uhlangothi nohlangothi kungenza inkulumo ephikisanayo njenge-−1<x−y<−2. Ngokukhipha, kufanele udlule emsebenzini oshintsha uphawu.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.c: Ukuthola uhla lwe-x + y ngokwengeza izinhlangothi ezifanayo uhlangothi nohlangothi
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.d: Ukuthola uhla lwe-xy ngokuphindaphinda uhlangothi nohlangothi ngaphandle kokucabanga ngophawu
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.d: Uma izinombolo ezinegethivu zixutshwe, ama-extremes omphumela ayashintsha. Isibonelo, uma −2<x<1 no-1<y<3, ukuphindaphinda uhlangothi nohlangothi kunika u-−2<xy<3, kodwa ngo-x=−1.9, y=2.9, xy≈−5.5 ungaphandle kwalokho.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.explain: Ukwengeza kungenzeka njalo, futhi ukuphindaphinda uhlangothi nohlangothi kuvunyelwe kuphela uma zonke izinombolo ziphozithivu. Ekukhipheni nasekuphindaphindeni okunezimpawu ezixubile, kufanele ushintshe izimpawu noma uhlukanise amacala futhi uhlole ama-extremes.

n-m-h1-ineq-08.title: Siyini Esinye Isidingo Sokuqinisekisa Inani Labafundi?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.goal: Misa uhlelo lokungalingani olunesimo senombolo egcwele, futhi uma kunamanani amaningi angenzeka, hlukanisa ulwazi oludingekayo ukunquma oyedwa nolwazi olungadingekile.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.material: Sifuna ukuhambisa amapensela kubafundi. Uma sinika amapensela angu-4 umuntu ngamunye, amapensela angu-15 asala. Uma sinika angu-7 ngamunye, bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bathola amapensela angu-7 ngamunye, futhi umfundi wokugcina uthola okungenani ipensela e-1 kodwa hhayi lonke u-7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.thinking.1: Ukusebenzisa isimo senombolo egcwele ukuthola onke amanani angenzeka
n-m-h1-ineq-08.thinking.2: Ukubona ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olunquma inani libe lilodwa
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.prompt: Ake inani labafundi libe ngu-n futhi uveze inani eliphelele lamapensela ngokuya ngo-n. Misa ukungalingani kwenani lamapensela umfundi wokugcina alithola, futhi uthole onke amanani angenzeka ka-n.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.hint.0: Veza inani eliphelele lamapensela ngokuya ngo-n esimweni lapho kunikwa u-4 ngamunye.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi bangaki abafundi abathola amapensela angu-7 ngamunye, khipha amapensela abewathole enanini eliphelele, futhi uveze isabelo somfundi wokugcina njengenkulumo.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.placeholder: isb., Kunamapensela angu-... sekukonke, futhi umfundi wokugcina uthola amapensela angu-..., ngakho ... ≤ n ≤ ...
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Ubhale isimo sokuthi isabelo somfundi wokugcina singu-1 okungenani futhi ngaphansi kuka-7 (u-6 ubuningi) njengokungalingani?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.selfAssess.2: Usebenzise isimo sokuthi u-n uyinombolo yemvelo?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.0: Kunamapensela angu-4n+15 sekukonke. Umfundi wokugcina uthola amapensela angu-4n+15−7(n−1)=22−3n, futhi 1≤22−3n≤6. Bese 16/3≤n≤7, futhi njengoba u-n eyinombolo yemvelo, kunabafundi abangu-6 noma abangu-7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.1: Uma inani labafundi lingu-n, kunamapensela angu-4n+15. Kunabafundi abangu-n−1 abathola u-7 ngamunye, ngakho isabelo somfundi wokugcina singu-22−3n, futhi njengoba lokhu kungu-1 okungenani futhi u-6 ubuningi, u-n ungu-6 noma u-7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.2: Njengoba u-4n+15 − 7(n−1) ungu-1 okungenani futhi u-6 ubuningi, u-22−3n uphakathi kuka-1 no-6. Njengoba n≤7 no-n≥5.33..., n=6 noma 7 kuyenzeka.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.prompt: Khetha lonke ulwazi olunquma phakathi kwabafundi abangu-6 nabafundi abangu-7. (Cabanga ngolwazi olufunda ngolusha, ngaphandle kwalokho osekwaziwa.)
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bala inani eliphelele lamapensela nesabelo somfundi wokugcina kubafundi abangu-6 nabafundi abangu-7, ubhale ethebuleni.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ethebuleni, thola ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezinamanani ahlukile emacaleni amabili.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.b: Iqiniso lokuthi ukunikeza u-4 ngamunye kushiya u-15
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.b: Lolu ulwazi osekuvele lusenkingeni. Bobabili abafundi abangu-6 nabangu-7 banelisa lesi simo.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.c: Iqiniso lokuthi wonke umuntu ngaphandle komfundi wokugcina uthola amapensela angu-7
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.c: Leli yiqiniso elivele liqukethwe enkingeni. Lisebenza ngokulinganayo kubo bobabili abafundi abangu-6 nabangu-7, ngakho alikwazi ukubahlukanisa.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.explain: Ngabafundi abangu-6 kunamapensela angu-39 futhi umfundi wokugcina uthola u-4; ngabafundi abangu-7 kunamapensela angu-43 futhi umfundi wokugcina uthola u-1. Ukwazi inani eliphelele noma isabelo somfundi wokugcina kunquma kube okukodwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi ufunda ukuthi umfundi wokugcina wathola amapensela angu-4. Nquma inani labafundi, futhi uhlole inani eliphelele lamapensela ngezimo zombili.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi uthola siphi isibalo ngokubeka inkulumo yesabelo somfundi wokugcina ngokuya ngo-n silingane no-4.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Bala inani eliphelele lamapensela nge-n oyitholile, futhi uhlole futhi izimo ezimbili zokunikeza u-7 ngamunye no-4 ngamunye.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.placeholder: isb., 22−3n=..., ngakho n=... abafundi namapensela angu-.... Ukuhlola: ...
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.0: Isabelo somfundi wokugcina 22−3n=4, ngakho n=6 abafundi. Amapensela: 4×6+15=39. Ukuhlola: ukunikeza abafundi abangu-5 amapensela angu-7 ngamunye kusebenzisa u-35, ngakho umfundi wokugcina uthola u-4; ukunikeza u-4 ngamunye kusebenzisa u-24 futhi kusala u-15.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.1: Kunabafundi abangu-6. Kunamapensela angu-39; abafundi abangu-5 bathola u-7 ngamunye ngo-35, futhi angu-4 asele yisabelo somfundi wokugcina. Ukunikeza abafundi abangu-6 u-4 ngamunye kushiya u-15, ngakho zombili izimo ziyafanelana.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.2: Ukuxazulula u-22−3n=4 kunika u-n=6, ngakho kunabafundi abangu-6 namapensela angu-39. Ngihlolile: 7×5+4=39 no-4×6+15=39.

n-m-h1-ineq-09.title: |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3: Ingabe Kunesixazululo? Izinhlobo Ezimbili Zobufakazi
n-m-h1-ineq-09.goal: Qhathanisa ukuhlola okwenziwe ngokufaka amanani ambalwa nobufakazi obuchazwe usebenzisa ibanga emgqeni wezinombolo, futhi uhumushe isethi yesixazululo eyenziwe isamba samanani aphelele ngokobanga.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.material:
'Abafundi ababili ngamunye banikeze ubufakazi mayelana nokuthi ukungalingani u-|x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3 kunesixazululo yini.

UArin: Ngifake u-x = −1, 0, 1, 2, 3. Izamba zingu-4, 4, 4, 4, 4 ngokulandelana. Akukho elingu-3 noma ngaphansi, ngakho akukho sixazululo.

UDohyeon: U-|x+1| yibanga phakathi kuka-x no-−1 emgqeni wezinombolo, futhi u-|x−3| yibanga phakathi kuka-x no-3. Ibanga phakathi kuka-−1 no-3 ngu-4, ngakho noma u-x ekuphi, isamba samabanga amabili asikwazi ukuba ngaphansi kuka-4. Ngakho akukho sixazululo.'
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.1: Ukufunda inani eliphelele njengebanga emgqeni wezinombolo
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.2: Ukuhumusha isethi yesixazululo yophawu lokungalingani oluhlukile enkulumweni efanayo
n-m-h1-ineq-09.prereq.0: Incazelo yenani eliphelele (ibanga phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili emgqeni wezinombolo)
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo esilungile mayelana nobufakazi bubo bobabili abafundi.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi amanani ka-x uArin awahloliwe ayizinombolo zohlobo luni, nokuthi mangaki amanani angahlolwanga asele.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi incazelo kaDohyeon isebenza noma u-x ekuphi, noma ingasetshenziswa kuphela ngemva kokulungisa u-x o-1.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.a: Ubufakazi buka-Arin kuphela obuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho sixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.a: Ukufaka izinombolo ezigcwele ezimbalwa kungukuhlola nje. Izinombolo zangempela ezingapheli azihloliwe.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.b: Bobabili ubufakazi buqinisekisa ukuthi akukho sixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi ukufaka amanani amahlanu kuchaza wonke u-x. Ku-x ongaphandle kwamanani ahloliwe, asikazi.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.c: Ubufakazi buka-Dohyeon kuphela obuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho sixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.d: Akukho nobunye ubufakazi obuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho sixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.d: Ubufakazi buka-Dohyeon, achazwe ngebanga, bukhombisa ukuthi isamba singu-4 okungenani ku-x ngamunye, ngakho buyanquma.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.explain: UDohyeon wakhombisa ukuthi, noma u-x ekuphi, isamba samabanga amabili singu-4 okungenani, ibanga phakathi kuka-−1 no-3. Lena incazelo yazo zonke izinombolo zangempela u-x. Amanani ka-Arin alungile, kodwa amanani amahlanu kuphela awakwazi ukusitshela ngabanye u-x.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.prompt: Sifuna ukuthola isethi yesixazululo ka-|x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 4 usebenzisa indlela kaDohyeon. Khetha elilungile.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Maka u-−1 no-3 emgqeni wezinombolo, futhi uqhathanise ukuthi isamba samabanga amabili singani uma u-x emaphakathi ngqo kwamaphoyinti amabili nalapho u-x esesokudla sika-3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Humusha, njengamabanga emgqeni wezinombolo, ukuthi kungani izamba ethebuleni luka-Arin zazifana zonke.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.a: Eziphetheni ezimbili, u-−1 no-3, isamba nasso singu-4 ngqo, ngakho zanelisa u-"≤ 4." Uphuthelwe umngcele ophawini lokungalingani oluhlanganisa ukulingana.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.c: Akusiyo eziphetheni ezimbili kuphela lapho isamba singu-4. Njengethebuleni luka-Arin, isamba singu-4 nezinombolo eziphakathi.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.d: Uthuthele umphumela we-"≤ 3" kwinkinga edlule njengoba injalo. Uma kukhona u-x onesamba esingu-4 ngqo, u-"≤ 4" unezixazululo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.explain: Uma u-x ephakathi kuka-−1 no-3 (kuhlanganise neziphetho zombili), isamba samabanga amabili singu-4 ngqo, ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili. Ngaphandle kwalokho, sikhulu kuno-4. Ngakho isethi yesixazululo ngu-−1 ≤ x ≤ 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuqhathanisa ukuthi kungani indlela ka-Arin (ukufaka amanani) ingakwazi ukuqinisekisa "akukho sixazululo," nokuthi kungani indlela kaDohyeon ingakwazi.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa inani lamanani uArin awahloliwe nenani lazo zonke izinombolo zangempela.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi isizathu sebanga uDohyeon asisebenzisile singasetshenziswa noma u-x engakamiswa yini.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.placeholder: isb., U-Arin wahlola kuphela ..., ngakho ..., futhi u-Dohyeon ..., ngakho ...
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ukhombe ukuthi kukhona u-x ongaphandle kwamanani ahloliwe?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubhale ukuthi kungani ubufakazi buka-Dohyeon busebenza ku-x ngamunye?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uxhumanise nokuthi umbono ofanayo ungafunda isethi yesixazululo ye-≤ 4?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.0: U-Arin wafaka kuphela izinombolo ezigcwele ezinhlanu, ngakho akakwazanga ukuhlola izinombolo eziphakathi noma u-x ezihleni ezinye. UDohyeon wakhombisa ukuthi njengoba ibanga phakathi kuka-−1 no-3 emgqeni wezinombolo lingu-4, isamba samabanga amabili sihlala singu-4 okungenani, futhi lokhu kusebenza kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela u-x.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.1: Ithebula libheka amanani ambalwa ka-x kuphela, ngakho ezinye izinombolo zangempela ziyasala (isb., 0.5, 100). Ukucabanga ngebanga, isamba sihlala singu-4 okungenani, ngakho kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi akukho sixazululo nganoma yimuphi u-x.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.2: Ukufaka amanani ambalwa akusiyo ubufakazi. Uma, njengoDohyeon, usho ukuthi isamba samabanga amabili singu-okungenani ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili, u-4, kuchaza onke u-x ngasikhathi sinye.

n-m-h1-geo-01.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Sebanga Phakathi Kwemigqa Emibili Efanayo
n-m-h1-geo-01.goal: Esixazululweni esisebenzisa ifomula yebanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili efanayo, thola futhi ulungise umugqa wokuqala ongalungile, bese uhlola usebenzisa ibanga elisuka ephoyintini liye emugqeni.
n-m-h1-geo-01.material: Ngezansi isixazululo sikaSeojin sebanga phakathi kwemigqa x+2y−3=0 no-2x+4y+8=0. (Funda u-x² njengo-"x owenziwe isikwele," √5 njengo-"impande yesikwele ka-5," no-−3 njengo-"negative 3.")
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ngenye indlela (ibanga phakathi kwephoyinti nomugqa)
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sikaSeojin ongalungile.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi izinombolo ezingaphambi kuka-x no-y ziyini ezibalweni ezimbili ezivela efomulini emgqeni 2.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola leso simo emigqeni emibili uSeojin ayibhale, eyodwa ngesikhathi.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.0: Imigqa emibili x+2y−3=0 no-2x+4y+8=0 inomthambeka ofanayo, ngakho ifana.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.1: Ibanga phakathi kwemigqa efanayo ax+by+c₁=0 no-ax+by+c₂=0 lingu-|c₁−c₂|/√(a²+b²).
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.2: Kumugqa wokuqala a=1, b=2, c₁=−3, futhi kumugqa wesibili c₂=8.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.explain: Kuphutha emgqeni 3. Ifomula emgqeni 2 ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma ama-coefficient ka-x no-y ezibalweni ezimbili efana, kodwa umugqa wesibili unama-coefficient angu-2 no-4 ku-x no-y, ahluka kumugqa wokuqala, futhi u-8 uyithemu elingaguquki laleso sibalo. Umugqa 4 ungukubala okulandela umugqa 3, ngakho inani lawo alilungile. Ukuhlukanisa isibalo sesibili ngo-2 kunikeza u-x+2y+4=0, futhi ibanga lingu-|−3−4|/√5=7/√5.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa ingxenye engalungile bese uthola ibanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili. Bese ukhetha iphoyinti emugqeni wokuqala, ubale ngokwehlukile ibanga laleli phoyinti kumugqa wesibili, bese ubhala ukuthi uthola inani elifanayo yini.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ungasishintsha kanjani isibalo sesibili ukuze ifomula isetshenziswe.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iphoyinti emugqeni wokuqala bese ubhala ngokwehlukile ifomula yebanga phakathi kwephoyinti nomugqa.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.placeholder: isib., Ukushintsha isibalo sesibili sibe ngu-... kunikeza ..., ngakho ibanga lingu-...
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe wenze ama-coefficient omugqa wesibili afane nowokuqala bese uqhathanisa amathemu angaguquki?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhethe iphoyinti futhi wahlola ukuthi inani elivela kwenye indlela lilingana nenani lokuqala?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi yisiphi isimo okufanele sihlolwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ifomula?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuhlukanisa isibalo sesibili ngo-2 kunikeza u-x+2y+4=0, ngakho ama-coefficient ka-x no-y aba afana nomugqa wokuqala. Khona ibanga lingu-|−3−4|/√5=7/√5. Hlola: ibanga elisuka ephoyintini (3,0) emugqeni wokuqala liye ku-2x+4y+8=0 lingu-|6+8|/√20=14/(2√5)=7/√5, okufanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukufanisa ama-coefficient, ngisike isibalo sesibili saba uhhafu futhi ngibhala u-x+2y+4=0. Ibanga lingu-7√5/5, cishe 3.13. Ukubala ibanga 14/√20 kusuka ku-(3,0) kuya emugqeni wesibili kunikeza inani elifanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isixazululo esisebenzisa kuphela ibanga phakathi kwephoyinti nomugqa nasso siyasebenza uma sinikeza inani elifanayo.

n-m-h1-geo-03.title: Hambisa Futhi Ubonise: Kuthiwani Uma Sishintshanisa Ukulandelana?
n-m-h1-geo-03.goal: Hlola ngesibonelo ukuthi ukuhlanganisa ukuhambisa nokubonisa kungaphumela ezimpumelelweni ezihlukile uma ukulandelana kushintshaniswa, futhi uthole ngesibalo isimo lapho ukushintshanisa ukulandelana kunikeza umphumela ofanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.material: Iphoyinti P endizeni yezixhumanisi lihanjiswa ngezinguquko ezimbili. Ushintsho T lukuhambisa ngo-m ohlangothini luka-x nango-n ohlangothini luka-y, futhi ushintsho S lukubonisa ngaphesheya kwe-x-axis. Uzoqhathanisa u-"T bese u-S" no-"S bese u-T."
n-m-h1-geo-03.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isibonelo e-1 sibe yisibalo esijwayelekile
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.prompt: Lungisa isibikezelo sakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvezwa ulwazi olusha mayelana nokwenzeka uma ukulandelana kushintshaniswa.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala bala ukulandelana okubili ngokwehlukile bese ubhala phansi izixhumanisi zephoyinti.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi yiyiphi ingxenye yokuhambisa ehlobene nesixhumanisi esishintsha uphawu ngaphansi kokubonisa.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Cabanga ukuhambisa (+1,+4) nokubonisa ngaphesheya kwe-x-axis kusetshenziswa ephoyintini P(3,2) ngezindlela ezimbili ezihlukile zokulandelana, kunikeza amaphoyinti amabili P₁ no-P₂.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucabanga ukuthi u-P₁ no-P₂ liyiphoyinti elifanayo?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ake sibale ngqo. Ukuhambisa kuqala: (3,2)→(4,6)→(4,−6). Ukubonisa kuqala: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(4,2). Amaphoyinti amabili ahlukile.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Kulokhu, shintsha ukuhambisa kube ngu-(+5,0). Iphoyinti lisaphethwe u-P(3,2).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Imiphumela yokulandelana okubili izohluka kulokhu nakho?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuhambisa kuqala: (3,2)→(8,2)→(8,−2). Ukubonisa kuqala: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(8,−2). Kulokhu ziyafana. Okushintshile ukuthi inani lokuhamba ngaphezulu laliyi-0.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sifuna ukuthola ukuhambisa lapho ukushintshanisa ukulandelana kunikeza umphumela ofanayo. Abangakhethwa ngu-(2,3), (4,0), (0,5), (0,0).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yikuphi kwalokhu okunikeza umphumela ofanayo kuwo wonke amaphoyinti uma ukulandelana kushintshaniswa?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukubonisa ngaphesheya kwe-x-axis kushintsha uphawu lwesixhumanisi sika-y, ngakho ukuhamba ohlangothini luka-y kufanele kube ngu-0. (4,0) no-(0,0) bafeza lokhu, futhi u-(0,0) ungukuhambisa okungahambisi lutho.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.reflect: Uma uqhathanisa ukuthi kungani imiphumela yahluka esibonelweni esisodwa futhi yafana kwesinye, ungabona ukuthi ukuthi ukulandelana kwezinguquko kubalulekile yini kuncike ku-"yini ehanjiswayo." Ngaphambi kokunquma u-"njalo kuyafana/kuyahluka" ngokubala okukodwa noma okubili, kufanele uhlole ngesibalo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala njengezibalo imiphumela yokusebenzisa u-"T bese u-S" no-"S bese u-T" ephoyintini (x,y), bese ubhala isimo ku-m no-n ukuze imiphumela emibili ilingane.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kulandelana ngakunye, bhala izixhumanisi eziphakathi isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa izixhumanisi zika-x nezika-y zamaphoyinti amabili okugcina ngokwehlukile.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.placeholder: isib., T bese u-S kunikeza ..., S bese u-T kunikeza ..., ukuze zilingane ...
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi isixhumanisi sika-y siba yisiphi isibalo ezindleleni ezimbili zokulandelana?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqinisekise ukuthi inani lika-m alithinti isimo?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uxhumanise izibonelo zezinombolo ezingenhla nezibalo ezijwayelekile?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.0: T bese u-S: (x,y)→(x+m,y+n)→(x+m,−y−n). S bese u-T: (x,y)→(x,−y)→(x+m,−y+n). Ukuze izixhumanisi zika-y −y−n no-−y+n zilingane, u-n kufanele abe ngu-0. U-m angaba yinoma yiliphi inani.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma ubonisa kuqala uthola u-(x+m, n−y), futhi uma uhambisa kuqala uthola u-(x+m, −y−n). Ukuze izixhumanisi zika-y zilingane, n=−n, ngakho kuphela uma u-n engu-0. Uma uhamba ngokuvundlile kuphela, ukushintshanisa ukulandelana kunikeza umphumela ofanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, cabanga ukuthi sisebenzisa ukubonisa ngaphesheya kwe-y-axis esikhundleni sika-S. Yini edingekayo ukuze ukuhambisa (m,n) nokubonisa kwe-y-axis kunikeze umphumela ofanayo uma ukulandelana kushintshaniswa?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kulokhu, kuqala nquma ukuthi yisiphi isixhumanisi esishintsha uphawu.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa izixhumanisi ezivelayo zokulandelana okubili ngendlela efanayo nasesinyathelweni esidlule.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.b: Uthuthele umphumela wokubonisa kwe-x-axis ngqo ekubonisweni kwe-y-axis. Hlola futhi ukuthi yisiphi isixhumanisi esishintsha uphawu.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.o.c: Njalo ziyafana noma ngabe u-m no-n bangobani.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.c: Ukubonisa kushintsha uphawu lwesixhumanisi e-1, ngakho ukuhamba ohlangothini lwalowo sixhumanisi kuthinta ukulandelana.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.explain: Ukubonisa kwe-y-axis kushintsha uphawu lwesixhumanisi sika-x. Ukuhambisa ngo-(x+m, y+n) bese kubonisa kunikeza u-(−x−m, y+n), futhi ukubonisa bese kuhambisa kunikeza u-(−x+m, y+n), ngakho kuyafana kuphela uma m=0.

n-m-h1-geo-04.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Sephoyinti Elibonisiwe Ngaphesheya Komugqa
n-m-h1-geo-04.goal: Esixazululweni sokuthola ukubonisa kwephoyinti ngaphesheya komugqa, thola futhi ulungise umugqa wokuqala ongalungile, bese wahlulela ukuthi yikuphi ukuhlola okungabamba impendulo engalungile.
n-m-h1-geo-04.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaDoyun sokuthola izixhumanisi zephoyinti B, ukubonisa kwephoyinti A(5,0) ngaphesheya komugqa y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.1: Ukuhumusha ngokulungile izimo (maphakathi, ukubambana) zibe yizibalo
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.2: Ukuqhathanisa ukuthi indlela yokuhlola ibamba iphutha yini
n-m-h1-geo-04.prereq.0: Umphumela wemithambeka uma imigqa emibili ibambana
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sikaDoyun oyaphosa.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi ubudlelwano obuphi busebenza phakathi kwama-slope emigqa emibili ephikisanayo ye-perpendicular.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.1: Phindaphinda i-slope emgqeni 3 nge-slope yomugqa u-y=2x futhi uhlole ukuthi lobo budlelwano buyasebenza yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.1: Iphoyinti eliphakathi ((5+p)/2, q/2) lengxenye u-AB lise-lineni u-y=2x, ngakho q/2=2·(5+p)/2, okungukuthi, q=2p+10.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.2: Umugqa u-AB uyi-perpendicular emgqeni u-y=2x, ngakho i-slope ka-AB ngu-−2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.4: Ukuxazulula izibalo ezimbili ndawonye kunika u-p=0, q=10, ngakho B(0,10).
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.explain: Kwaphosa emgqeni 3. Uma imigqa emibili iyi-perpendicular, umphumela wama-slope awo ngu-−1, ngakho ukuze umphumela nge-slope engu-2 ka-y=2x ube ngu-−1, i-slope ka-AB kufanele ibe ngu-−1/2. Awukwazi nje ukushintsha uphawu. Imigqa 4 no-5 ilandela emgqeni 3.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ophosile bese uthola amakhodi ephoyinti elibonakaliswe u-B. Bhala nokuthi yiyiphi i-slope okufanele isetshenziswe.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-slope yomugqa u-y=2x bese uthola inombolo ephindaphinda nayo inika u-−1.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.1: Usebenzisa leyo slope, misa ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kuka-q no-p, bese uyixazulula ndawonye nesibalo esivela esimweni sephoyinti eliphakathi.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.placeholder: isb., Njengoba beyi-perpendicular, i-slope ka-AB ngu-..., futhi ukuxazulula ndawonye kunika ...
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ubhale kahle isimo se-perpendicular njengomphumela wama-slope = −1?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uhlole ukuthi iphoyinti olitholile linelisa kokubili isimo sephoyinti eliphakathi nesimo se-perpendicular?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi iliphi isimo iphoyinti likaDoyun (0,10) eliphula?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.0: Uma beyi-perpendicular, umphumela wama-slope ngu-−1, ngakho ku-slope engu-2 ka-y=2x, i-slope ka-AB kufanele ibe ngu-−1/2. Kusuka ku-q/(p−5)=−1/2 sithola u-p+2q=5, futhi ukuxazulula ndawonye no-q=2p+10 kunika u-p=−3, q=4. Iphoyinti elibonakaliswe ngu-(−3,4), futhi iphoyinti eliphakathi (1,2) lise-y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.1: Ukubhala i-slope njengo-−2 kwaphosa. Uma beyi-perpendicular, umphumela ngu-−1, ngakho i-slope ka-AB ngu-−1/2. Ukuxazulula ngaleyo ndlela kunika u-B(−3,4). Ukuhlola: iphoyinti eliphakathi (1,2) lise-y=2x, futhi i-slope ka-AB ngu-4/(−8)=−1/2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.prompt: Yikuphi ukuhlola okuveza ukuthi impendulo kaDoyun (0,10) iphosile? (Iphoyinti likaDoyun linelisa isimo sephoyinti eliphakathi uDoyun asimisile.)
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sebenzisa ukuhlola ngakunye ngqo ephoyinteni likaDoyun (0,10) futhi ubone ukuthi lidlula yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sho ukuthi isimo esiphi ukuhlola okuhlulekayo okuhlola.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.a: Hlola ukuthi iphoyinti eliphakathi lengxenye u-AB lise-lineni u-y=2x yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.a: Iphoyinti likaDoyun lakhiwa kusuka kuleli simo, ngakho lokhu kuhlola kudlula njalo. Udinga ukuhlola esinye isimo.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.b: Hlola ukuthi amabanga asuka ku-A nasuka ku-B aya emgqeni u-y=2x alingana yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.b: Leli nani lilingana kumaphoyinti amabili, kodwa iphoyinti likaDoyun nalo lidlula kuko (bobabili bangu-2√5). Udinga ukubheka ngokwehlukana isiqondiso somugqa u-AB.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.c: Hlola ukuthi isiqondiso somugqa u-AB siyi-perpendicular emgqeni u-y=2x yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.d: Hlola ukuthi u-B uyiphoyinti elihlukile ku-A yini.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.d: (0,10) liyiphoyinti elihlukile ku-A, ngakho lokhu kuhlola akukhiphi lutho.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.explain: Ku-(0,10), iphoyinti eliphakathi (2.5,5) lise-y=2x, futhi amabanga asuka ku-A no-B aya emgqeni womabili ngu-2√5, alingana, ngakho a no-b badlula. Kodwa i-direction vector ka-AB, (−5,10), nesiqondiso somugqa, (1,2), kunika u-(−5)·1+10·2=15≠0, ngakho abayi-perpendicular. Iphoyinti elibonakaliswe kufanele linelise kokubili "iphoyinti eliphakathi lise-lineni" no-"umugqa u-AB uyi-perpendicular emgqeni."

n-m-h1-geo-06.title: Ukukhipha Izibalo Zezindilinga Ezimbili Kunike Umugqa
n-m-h1-geo-06.goal: Wahlulele isisho sokuthi umugqa otholwa ngokukhipha izibalo zezindilinga ezimbili udlula emaphoyintini lapho izindilinga zihlangana khona, futhi ubhale ukuthi ungahlola kanjani ukuthi zihlangana ngempela.
n-m-h1-geo-06.material: USeoa wakhipha izibalo zezindilinga ezimbili u-x²+y²=4 no-(x−5)²+y²=4 uhlangothi nohlangothi ukuthola u-10x−25=0, okungukuthi, x=5/2, futhi wabhala, "Izindilinga ezimbili zihlangana emaphoyintini asemgqeni u-x=5/2."
n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa umphumela ovela ezibalweni nokuba khona kwangempela
n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.2: Ukwahlulela indawo ehlobene usebenzisa ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo nama-radius
n-m-h1-geo-06.prereq.1: Indawo ehlobene yezindilinga ezimbili (ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo nama-radius)
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.prompt: Ungawuhlulela kanjani isiphetho sikaSeoa, "Izindilinga ezimbili zihlangana emaphoyintini asemgqeni u-x=5/2"?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x=5/2 kwesinye sezibalo ezimbili zokuqala.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi izindilinga ezimbili zikuphi empeleni, usebenzisa izikhungo nama-radius azo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Umugqa uvele ekukhipheni izibalo, ngakho amaphoyinti okuhlangana asemgqeni.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.a: Uphuthelwe ukuthi umugqa otholwe ngokukhipha "yindawo lapho amaphoyinti okuhlangana ayoba khona, uma izindilinga zihlangana" kuphela.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.b: Kulungile. Izindilinga ezimbili zinama-radius alinganayo, ngakho zihlala zihlangana.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.b: Noma ngama-radius alinganayo, izindilinga azihlangani uma izikhungo zazo zikude.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.c: Akulungile. Sithole umugqa, kodwa ukuthi izindilinga ezimbili zihlangana ngempela kufanele kuhlolwe ngokwehlukana.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.d: Akulungile. Akumele ukhiphe izibalo zezindilinga ezimbili.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.d: Ukukhipha izibalo kuyikubala okuvumelekile. Inkinga ukuthi umphumela uhunyushwa kanjani.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka u-x=5/2 esibalweni sendilinga kunika u-y²=4−25/4<0, ngakho akukho u-y wangempela. Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-5, likhulu kunesamba sama-radius, u-4, ngakho izindilinga ezimbili azihlangani. Umugqa ovela ekukhipheni izibalo usho kuphela "uma zihlangana, amaphoyinti okuhlangana asemgqeni."
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala okungenani indlela e-1 yokuhlola ukuthi izindilinga ezimbili zihlangana yini, futhi ubhale ukuthi inika muphi umphumela uma isetshenziswa kule nkinga.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi uthola siphi isibalo ku-y uma ufaka inani luka-x elitholwe ngokukhipha esibalweni sokuqala.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala isikhungo nobubanzi bendilinga ngayinye bese uqhathanisa nebanga phakathi kwezikhungo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uzame ukufaka umugqa otholwe ngokukhipha esibalweni sendilinga?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uqhathanise ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-5, nesamba sama-radius, u-4?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungachaza ukuthi "sithole umugqa" no-"kunephoyinti lokuhlangana" kusho izinto ezihlukile?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.model.0: Ukufaka u-x=5/2 ku-x²+y²=4 kunika u-y²=4−25/4=−9/4, onegethivu, ngakho akukho u-y wangempela. Ngakho azikho amaphoyinti okuhlangana futhi izindilinga ezimbili azihlangani. Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-5, ukuba likhulu kunesamba sama-radius, u-4, kuholela esiphethweni esifanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.model.1: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo (0,0) no-(5,0) ngu-5, futhi isamba sama-radius ngu-4. Ibanga likhulu kunesamba, ngakho azihlangani. Umugqa ovela ekukhipheni izibalo ngumugqa osebenzisa uma ucabanga ukuthi ziyahlangana.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi uthola umugqa ngokukhipha bese uphinde uhlole. Khetha wonke amapheya ezindilinga alandelayo anephoyinti okungenani e-1 elivamile.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.hint.0: Thola ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo zepheya ngalinye.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.r.b: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-3, likhulu kunesamba sama-radius, u-2, ngakho azihlangani.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.r.c: Indilinga encane iphakathi ngokuphelele kwendilinga enkulu (ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo 1 < umehluko wama-radius 3).
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.explain: a: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-4, liphakathi komehluko wama-radius, u-1, nesamba, u-5, ngakho zihlangana emaphoyintini amabili. d: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo, u-1, lilingana nomehluko wama-radius, u-1, ngakho ziyathintana ephoyinteni e-1 (2,0). Ku-b, ibanga u-3 likhulu kunesamba u-2, futhi ku-c, ibanga u-1 lincane kunomehluko u-3, ngakho azinaphoyinti elivamile.

n-m-h1-geo-07.title: Ukuchaza Isibalo Somugqa We-Tangent Ngaphandle Kwefomula
n-m-h1-geo-07.goal: Kumngani osebenzisa kuphela ifomula yomugqa we-tangent ephoyinteni endilingeni, chaza futhi ukuthi kungani isibalo somugqa we-tangent siphuma, usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi i-tangent iyi-perpendicular ku-radius.
n-m-h1-geo-07.material: UHarin wakhumbula kuphela umphumela wefomula, "umugqa we-tangent endilingeni u-x²+y²=25 ephoyinteni (3,4) ngu-3x+4y=25." Ufuna ukuchazela umngani wakhe uJiho, obuze ukuthi kungani. (Funda u-x² njengo-"x isikwele.")
n-m-h1-geo-07.thinking.1: Ukubhala kabusha okuqukethwe okufanayo ngezinga lomlaleli
n-m-h1-geo-07.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi komugqa we-tangent ne-radius yendilinga
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.prompt: Liyiphi iqiniso elibaluleke kakhulu ekuchazeni ukuthi kungani lesi sibalo somugqa we-tangent silungile?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba ingxenye exhuma iphoyinti lokuthinta (3,4) nesikhungo (0,0), nomugqa we-tangent, emdwebweni owodwa.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umugqa we-tangent kufanele wenze ingeli enjani nale ngxenye ukuze ungangeni ngaphakathi kwendilinga.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.a: Umugqa we-tangent ngumugqa ongaphezulu kude nesikhungo sendilinga.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.a: Umugqa we-tangent ngumugqa ohlangana nendilinga endaweni e-1; akuyona umugqa okude kakhulu nesikhungo (kunemigqa emabangeni angapheli amakhulu).
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.b: Umugqa we-tangent udlula ephoyinteni eliphakathi lengxenye exhuma iphoyinti lokuthinta nemvelaphi.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.b: Umugqa we-tangent ephoyinteni lokuthinta udlula ephoyinteni lokuthinta. Iphoyinti eliphakathi alise-tangent.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.c: Umugqa we-tangent unayo i-slope efanayo nomugqa oxhuma iphoyinti lokuthinta nemvelaphi.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.c: Umugqa oxhuma iphoyinti lokuthinta nemvelaphi ungumugqa oqukethe i-radius, futhi i-tangent iyi-perpendicular kuwo. Uma ama-slope ayelingana, i-tangent yayizodlula ngaphakathi kwendilinga.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.d: Umugqa we-tangent uyi-perpendicular ku-radius ephoyinteni lokuthinta.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa we-tangent endilingeni uyi-perpendicular ku-radius ephoyinteni lokuthinta. I-slope ye-radius ingu-4/3, ngakho i-slope ye-tangent ingu-−3/4, futhi ukwenza lula umugqa odlula ephoyinteni (3,4) kunika u-3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.prompt: Yiba nguHarin bese uchazela uJiho ngemisho engu-3 kuya ku-4. Ungasebenzisi ifomula; bhala ukuthi u-3x+4y=25 uphuma kanjani usebenzisa i-slope ye-radius ne-slope yomugqa we-tangent.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuthola i-slope yengxenye exhuma iphoyinti lokuthinta nesikhungo.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-slope emigqa ephikisanayo ye-perpendicular ukuthola i-slope ye-tangent, bese ubhala isibalo kusuka ephoyinteni nasekuslopeni.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.placeholder: isb., I-slope ye-radius exhuma isikhungo (0,0) sendilinga neliphoyinti lokuthinta (3,4) ngu-...
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uchaze usebenzisa amaqiniso e-geometry ngaphandle kwefomula?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ubhale ukuthi usuke kanjani ku-slope ye-radius uye ku-slope yomugqa we-tangent?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.model.0: I-slope ye-radius exhuma isikhungo (0,0) nephoyinti lokuthinta (3,4) ngu-4/3. Umugqa we-tangent uyi-perpendicular ku-radius ephoyinteni lokuthinta, ngakho i-slope yawo ingu-−3/4. Ukwenza lula umugqa one-slope engu-−3/4 odlula ephoyinteni (3,4) kunika u-3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.model.1: Jiho, umugqa we-tangent uhlangana ne-radius ngengeli elungile ephoyinteni lokuthinta. I-slope ye-radius iyi-ingxenye ezine kwezintathu, ngakho i-slope ye-tangent iyi-negative three fourths. Ukwenza lula u-y−4=−(3/4)(x−3) kunika u-3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.prompt: Ake sihlole ukuthi le ncazelo isebenza kwezinye izindilinga nazo yini. Endilingeni u-x²+y²=r² (u-r uyinombolo egcwele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-13), khetha iphoyinti lenombolo egcwele (a,b) elinawo womabili amakhodi angengo-zero, bese wenza umugqa we-tangent u-ax+by=r². Bhala u-(a, b, r) abangu-4 abahlukile.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ibanga elisuka kumvelaphi liye emgqeni u-ax+by=r² ngokuya ngo-a, b, r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenza ukuthi u-a²+b² kufanele abe nani liphi ukuze leli banga lilingane ne-radius u-r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.ok.k1: Zonke ziyizinombolo eziphelele ebangeni elivunyelwe, futhi u-a no-b abayona u-0.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k1: U-r kumele abe yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-13, futhi u-a no-b kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele ezingezona u-0.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k2: Indawo ayisemjikelezweni. Kule ndawo, isibalo somugqa we-tangent asibhalwa ngale ndlela.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.ok.k3: Umugqa ax+by=r² uqhele ku-origin ngebanga r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k3: Umugqa ax+by=r² awuqhele ku-origin ngebanga r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.explain: Ibanga phakathi komugqa ax+by=r² ne-origin ngu-r²/√(a²+b²), futhi ukuze kube ngumugqa we-tangent lokhu kumele kulingane no-radius r. Khona a²+b²=r², okungukuthi, indawo (a,b) kumele ibe semjikelezweni. isb., (3,4,5), (6,8,10), (5,12,13).

n-m-h1-geo-08.title: Izimpendulo Ezintathu Zomugqa Ocabangelwe: Ingabe Indawo Eyodwa Ingazihlunga?
n-m-h1-geo-08.goal: Ukukhetha impendulo elungile phakathi kwemigqa ehlukile enikezwe abafundi abathathu, cabanga indawo eyodwa njengokuhlola, bese uhlulela ukuthi lokho kuhlola kuyobufakazi obwanele yini.
n-m-h1-geo-08.material: Abafundi abathathu bathole izimpendulo ezihlukile zomugqa otholwa ngokucabangela umugqa 2x+y=3 ngaphesheya komugqa y=−x. UMinsu uthole x+2y+3=0, uJia uthole x+2y−3=0, noHajun uthole 2x+y+3=0. Abathathu banquma ukuhlola ukuthi indawo (1,1) emugqeni wokuqala, eba ngu-(−1,−1) ngemva kokucabangela, isemugqeni omusha yini.
n-m-h1-geo-08.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho okuhlungwa ukuhlola nalokho okungakwazi
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha bonke abafundi abamugqa wabo udlula endaweni (−1,−1).
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x=−1, y=−1 kusibalo somfundi ngamunye bese ubala ukuthi silingana no-0 yini.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.r.d: Faka (−1,−1) ngqo kusibalo ngasinye bese ubala.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.explain: UMinsu: −1−2+3=0 noHajun: −2−1+3=0, ngakho bobabili badlula kuyo. UJia unika u-−6, ngakho akadluli.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.prompt: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi indawo (−1,−1) isemugqeni womfundi?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi imigqa emibili ehlukile ingadlula endaweni efanayo yini.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi leyo ndawo eyodwa inquma umugqa yini.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.a: Ukudlula endaweni akwenzi kube kulungile; kungubufakazi nje obungenele ukusho ukuthi akulungile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.b: Uma kudlula endaweni, lokho kufakazela ukuthi umugqa ocabangelwe ulungile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.r.b: Imigqa engenamkhawulo idlula endaweni eyodwa, ngakho imigqa ehlukile ingadlula endaweni efanayo. Ukudlula kuphela akwenzi umugqa ulunge.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.c: Phakathi kwemigqa edlula kuleyo ndawo, lokhu kuhlola kuphela kukhetha eyodwa elungile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.r.c: Uma imigqa eminingana idlula endaweni efanayo, lokhu kuhlola kungeke kuyihlukanise.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.explain: Ukudlula ukuhlola akwenzi kube kulungile. Indawo eyodwa ingavumela imigqa eminingi yabangenzeka ukuthi idlule (imigqa engenamkhawulo idlula endaweni eyodwa). Ukunquma umugqa, udinga izindawo ezimbili ezihlukile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha enye indawo emugqeni wokuqala 2x+y=3 ngaphandle kuka-(1,1) bese uthola ukucabangela kwayo ngaphesheya ku-y=−x. Hlola ukuthi leyo ndawo isemugqeni wabani kwabathathu bamafundi, bese ubhala ukuthi umugqa kabani olungile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.hint.0: Thola enye indawo eyanelisa u-2x+y=3 (zama u-x=0).
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ukucabangela kwaleyo ndawo bese ukufaka ezibalweni zikaMinsu noHajun.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Uma ngithatha indawo (0,3), indawo ecabangelwe ...
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthole ukucabangela kwaleyo ndawo usebenzisa (x,y)→(−y,−x)?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukhombise ngokubala ukuthi indawo isemugqeni owodwa kuphela?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.model.0: Uthatha indawo (0,3) emugqeni, ukucabangela kwayo ngaphesheya ku-y=−x ngu-(−3,0). Ukufaka ku-x+2y+3=0 kukaMinsu kunika −3+3=0, ngakho kuyadlula, kodwa ku-2x+y+3=0 kaHajun sithola −6+3≠0, ngakho akudluli. Ngakho uMinsu uqinisile.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.model.1: Uma ukhetha indawo (2,−1), ukucabangela kwayo ngu-(1,−2). Isibalo sikaMinsu sinika 1−4+3=0, ngakho siyadlula, futhi esikaHajun sinika 2−2+3=3, ngakho asidluli. Umugqa kaHajun awulungile futhi umugqa kaMinsu ulungile.

n-m-h1-logic-01.title: Ukuthola Umugqa Wokuqala Ophosile Esixazululweni Usebenzisa I-Contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.goal: Esixazululweni esithola i-contrapositive yesimo esihlanganiswe ngo-"futhi," thola futhi ulungise umugqa wokuqala ophosile, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani isiphakamiso sokuqala singaphenduki iphutha noma i-contrapositive engalungile iyiphutha.
n-m-h1-logic-01.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaMinseo, esisebenzisa i-contrapositive ukunquma ukuthi isiphakamiso "[Uma x>0 futhi y>0, bese xy>0]" siyiqiniso noma iphutha, ezinombolweni zangempela u-x, y. (U-xy usho u-x izikhathi u-y.)
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isixazululo umugqa ngomugqa ukuthola indawo yokuqala ephosile
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.2: Ukukulungisa kube yi-contrapositive elungile futhi unqume ukuthi isitatimende sokuqala siyiqiniso noma amanga
n-m-h1-logic-01.prereq.0: I-contrapositive ~q→~p yesitatimende p→q inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sika-Minseo lapho kuphutha khona.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngokulandelana ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uvele kanjani emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha u-(x, y) olodwa lapho p ingasebenzi, bese uhlola ukuthi isimo esibhalwe ~p esixazululweni sifaka leli nani yini.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.0: Vumela p: x>0 futhi y>0, no-q: xy>0. Khona-ke isitatimende esinikeziwe ngu-p→q.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho i-contrapositive ithi "Uma xy≤0, khona-ke x≤0 futhi y≤0."
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.4: Uma x=−1, y=2, khona-ke xy=−2≤0 kodwa y≤0 akuyona iqiniso, ngakho le contrapositive iyamanga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.5: Isitatimende sokuqala nesayo i-contrapositive banenani leqiniso elifanayo, ngakho isitatimende esinikeziwe naso siyamanga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 3. Uma p ithi "x>0 futhi y>0," ukuthi p ayisebenzi kusho ukuthi akunjalo ukuthi zombili zinhle, ngakho ngu-"x≤0 noma y≤0." "x≤0 futhi y≤0" yisimo esincane kakhulu. Umugqa 4 ulandela umugqa 3, futhi ukubala emugqeni 5 kulungile, kodwa isiphetho emugqeni 6 silandela iphutha emugqeni 3.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.prompt: Bhala i-contrapositive elungile, bese ubhala emishweni eyodwa noma emibili ukuthi isitatimende esinikeziwe siyiqiniso noma amanga, nesizathu sakho.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi zingaki kwezimo ezimbili x>0, y>0 okudingeka ziphuthe ukuze p ingasebenzi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani afana no-x=−1, y=2 ku-contrapositive yakho elungisiwe, bese uzama izinombolo ezimbalwa ezinhle esitatimendeni sokuqala.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uma ubhala i-contrapositive, ingabe uhlolile ngamanani ukuthi kungani "futhi" iguqulwa ibe "noma"?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi kungani isitatimende sokuqala siyiqiniso usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi isiphumo sezinombolo ezinhle sinhle?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uyaqonda ukuthi kungani isitatimende sokuqala singamanga noma i-contrapositive engalungile iyamanga?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.0: I-contrapositive elungile ithi "Uma xy≤0, khona-ke x≤0 noma y≤0." Uma u-x no-y bobabili benhle, isiphumo sabo nasso sinhle, ngakho isitatimende sokuqala siyiqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.1: ~p ngu-x≤0 noma y≤0, ngakho i-contrapositive ithi: uma xy≤0, khona-ke x≤0 noma y≤0. Isiphumo sezinombolo ezimbili ezinhle sinhle, ngakho isitatimende esinikeziwe siyiqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.2: ~p isho ukuthi okungenani u-x noma y ungu-0 noma ngaphansi, ngakho i-contrapositive elungile ithi "Uma xy≤0, khona-ke x≤0 noma y≤0." Isiphumo sezinombolo ezimbili ezinhle sihlala sinhle, ngakho isitatimende sokuqala siyiqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.prompt: Noma umugqa 5 ukhombise ukuthi i-contrapositive ebhalwe ngephutha iyamanga, isiphetho emugqeni 6 siphutha. Khetha isizathu esifanelekile kakhulu.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Funda futhi phakathi kwamaphi izitatimende ezimbili isakhiwo se-"banenani leqiniso elifanayo" sisebenza khona.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Beka isitatimende sika-Minseo ne-contrapositive elungile eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ziyisitatimende esifanayo yini.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.a: Isitatimende sika-Minseo asiyona i-contrapositive, ngakho ukumanga kwaso akudluliselwa esitatimendeni sokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.b: Noma i-contrapositive iyamanga, isitatimende sokuqala singaba yiqiniso, ngakho awukwazi ukunquma iqiniso noma amanga usebenzisa i-contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.b: Uphathe i-contrapositive elungile nesitatimende esibhalwe ngephutha njengesifanayo. I-contrapositive elungile ihlala inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesokuqala.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.c: Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo asikwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi noma yisiphi isitatimende siyamanga, ngakho ubufakazi emugqeni 5 bubuthakathaka
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.c: Ushaya indlela yesibonelo esiphikisayo. Lesi sitatimende siba amanga ngesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.d: Okuphambene (converse) kwesitatimende sokuqala kufanele kuhlolwe futhi, ngakho i-contrapositive yodwa ayikwazi ukunikeza isiphetho
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.d: Uxubanise i-converse ne-contrapositive. Inani leqiniso lesitatimende sokuqala linqunywa yi-contrapositive yodwa.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.explain: I-contrapositive elungile kuphela inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesokuqala. Isitatimende sika-Minseo asiyona i-contrapositive, ngakho noma siyamanga, asisho lutho ngesitatimende sokuqala. I-contrapositive elungile ihlala inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesokuqala, ngakho ungahlulela usebenzisa i-contrapositive (yingakho b iphutha), futhi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sefomu elithi "kuyo yonke ..." siyamanga (c). I-converse ingaba nenani leqiniso elihlukile kunelokuqala, ngakho akudingeki ukuyihlola (d).

n-m-h1-logic-04.title: Ukwenza Isimo Esidingekayo Kodwa Esingenele
n-m-h1-logic-04.goal: Funda "p yisimo esidingekayo ku-q" njengobudlelwano bokufakwa phakathi kwamasethi eqiniso, bese wakha futhi uhlola isimo esidingekayo kodwa esingenele.
n-m-h1-logic-04.material: Kunezimo ezimbili enombolweni engempela x. q: −2≤x≤4. Futhi ngezinombolo ezingaguquki a no-b, p: a≤x≤b. Vumela amasethi eqiniso ezimo ezimbili abe ngu-Q no-P, ngokulandelana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.thinking.0: Ukuguqula umusho ube ubudlelwano bokufakwa kwamasethi
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwano besethi yeqiniso obusho into efanayo no-"p yisimo esidingekayo ku-q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kusuka emshweni, qala uthole ukuthi yikuphi okudingekayo ukuthi kube yiqiniso: "uma q, khona-ke p" noma "uma p, khona-ke q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha into yesethi eyodwa bese ulandela isiqondiso okufanele ibe ngaso kwenye isethi, ku-P no-Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde njengobudlelwano lapho "uma p, khona-ke q" iyiqiniso, okungukuthi, lapho p iyisimo esanele.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde njengobudlelwano lapho kungekho nani ligculisa izimo zombili. Isimo esidingekayo siwubudlelwano bokufakwa.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.c: Ufunde njengobudlelwano lapho izimo ezimbili zilingana. Ukuba nokudingeka akusho ukuthi izimo ezimbili kufanele zilingane.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.explain: "p yisimo esidingekayo ku-q" isho ukuthi uma q isebenza, khona-ke p kufanele isebenze, okungukuthi, q⇒p. Wonke amalungu ka-Q asemhlanganweni ka-P, ngakho Q⊂P. Uma P⊂Q, khona-ke p iyisimo esanele ku-q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo eziphelele a, b (−10≤a, b≤10) ukuze p ibe yisimo esidingekayo kodwa esingeyona esanele ku-q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba u-Q=[−2, 4] njengebanga, bese unquma ukuthi u-P=[a, b] kufanele embozele kanjani u-Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ngemva kokukhetha u-a no-b, thola inombolo eyodwa engempela egculisa p kodwa hhayi q, ukuhlola ukuthi eyodwa ikhona ngempela.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−10 kuya ku-10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−10 kuya ku-10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Wonke u-x ogculisa q ugculisa no-p (isimo esidingekayo).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Abanye ngu-x abagculisa q abagculisi p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Kukhona u-x ogculisa p kodwa hhayi q (ngakho akuyona isimo esanele).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c3: p no-q yisimo esifanayo, ngakho p nayo iyisimo esanele.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.explain: P=[a, b] kufanele ibe no-Q=[−2, 4] ngaphandle kokulingana nayo. Isibonelo, ku-(−5, 6), P=[−5, 6], futhi x=5 igculisa p kodwa hhayi q. Ku-(−2, 4), P=Q, ngakho p iyisimo esidingekayo nesanele.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elilodwa lamapheya akho (a, b) bese ubhala ① inani elilodwa lika-x elingagculisa p kodwa hhayi q, no-② isizathu sokuthi wonke u-x ogculisa q ugculisa no-p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ubhale ibanga [a, b] usebenzisa amanani akho ka-a no-b.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Khetha inombolo eyodwa esebangeni elo kodwa engekho ku-[−2, 4].
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi u-x owakhethile useku-[a, b] ngempela kodwa engekho ku-[−2, 4]?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ② usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi zombili iziphetho zika-Q, −2 no-4, zingaphakathi ku-P?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma (a, b)=(−5, 6), x=5 igculisa p ngoba −5≤x≤6, kodwa inkulu kuno-4, ngakho ayigculisi q. Wonke u-x onge-−2≤x≤4 ungaphakathi kuka-−5 no-6, ngakho ugculisa no-p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma ngithatha (−3, 4), khona-ke x=−3 igculisa p kodwa hhayi q. Ibanga luka-q, [−2, 4], liqukethwe ngokuphelele ku-[−3, 4], ngakho noma nini uma q isebenza, p ihlala isebenza.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma a=-3 no-b=5, khona-ke 5 igculisa p kodwa hhayi q. Wonke inombolo egculisa q ingaphakathi kuka-−3 no-5, ngakho igculisa no-p.

n-m-h1-comb-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esibala izindlela zokufaka amagama ezibhokisini zeposi
n-m-h1-comb-01.topic: Ukubala: izinyathelo zomthetho womphumela kufanele zisekelwe kuni?
n-m-h1-comb-01.goal: Esixazululweni esasebenzisa umthetho womphumela, hlola ukuthi "lokho okunqunywe isinyathelo ngesinyathelo" kuhambisana nezimo zenkinga yini, thola umugqa ophosile, futhi uqinisekise ngokubhala icala elincane ngqo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.material: Sifuna ukufaka amagama ahlukile angu-4 ezibhokisini zeposi ezingu-3, wonke. Ibhokisi lingathola amagama amaningi, futhi elinye ibhokisi lingase lingathole igama nhlobo. USujin wazixazulula ngomthetho womphumela njengoba kukhonjiswe ngezansi. (U-4³ yinombolo oyithola ngokuphindaphinda u-4 izikhathi ezintathu.)
n-m-h1-comb-01.thinking.2: Akha izimo zenkinga (wonke amagama afakiwe, amagama amaningi avunyelwe) enkulumweni
n-m-h1-comb-01.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubala izindlela zokufaka izinto ezihlukile ezindaweni eziningana usebenzisa umdwebo wesihlahla noma uhlu
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile esixazululweni sikaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokugcizelela izimo "wonke afakiwe" no-"amagama amaningi angafakwa" enkingeni.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ngomugqa ngamunye, bhala ngokufushane ukuthi uSujin unquma ini isinyathelo ngesinyathelo nokuthi ukhetha kuni.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hlola ukuthi, ngalezo zinketho, onke amagama angu-4 aphelela ezibhokisini ngaphandle kokushiywa.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukubala izindlela usebenzisa umthetho womphumela, sihlukanisa umsebenzi ube yizinyathelo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.1: Qala ngokubheka amabhokisi eposi angu-3 elandelana, futhi ibhokisi ngalinye sikhetha igama elilodwa ukulifaka kulo kuwo amagama angu-4.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.3: Njengoba kunamabhokisi eposi angu-3, inani lingu-4×4×4=4³=64 izindlela.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 2. Le nkinga ikhuluma ngokufaka "wonke amagama angu-4" ezibhokisini zeposi. Uma ukhetha igama elilodwa kuphela ibhokisi ngalinye, uxuba amacala lapho ibhokisi elilodwa lithola amagama amabili noma elinye igama lingafakwa, ngakho awubali isimo esisenkingeni. Imigqa 3 no-4 iphosile ngoba ilandela umugqa 2.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ophosile ukuthola inani elilungile lezindlela, futhi ubhale nokuthi uguqule ini ukunquma isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khomba inombolo ephindaphindwayo nenani lezikhathi eliphindaphindwayo enkulumweni kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuthi ungakhetha emabhokisini amangaki uma unquma igama elilodwa, futhi ubale ukuthi ukwenza lokhu izikhathi ezingaki.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Kulokhu sinquma ... isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Bese ...
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uguqule kwaba ukukhetha ibhokisi lokufaka igama ngalinye kwangu-4?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ubhale kahle ukuthi ungakhetha emabhokisini amangaki uma ufaka igama elilodwa?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi inani lokuphindaphinda nenani eliphindaphindwayo ngalinye liyini?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.model.0: Ngegama ngalinye kunamabhokisi eposi angu-3 okuliphakamisa kuwo, futhi senza lokhu emagameni angu-4 elandelana, ngakho kungu-3×3×3×3=81 izindlela. USujin wabala ngebhokisi, ngakho akusaphelelani nezimo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.model.1: Igama ngalinye lingena kwelinye lamabhokisi eposi angu-3, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-3^4=81. Uma ukhetha igama ibhokisi ngalinye, isimo sokuthi wonke amagama angu-4 afakiwe asikhi enkulumweni.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.prompt: Iyiphi indlela esheshayo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela ezingu-64 zikaSujin akuyona impendulo yenkinga?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.hint.0: Shintshela kucala elincane, bhala konke ngqo, futhi uqhathanise leso sibalo nesibalo esibaliwe ngendlela kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi iyiphi inkulumo indlela kaSujin eyinika amagama angu-2 namabhokisi eposi angu-3.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.a: Hlola ukuthi impendulo engu-64 iyinombolo yemvelo yini.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.a: U-64 uyinombolo yemvelo, ngakho udlula lokhu kuhlola. Kodwa ukuthi inani liyinombolo yemvelo akusitsheli ukuthi indlela yokubala iyiso yini.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.b: Funda futhi kanye ukuthi onke amagama angu-4 afakiwe yini.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.b: Ukufunda kabusha izimo kuhle, kodwa akuyona ukuhlolwa okunquma ukuthi inkulumo iphosile yini.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.c: Bhala icala elincane njengamagama angu-2 namabhokisi eposi angu-3, bese ulaqhathanisa nenani elibalwe ngendlela kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.d: Phindaphinda inani lamabhokisi eposi nenani lamagama bese uqhathanisa no-4×3=12.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.d: Ukuqhathanisa nenkulumo engenzeka akunaso isisekelo. Kufanele uqhathanise nenani olibhale ngqo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.explain: Uma ubhala ngqo amagama angu-2 (a, b) namabhokisi eposi angu-3, u-a unezindawo ezingu-3 futhi u-b unezindawo ezingu-3, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-9. Ukubala ngendlela kaSujin, ngebhokisi ngalinye kwangu-3 ukhetha elilodwa lamagama angu-2, okunika u-2³=8, okuhlukile ku-9. Ukuqhathanisa icala elincane njengalokhu kukhombisa ngokushesha ukuthi indlela iphosile.

n-m-h1-comb-04.title: Ukubala izihlukanisi nge-prime factorization nokwenza inombolo enezihlukanisi eziyi-12
n-m-h1-comb-04.topic: Umthetho wesiphumo: ukubala izihlukanisi nge-prime factorization
n-m-h1-comb-04.goal: Bona izihlukanisi njengokukhetha kwama-exponent futhi ubale usebenzisa umthetho wesiphumo, bese wenza izinombolo ezinenani elinikeziwe lezihlukanisi futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani izimo ezingenzeka zama-exponent zilinganiselwe.
n-m-h1-comb-04.material: Cabanga ukuthi inombolo yemvelo N inayo i-prime factorization N=2^a×3^b (a, b yizinombolo eziphelele okungenani ezingu-1). Izihlukanisi ezinhle ze-N zinefomu 2^i×3^j ne-0≤i≤a, 0≤j≤b. Isibonelo, uma N=12=2²×3, izihlukanisi ngu-1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, okuyizihlukanisi ezingu-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.0: Bala ngokuguqula into ibe yisakhiwo (ukukhetha kwama-exponent)
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.1: Qinisekisa ngokwenza izibonelo eziningana ezigculisa izimo
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi isimo sebanga (i-exponent okungenani engu-1) sinciphisa kanjani okungenzeka
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.prompt: Yisiphi isibalo ku-a no-b esinika inani lezihlukanisi ezinhle ze-N=2^a×3^b? (Hlola ngecala lika-12.)
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala zonke izihlukanisi ezingu-6 zika-12 ngefomu 2^i×3^j bese ubala amapheya (i, j).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukukhetha u-i nokukhetha u-j kwenzeka ndawonye noma ngokwehlukana.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.a: Ku-12, a=2 no-b=1, ngakho a×b=2, kodwa empeleni kunezihlukanisi ezingu-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.b: Ku-12, a=2 no-b=1, ngakho a+b=3, kodwa empeleni kunezihlukanisi ezingu-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.c: Ukufaka u-12 kunika 3+2=5, kodwa empeleni kunezihlukanisi ezingu-6. Cabanga ukuthi ukukhetha u-i no-j ngokwehlukana kunika isamba noma isiphumo.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.explain: Kunezindlela ezingu-a+1 zokukhetha u-i (kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-a) nezindlela ezingu-b+1 zokukhetha u-j, futhi isihlukanisi sinqunywa kuphela uma ukukhetha kokubili kwenziwa ndawonye, ngakho ngomthetho wesiphumo kunezihlukanisi ezingu-(a+1)(b+1). Ku-12 lokhu kungu-3×2=6, okuyahambisana.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola amapheya ama-3 ahlukile (a, b) ukuze N=2^a×3^b (a, b yizinombolo eziphelele okungenani ezingu-1) ibe nezihlukanisi ezinhle ezingu-12 ngqo, bese uwafaka.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa u-12 ube yisiphumo sezinombolo ezimbili ukuze isibalo senani lezihlukanisi ku-a no-b silingane no-12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khipha u-1 kuzo zombili izinombolo ukuthola u-a no-b, bese uhlola ukuthi amanani afanela ibanga enkingeni.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b yizinombolo eziphelele okungenani ezingu-1.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo eziphelele okungenani ezingu-1.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.explain: Kusuka ku-(a+1)(b+1)=12, sinaka 12=2×6=3×4=4×3=6×2, ngakho (a, b)=(1, 5), (2, 3), (3, 2), (5, 1). Ngo-12=1×12 i-exponent eyodwa yayiyoba ngu-0, okungahambisani no-b≥1. Izinombolo ngu-2×3^5=486, 4×27=108, 8×9=72, 32×3=96.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma N=2^a×3^b×5^c (a, b, c zonke okungenani ezingu-1) inezihlukanisi ezinhle ezingu-12, (a+1)(b+1)(c+1)=12. Thola onke amanani angenzeka ka-a, b, c, bese ubhala isizathu sokuthi akukho cala eliphuthile.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale amanani amancane kakhulu u-a+1, b+1, c+1 angawathatha.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa isiphumo samanani amancane kuphela nalawo no-12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uma ubhala u-12 njengesiphumo, ingabe uqale wanquma ukuthi izinombolo ezingaki ziyaphindaphindwa?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani isici esingu-1 singasetshenziswa?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange nangamacala anokulandelana okuguquliwe (a, b, c ezindaweni ezihlukile)?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.0: a+1, b+1, c+1 zonke ziyizinombolo eziphelele okungenani ezingu-2 futhi isiphumo sazo singu-12. Ukubhala u-12 njengesiphumo sezinombolo ezintathu okungenani ezingu-2 kunika kuphela 2×2×3, ngakho (a, b, c) ngu-1, 1, 2 ngokulandelana okuthile: (1,1,2), (1,2,1), (2,1,1).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.1: I-exponent ngayinye okungenani ingu-1, ngakho (a+1), (b+1), (c+1) azikwazi ukuba ngu-1 futhi okungenani zingu-2. Izinombolo eziphelele ezintathu kuphela okungenani ezingu-2 ezinesiphumo esingu-12 ngu-2×2×3, ngakho ama-exponent angu-1, 1, 2, futhi kuye ngokuthi yiliphi inombolo ye-prime ethola u-2, kunezindlela ezingu-3.

n-m-h1-comb-02.title: Ukupenda izingxenye ezine zebhede lezimbali ngemibala emithathu: singayethemba ukuphindaphinda kukaHyunwoo?
n-m-h1-comb-02.topic: Ukubala: uma inani lezinketho lincike ezinketho zangaphambilini emthethweni womphumela
n-m-h1-comb-02.goal: Qaphela ukuthi emthethweni womphumela inani lezinketho esinyathelweni ngasinye lingancika ezinketho zangaphambilini, futhi uthole inani elilungile ngokuhlukanisa amacala.
n-m-h1-comb-02.material: Ibhede lezimbali eliyisikwele lihlukaniswe libe yizingxenye ezine: A, B, C, no-D. U-A no-B, u-B no-C, u-C no-D, no-D no-A babelana ngohlangothi; u-A no-C, no-B no-D, bahlangana endaweni kuphela, ngakho abayona omakhelwane. Sisebenzisa imibala emi-3: obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nophuzi, futhi izingxenye ezingomakhelwane zipendwa ngemibala ehlukile. Umbala ungasetshenziswa ezingxenyeni eziningi, futhi akudingeki sisebenzise yonke imibala emi-3. UHyunwoo wabala kanje: U-A unezindlela ezingu-3, u-B uhlukile ku-A ngakho izindlela ezingu-2, u-C uhlukile ku-B ngakho izindlela ezingu-2, futhi u-D uhlukile ku-C ngakho izindlela ezingu-2, ngakho 3×2×2×2=24 izindlela.
n-m-h1-comb-02.thinking.0: Hlola ukuthi inani lezinketho liyafana esinyathelweni ngasinye yini
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.prompt: Yenza izindlela ezi-4 ezihlukile zokupenda ezanelisa izimo. Faka imibala njengo-1=obomvu, 2=oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, 3=ophuzi.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kusukela ku-A, nquma imibala eyodwa ngeyodwa ngokulandelana u-B, C, D, futhi uhlole ukuthi akukho ingxenye enombala ofanayo nomakhelwane.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuthi u-D umakhelwane bobabili u-C no-A uma ubhala izibonelo zakho.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.ok.c1: Yonke imibala emine ingomunye ku-1 kuya ku-3.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.fail.c1: Umbala ngamunye kufanele ube ngomunye ku-1, 2, 3 (inombolo egcwele).
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.fail.c2: U-A no-B, no-B no-C, bangomakhelwane, ngakho imibala yabo kufanele ihluke.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.fail.c3: U-C no-D, no-D no-A, bangomakhelwane, ngakho imibala yabo kufanele ihluke.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo, (obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) kanye (obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ophuzi, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) kokubili kunelisa izimo. U-A no-C, abangayona omakhelwane, bangaba nombala ofanayo noma imibala ehlukile.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.prompt: Siyini isizathu esifanele kakhulu sokuthi kungani ukubala kukaHyunwoo 3×2×2×2=24 kungeke kube yimpendulo yale nkinga?
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala phansi zonke izingxenye ezingomakhelwane bakaD, futhi wenze izibonelo ezimbili ezinemibala egcwalisiwe kulezo zingxenye; bala izinketho zika-D ngasinye.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kwezibonelo ozenzile, hlukanisa lezo lapho u-A no-C banombala ofanayo nalezo lapho behluka, futhi uqhathanise inani lemibala ongayikhetha u-D.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.o.a: Uma upenda u-D, imibala okufanele igwenywe imibala ka-C no-A, futhi inani lemibala etholakalayo lincike ekutheni leyo mibala emibili ifana noma ihlukile, ngakho asikwazi ukuphindaphinda ngo-2 njalo.
