n-m-h1-eq-01.title: Inani lika-√(−2)·√(−3): yisiphi kwezixazululo ezimbili esilungile?
n-m-h1-eq-01.topic: Izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi: ukuphindaphinda izimpande zesikwele zezinombolo ezimbi nebanga lapho umthetho we-radical usebenza khona
n-m-h1-eq-01.goal: Hlola ngokubala amanani ngqo ukuthi umthetho wokuphindaphinda wama-radical amabili ungasetshenziswa njengoba unjalo uma izinombolo ezingaphansi kwe-radical zimbi, bese ufingqa emshweni owodwa ibanga lapho umthetho usebenza khona.
n-m-h1-eq-01.material:
USeonu noHaeun ngamunye bathole inani lika-√(−2)·√(−3).
Seonu: √(−2)·√(−3)=√((−2)×(−3))=√6
Haeun: √(−2)=√2·i, √(−3)=√3·i, ngakho √(−2)·√(−3)=√2·i·√3·i=√6·i²=−√6
(Lapha u-√ usho impande yesikwele, futhi sivumelana ukuthi impande yesikwele yenombolo embi u-−k ngu-√(−k)=√k·i.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.0: Qhathanisa imithetho ngayinye yezixazululo ezimbili esekelwe kuyo
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.1: Hlola ukuthi umthetho usebenza yini ngokushintsha izinombolo
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.2: Fingqa ngamazwi ibanga lapho umthetho usebenza khona
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.prompt: Bheka izixazululo ezimbili bese ukhetha isahlulelo esifaneleke kakhulu.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thola lapho inombolo engaphansi kwe-radical imbi ezixazululweni ezimbili, bese uqhathanisa eduzane ukuthi isixazululo ngasinye siyiphethe kanjani leyo nombolo embi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ulandela umthetho oguqula u-√(−2) ube ngu-√2·i, bala ngqo kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni bese unquma ukuthi leli nani lihambisana nesixazululo sini.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.a: USeonu: umphumela wama-radical ungahlanganiswa ube munye, ngakho inani lingu-√6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.a: Kucabange ukuthi u-√a·√b=√(ab) uyasebenza noma kubandakanya izinombolo ezimbi. Buyisela ingqondo ukuthi lo mthetho wenzelwe izinombolo zohlobo luni ku-a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa: impande yesikwele yenombolo embi ayinawo inani elilodwa
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.b: Esikoleni esiphakeme umthetho √(−k)=√k·i umisa inani. Bala ngokuya ngaleso sivumelwano.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.c: UHaeun: uqala aguqule abe yiyunithi engeyona yangempela bese ephindaphinda, ngakho inani lingu-−√6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.d: Bobabili balungile: kuhluka kuphela ifomu futhi inani liyafana
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.d: U-√6 no-−√6 yizinombolo ezihlukile. Cabanga ukuthi kuzodingeka ini ukuze zilingane.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.explain: Ulandela umthetho √(−k)=√k·i, √(−2)·√(−3)=√2 i·√3 i=√6·i²=−√6. Isixazululo sikaSeonu sisebenzise u-√a·√b=√(ab) njengoba unjalo noma u-a no-b bobabili bembi, ngakho sivele njengo-√6.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke ama-(a, b) lapho u-√a·√b=√(ab) usebenza khona. (Bala izimpande zesikwele zezinombolo ezimbi njengo-√(−k)=√k·i bese uqhathanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngqo.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwelinye ngalinye lamacala amane, bala uhlangothi lwesobunxele u-√a·√b nolwesokudla u-√(ab) ngokwehlukile futhi ubhale eduzane ethebuleni.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa amacala lapho amanani abaliwe elingana nalawo lapho ehlukile, bese ubheka izimpawu zika-a no-b emacaleni ahlukile.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.a: Bala ngqo ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili zilingana yini. Uma konke ngaphansi kwama-radical kuhle, umthetho uyasebenza.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.b: √(−4)=2i no-√9=3, ngakho umphumela ungu-6i, futhi √(−36)=6i. Umthetho uyasebenza noma owodwa wabo embi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.c: √4=2 no-√(−9)=3i, ngakho umphumela ungu-6i, futhi √(−36)=6i. Umthetho uyasebenza noma owodwa wabo embi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.d: √(−4)·√(−9)=2i·3i=−6, kodwa √36=6, ngakho amanani amabili ahlukile. Kuleli cala umthetho awusebenzi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.explain: Ku-a=4, b=9 uyasebenza njengo-6=6, futhi ku-a=−4, b=9 naku-a=4, b=−9 uyasebenza njengo-6i=6i kokubili. Kuphela uma a=−4, b=−9 sithola u-−6 no-6, ohlukile.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala emishweni eyodwa noma emibili ukuthi ku-a no-b abayizinombolo ezinjani isibalo √a·√b=√(ab) siyehluleka, nokuthi u-√a·√b no-√(ab) bahlobana kanjani ngaleso sikhathi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula icala elilodwa elingasebenzanga esinyathelweni esedlule bese ubhala izimpawu zika-a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phansi inani lesobunxele nelesokudla kuleli cala bese uqhathanisa ukuthi lihlobana kanjani.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Kuphela uma u-a no-b bengu-... ingu-..., bese ...
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale icala lapho kuphela u-a noma u-b ombi?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ungasho ukuthi uma bobabili bembi uphawu luyashintsha ngenxa ye-i²=−1?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.0: Iyehluleka kuphela uma u-a no-b bobabili bembi. Ngaleso sikhathi u-√a·√b unophawu oluphambene no-√(ab), ngakho uba ngu-−√(ab).
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma zombili izinombolo zimbi, √a·√b=√|a|i·√|b|i=−√(ab), ngakho uphawu luphambene. Uyasebenza uma owodwa kuphela embi noma uma bobabili bahle.

n-m-h1-eq-02.title: Okuphindwe ω kuze kube yi-2026: ukubala kukaChaerin kwaphambuka kuphi?
n-m-h1-eq-02.topic: Izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi nezibalo ze-quadratic: amandla empande engeyona yangempela nokuphindaphindeka
n-m-h1-eq-02.goal: Thola umthetho wamandla ku-quadratic equation enelwa impande engeyona yangempela, thola futhi ulungise iphutha ekuxazululweni okusebenzise isikhathi ngokungalungile, bese uhlola wena umthetho.
n-m-h1-eq-02.material: UChaerin uzamile ukuthola inani lika-ω^2026 uma u-ω eyimpande eyodwa engeyona yangempela ye-quadratic equation x²−x+1=0, futhi wayixazulula ngale ndlela elandelayo. (u-ω^2026 usho u-ω ku-2026 amandla.)
n-m-h1-eq-02.thinking.2: Thola umthetho wezinyuso ezenza amandla alingane no-1
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaChaerin.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funda imigqa yesixazululo ngokulandelana bese uhlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye usebenzisa umphumela womugqa odlule njengoba unjalo yini.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa umphumela womugqa ngamunye eyodwa ngesikhathi nenani lika-ω³ elitholwe emgqeni 1, bese ubala ngokufaka leli nani ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.line.0: U-ω uyimpande ye-x²−x+1=0, ngakho ω²−ω+1=0. Ukuphindaphinda zombili izinhlangothi ngo-ω+1 kunikeza u-ω³+1=0, ngakho ω³=−1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlukanisa u-2026 ngo-3 kunikeza isiphumo 675 nensalela 1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 awulungile. Umugqa 1 uthe ω³=−1, ngakho (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Ngakho ω^2026=−ω. Imigqa 1 kuya ku-3 ilungile.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inani elilungisiwe lika-ω^2026, futhi ubonise ukuthi enye indlela (isibonelo, ukusebenzisa inani lika-ω⁶ nensalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-6) inikeza inani elifanayo.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa inani lika-ω³ njengoba lalitholwe ngaphambilini, bese unquma uphawu lomphumela wokuliphindaphinda izikhathi ezingu-675.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Uma ω³=−1, thola inani lika-ω⁶, bese ubala futhi usebenzisa insalela uma u-2026 uhlukaniswa ngaleso sinyuso.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unqume uphawu lwe-(−1)^675 ngoba isinyuso singu-odd?
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise nomphumela wokubala usebenzisa insalela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-6?
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.0: ω^2026=−ω. Njengoba ω³=−1, (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Ngenye indlela, ω⁶=1 no-2026=6×337+4, ngakho ω^2026=ω⁴=ω³·ω=−ω, okufanayo.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.1: (ω³)^675=(−1)^675 ungu-−1 ngoba isinyuso singu-odd. Ngakho ω^2026 ungu-−ω. Lokhu kuvumelana nokuthi insalela 4 uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-6 inikeza u-ω⁴=−ω.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.prompt: Ku-ω, impande engacatshangwayo ye-x²−x+1=0, thola futhi ufake izinombolo zemvelo ezintathu ezihlukile k (1≤k≤60) ezenza ω^k=1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khulisa isinyuso njengo-ω³, ω⁶, ω⁹ bese ubhala amanani ngokulandelana.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Thola isinyuso sokuqala lapho inani liba ngu-1, bese uhlola ukuthi liyafana kwezinye izikhathi zalesosinyuso.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Iyinombolo yemvelo esuka ku-1 kuya ku-60.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Kufanele ibe yinombolo yemvelo esuka ku-1 kuya ku-60.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Kulo k, ω^k alingani no-1. Bala u-ω³, ω⁶, nokunye ngokulandelana.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.explain: Njengoba ω³=−1, ω⁶=1. Ngakho ω^k=1 ku-k oyisiphindaphindi sika-6. Ku-k=3, ω³=−1, ngakho akusebenzi.

n-m-h1-eq-03.title: Uma impande e-1 ingu-1+i, enye impande ingu-1−i?
n-m-h1-eq-03.topic: Izimpande ezingacatshangwayo zezibalo ze-quadratic: isimo esiqinisekisa impande ye-conjugate
n-m-h1-eq-03.goal: Khomba ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukunquma enye impande uma impande e-1 ingacatshangwa, bese wenza isibonelo lapho isiphetho sishintsha uma ulwazi lungekho.
n-m-h1-eq-03.material: Cabanga ukuthi impande e-1 ye-x²+px+q=0 ingu-1+i. USoyeon wathi, "Enye impande kufanele ibe ngu-1−i," futhi uJeonghun wathi, "Awukwazi ukuqinisa lokho." (Akwaziwa okwamanje ukuthi u-p no-q bayizinombolo ezinjani.)
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.0: Thola isimo esifihliwe esidingekayo ukuze isiphetho sibambe
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi kungani isibonelo esiphikisayo sibonisa ukuthi isimo siyadingeka
n-m-h1-eq-03.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili nama-coefficient esibalo se-quadratic
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze isimangalo sikaSoyeon sibambe ngokuphoqelekile, yikuphi kokulandelayo okwanele ukukwazi?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ake enye impande ibe ngu-a+bi bese ubhala isamba nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili ngo-a no-b ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isibalo isimo ekukhetheni ngakunye esinikeza u-a no-b, bese ufuna icala elisifezayo kuyilapho u-a+bi engeyona u-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.a: Uma ungazi ukuthi u-p no-q bayizinombolo zangempela yini, u-p²−4q kungaba yinombolo ye-complex, ngakho igama elithi "negative" ngokwalo lingase lingachazwa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.b: Noma isamba singesangempela, enye impande ingase ingabi ngu-1−i. Ake enye impande ibe ngu-a+bi bese ubheka ingxenye engacatshangwayo yesamba.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.c: Noma umphumela ungowangempela, enye impande ingase ingabi ngu-1−i. Ake enye impande ibe ngu-a+bi bese ubheka ingxenye engacatshangwayo yomphumela.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.explain: Kuphela uma u-p no-q bobabili bengabangempela inombolo ye-complex ye-conjugate iyimpande. Ukuba nesamba kuphela esingesangempela, noma umphumela kuphela, akwanele. Uma bobabili bengabangempela, kulelo cala lapho u-p no-q bengabangempela, futhi isiphetho sinqunyiwe.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.prompt: Ake enye impande ibe ngu-a+bi (u-a, b bayizinombolo ezigcwele ezisuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9). Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile (a, b) ukuze isamba sezimpande ezimbili singesangempela futhi enye impande ingeyona u-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ingxenye yangempela nengxenye engacatshangwayo yesamba (1+i)+(a+bi) ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nquma ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye okufanele ibe ngu-0 ukuze isamba sibe sesangempela, bese uhlola ngokushintsha inani lika-a ngaphansi kwalowo mbandela.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo ezigcwele ezisuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ingxenye engacatshangwayo yesamba sezimpande ezimbili ingu-0, ngakho isamba singesangempela.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Isamba (1+a)+(1+b)i asiyona eyangempela. Zama ukwenza ingxenye engacatshangwayo yesamba ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Enye impande iphuma ingu-1−i. Kufanele uthole icala elihlukile esimangalweni sikaSoyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.explain: Ukuze isamba sibe sesangempela, ingxenye engacatshangwayo 1+b kufanele ibe ngu-0, ngakho b=−1, futhi uma u-a engeyona u-1, enye impande ayiyona u-1−i. Isibonelo, uma izimpande zingu-1+i no-3−i, isamba singu-4, esangempela, kodwa enye impande ayiyona u-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.prompt: Bheka isibalo esinezimpande 1+i no-3−i: isamba singesangempela, kodwa isimangalo sikaSoyeon asibambi. Bala nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani lesi sibalo siyisibonelo esiphikisayo esimangalweni sikaSoyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nwebisa u-(1+i)(3−i) usebenzisa umthetho wokusabalalisa bese wenza lula ngokufaka u-−1 esikhundleni sika-i².
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi u-p no-q banqunywa isamba nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili, bese uhlola ukuthi u-p no-q bangabangempela yini.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unwebise u-(1+i)(3−i) ngqo futhi waqinisekisa ukuthi ingxenye engacatshangwayo iyasala?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi isibalo esiyisibonelo esiphikisayo siphula isimo isimangalo sikaSoyeon esisidingayo?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.0: (1+i)(3−i)=3−i+3i−i²=4+2i, ngakho umphumela awusiwo wangempela. Njengoba umphumela q ungesona sangempela, u-p no-q abasibo bobabili bangempela, ngakho isimo isimangalo sikaSoyeon esisidingayo asifezwanga.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.1: Isamba singu-4, esingesangempela, kodwa umphumela ungu-4+2i, onengxenye engacatshangwayo futhi ongesiwo wangempela. Ama-coefficient alesi sibalo akayona wonke angempela, ngakho ngaphandle kwesimo sokuthi ama-coefficient angempela, asikwazi ukusho ukuthi enye impande ingu-1−i.

n-m-h1-eq-04.title: Ukwenza isibalo x⁴+ax²+b=0 onempande engu-x=2
n-m-h1-eq-04.topic: Izibalo zezinga eliphezulu: izibalo ze-biquadratic nesimo sezimpande zangempela ngemva kokufaka esikhundleni
n-m-h1-eq-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiziphi izimpande zesibalo se-quadratic esitholwe ngo-x²=t ezinikeza izimpande zangempela zesibalo sokuqala, yenza izibalo eziningana ezihambisana nezimo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
n-m-h1-eq-04.material: Kunesibalo x⁴+ax²+b=0 (u-a, b bayizinombolo ezigcwele). Phakathi kwezimpande zaso ezine (bala impande ephindaphindwayo ngokuphindaphindeka kwayo), sifuna ezimbili ngqo zibe zangempela nezimbili ezisele zibe ngezingacatshangwayo. Futhi, u-x=2 uyimpande yalesi sibalo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi kungani uphawu lwama-coefficient lunquma uhlobo lwezimpande
n-m-h1-eq-04.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient esibalo se-quadratic
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.prompt: Ukumisa x²=t kunikeza u-t²+at+b=0. Ukuze u-x esibalweni sokuqala abe ongempela, u-t kufanele athathe maphi amanani?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xazulula u-x²=t emacaleni amathathu t=4, t=0, t=−4 bese uhlola ukuthi u-x ungowangempela yini.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yiliphi ibanga lamanani olithola njalo uma wenza inombolo yangempela u-x isikwele.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.a: Kwanele ukuthi u-t abe yinombolo ephelele
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.a: Ku-x=√t, noma u-t eyinombolo ephelele, u-x akayona eyangempela uma u-t engu-negative. Okubalulekile uphawu, hhayi ukuthi iyinombolo ephelele yini.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.b: Kwanele ukuthi u-t abe yinombolo yangempela
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.b: Noma u-t eyangempela, uma engu-negative akukho x wangempela ongu-x²=t. Zama ukuxazulula u-x²=−4 ku-t=−4.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.d: Noma u-t engu-0, u-x=0 uyimpande yangempela, futhi noma u-t engeyona inombolo ephelele, kuvela izimpande zangempela. Isimo sincane kakhulu.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.explain: Uma u-x eyangempela, u-x²=t ungu-0 okungenani. Ngokuphambene, uma u-t eyinombolo yangempela engu-0 okungenani, khona x=±√t izimpande zangempela. Uma u-t engu-negative, u-x uba yipheya yezinombolo ezingacatshangwayo eziyi-conjugate komunye nomunye.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola amapheya amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo ezigcwele (a, b) kusibalo x⁴+ax²+b=0 ukuze x=2 abe yimpande, ezimbili ngqo kwezine zibe zangempela (2 no-−2), nezinye ezimbili zibe ngezingacatshangwayo. (−20≤a≤20)
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=2 ukuthola ubudlelwano o-1 phakathi kuka-a no-b, bese ukhetha u-a, uthole u-b, bese uthola ngqo izimpande ezimbili zika-t²+at+b=0.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Eyodwa yezimpande ezimbili zika-t ingu-4. Bheka ukuthi izimpande zesibalo sokuqala ziba yini uma enye impande iyi-positive, u-0, noma i-negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo ezigcwele ezinga-20≤a≤20.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukufaka x=2 akunikezi u-0. Hlola inani lika-16+4a+b.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Eyodwa kuphela yezimpande ezimbili zika-t iyi-positive.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Azikho izimpande ezimbili zangempela (zonke ezine zingezangempela, noma u-0 uyimpande). Hlola izimpawu zezimpande ezimbili zesibalo se-quadratic ku-t.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.explain: Uma x=2, khona t=4 uyimpande ka-t²+at+b=0, ngakho 16+4a+b=0. Enye t ingu-−a−4, futhi leli nani kufanele libe yi-negative, ngakho b=4(−a−4)<0. Isibonelo, (a, b)=(−3, −4) inikeza u-(t−4)(t+1)=0, ngakho x=±2, ±i.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi umphumela wezimpande ezimbili zesibalo se-quadratic ku-t ungu-b, chaza ukuthi kungani, uma b<0, isibalo sokuqala sinezimpande zangempela ezimbili ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ake izimpande ezimbili zika-t²+at+b=0 zibe ngu-t₁, t₂, bhala u-t₁t₂ njengo-b, bese ucabanga ngezimpawu zezimpande ezimbili uma u-b engu-negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi u-x uba yini uma uxazulula u-x²=t ku-t oyi-positive nakweyi-negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: isib. Njengoba umphumela wezimpande ezimbili ku-t ungu-b, ...
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqinisekise ukuthi eyi-positive phakathi kwamanani amabili ka-t inikeza u-x=±√t?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqinisekise ukuthi u-x uba ongacatshangwayo kweyi-negative?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Umphumela wezimpande ezimbili ku-t ungu-b futhi b<0, ngakho izimpande ezimbili zinezimpawu eziphambene, eyodwa i-positive nenye i-negative. U-t oyi-positive unikeza u-x=±√t, izimpande ezimbili zangempela, futhi u-t oyi-negative wenza u-x abe ongacatshangwayo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngobudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient, umphumela wamanani amabili ka-t ungu-b, ngakho uma u-b engu-negative, u-t o-1 uyi-positive futhi omunye uyi-negative. U-t oyi-positive kuphela unikeza u-x wangempela futhi u-t oyi-negative unikeza izimpande ezingacatshangwayo, ngakho kunezimpande zangempela ezimbili ngqo.

n-m-h1-eq-08.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient esibalo se-quadratic
n-m-h1-eq-08.title: Isixazululo esithola u-k emphumeleni wezimpande ezintathu: ingabe uphawu luyiso?
n-m-h1-eq-08.topic: Izibalo zebanga eliphezulu: izimpawu ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient esibalo se-cubic
n-m-h1-eq-08.goal: Thola umugqa ophosile ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient esibalo se-cubic futhi ulungise, futhi uhlole uphawu lobudlelwano obujwayelekile usebenzisa isibalo esinezimpande ezikhethekile.
n-m-h1-eq-08.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaHajun sokuthola inani le-constant u-k uma izimpande ezintathu zika-x³−2x²−5x+k=0 zingu-α, β, γ futhi umphumela wezimpande ezintathu u-αβγ ungu-−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.thinking.2: Hlola izimpawu zefomula ejwayelekile ngesibonelo esithile
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile esixazululweni sikaHajun.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ithemu elingaguquki liba yini uma ukhulisa u-(x−α)(x−β)(x−γ).
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi uphawu lwethemu elingaguquki lufana noma luphambene nomphumela wezimpande ezintathu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.0: Ake izimpande ezintathu zika-x³−2x²−5x+k=0 zibe ngu-α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.1: Ngobudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient, umphumela wezimpande ezintathu ungu-ithemu elingaguquki u-k ohlukaniswe ngo-coefficient ehamba phambili u-1, ngakho αβγ=k.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uphosile. Ku-cubic equation, umphumela wezimpande ezintathu ngu-−(ithemu elingaguquki)÷(coefficient ehamba phambili), ngakho αβγ=−k. Bese −k=−6 kunika u-k=6. Imigqa 3 no-4 ukubala okulandela umugqa 2.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inani elilungisiwe luka-k, futhi ubhale inqubo yokuhlola ukuthi umphumela wezimpande ezintathu empeleni ungu-−6 kule k, ngokuhlukanisa isibalo ngezici noma ngokufaka impande.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Lungisa umugqa ophosile bese uthola u-k futhi, bese ubhala isibalo esinelo k bese uthola inombolo egcwele e-1 eyimpande.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Uma usuthole impande e-1, hlukanisa ngezici ukuthola ezinye izimpande bese uphindaphinda izimpande ezintathu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uma k=6, uhlukanise u-x³−2x²−5x+6 ngezici futhi wathola izimpande ezintathu?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uphindaphinde izimpande ezintathu ngqo futhi wahlola ukuthi uthola u-−6?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.0: αβγ=−k, ngakho −k=−6 kunika u-k=6. Ukuhlola: x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), ngakho izimpande ezintathu ngu-1, 3, −2 futhi umphumela ngu-1×3×(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.1: Uphawu lwethemu elingaguquki luphambene, ngakho umphumela wezimpande ezintathu ngu-−k. Ngakho k=6, futhi ukufaka u-x=1 kunika u-1−2−5+6=0, ngakho iyimpande. Ukuyibhala njengo-(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), umphumela wezimpande ezintathu ngu-1·3·(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.2: k=6. x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), ngakho izimpande zingu-1, 3, −2 futhi umphumela ngu-−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwano obulungile uma izimpande ezintathu zika-x³+ax²+bx+c=0 zingu-α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala isibalo se-cubic esinezimpande ezingu-1, 2, 3 njengo-(x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=0, sikhulise, futhi uthole u-a, b, c.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Faka u-a, b, c owathole enkulumweni ephakathi kwenketho ngayinye futhi uthole leyo ehambisana nesamba nemiphumela yezimpande ezintathu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.b: Ufunde ama-coefficient njengoba injalo. Qhathanisa isamba esingu-6 nenani lika-a uma izimpande ezintathu zingu-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.c: Uxube izimpawu zesibili nesesithathu nezimpawu ze-quadratic. Bala amanani ka-b no-c uma izimpande zingu-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.d: Awushintshanga uphawu lwesamba. Thola inani lika-a uma izimpande zingu-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.explain: (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=x³−6x²+11x−6, ngakho a=−6, b=11, c=−6. Isamba 6=−a, isamba semiphumela yezimpande ezimbili 11=b, nomphumela 6=−c.

n-m-h1-eq-06.title: Ukubhala kabusha "azikho izimpande uma D<0" ukuze kufanele izethameli
n-m-h1-eq-06.topic: I-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic: ukuhlukanisa "azikho izimpande zangempela" no-"azikho izimpande"
n-m-h1-eq-06.goal: Bhala kabusha isitatimende mayelana ne-discriminant ngokuqondile ezethamelini (umfowenu omncane weBanga 9, umfundi omnye), futhi uthole indawo lapho amagama angasho isistimu yezinombolo adala ukungaqondi.
n-m-h1-eq-06.material: UGyumin wabhala amaphuzu abalulekile e-discriminant encwadini yokubhala ukuchazela umfowabo omncane, osebangeni 9, izimpande zezibalo ze-quadratic. (U-a, b, c bayizinombolo zangempela futhi a≠0.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.1: Bhala okuqukethwe okufanayo ngamagama ahlukile ukuze kufanele izethameli
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.2: Bhala isistimu yezinombolo ukuze ubhale ngokuqondile
n-m-h1-eq-06.prereq.1: Incazelo yezimpande ezingelona zangempela nezinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uthatha yiluphi uhlelo lwezinombolo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha isibalo esinoD onegethivu, njengo-x²+1=0, futhi ucabange ukuthi empeleni asinaso isixazululo nhlobo yini.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.1: Uma D>0, inezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukile.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 awuqondile. Uma D<0 azikho izimpande zangempela, kodwa esikoleni esiphakeme izinombolo ziyanwetshwa zibe yizinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi, futhi isibalo sinezimpande ezimbili ezingelona zangempela eziyizinhlanganisela zomunye komunye. Imigqa 1, 2, no-4 ilungile.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa 3 emisho eyodwa noma emibili ukuze umfowenu omncane weBanga 9 ayiqonde. (Akakafundi izinombolo ezingelona zangempela, kodwa uyazazi amagrafu.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi "azikho izimpande" zishiwo kusistimu yezinombolo muphi, bese ufaka loho hla emshweni.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi izimpande zesibalo zivela kuphi egrafini bese uxhumanisa lokho nomusho.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Esikhundleni sokubhala "azikho izimpande" njengoba kunjalo, usho ukuthi usho yiluphi uhlelo lwezinombolo?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uchaze usebenzisa umbono wamagrafu umfowenu awaziyo?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.0: Uma D<0, azikho izimpande phakathi kwezinombolo zangempela. Igrafu (i-parabola) ayihlangani ne-x-axis. Uma sinwetshela izinombolo ezibizwa ngokuthi izinombolo ezingelona zangempela, izimpande ziyavela, kodwa uzokufunda lokho kamuva.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.1: Uma D<0, azikho izimpande zangempela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi igrafu ka-y=ax²+bx+c ayihlangani ne-x-axis. Esikoleni esiphakeme, uma izinombolo zinwetshwa, uhlobo olunye lwempande luyavela.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, bhala kabusha umugqa ofanayo 3 ngamagama aqondile encwadini yokubhala efundwa umngani weBanga 10. (Bhala kokubili inani nohlobo lwezimpande.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Emshweni womfowenu weBanga 9, "lokho ozokufunda okulandelayo" kwashiywa. Kulokhu, kubhale ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi zingaki izimpande ezingelona zangempela nokuthi izimpande ezimbili ezingelona zangempela zihlobana kanjani, usebenzisa izixazululo zika-x²+1=0 njengesethenjwa.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ukuthi zingaki izimpande ezingelona zangempela nokuthi zihlobana kanjani?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngokungafani nencazelo yeBanga 9, unwebe uhlelo lwezinombolo lwaba yizinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma D<0, azikho izimpande zangempela, futhi kunezimpande ezimbili ezihlukile ezingelona zangempela eziyizinhlanganisela zomunye komunye.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.1: Uma D<0, azikho izimpande zangempela, kodwa ezinombolweni eziyinkimbinkimbi kunezimpande ezi-2 ezingelona zangempela. Izimpande ezimbili ziyizinhlanganisela eziyinkimbinkimbi zomunye komunye.

n-m-h1-eq-07.title: Ukwenza amapheya e-exponent anu-i^p+i^q=0
n-m-h1-eq-07.topic: Izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi: amandla eyunithi engelona yangempela u-i nesimo sesamba esingu-0
n-m-h1-eq-07.goal: Sebenzisa iphethini ephindaphindayo emandleni ka-i ukwenza amapheya e-exponent anesamba esingu-0 wena, futhi ufingqe emagameni lokho amapheya ahlangana ngakho.
n-m-h1-eq-07.material: Iyunithi engelona yangempela u-i inelisa u-i²=−1. Ukuthatha amandla ka-i kunika u-i, i²=−1, i³, i⁴, …, futhi uma ubhala amanani ngokulandelana, amanani afanayo ayaphinda. Cabanga ngo-i^p+i^q ngezinombolo zemvelo u-p, q. (U-i^p usho u-i ngamandla ka-p.)
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.0: Thola iphethini lapho amandla aphinda khona
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.2: Jwayelanisa futhi uchaze lokho izibonelo ozenzile ezihlangana ngakho
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bala u-i¹, i², i³, i⁴, i⁵, i⁶ ngokulandelana futhi ubhale ukuthi amanani aqhubeka kanjani.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Thola i-exponent lapho amanani aphinda kuqala khona, futhi uthole okusele uma u-2025 uhlukaniswa ngaleyo nombolo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.b: U-i²=−1 yinani uma i-exponent ingu-2. Bheka ukuthi okusele kuyini uma u-2025 uhlukaniswa ngo-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.c: U-i³=−i uma okusele kwe-exponent ehlukaniswe ngo-4 kungu-3. Thola okusele uma u-2025 uhlukaniswa ngo-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.d: U-i⁴=1 uma i-exponent iyisiphindaphindi sika-4. Hlola okusele uma u-2025 uhlukaniswa ngo-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.explain: U-i, −1, −i, 1 baphinda ngamaqoqo angu-4. Okusele uma u-2025 uhlukaniswa ngo-4 ngu-1, ngakho i²⁰²⁵=i¹=i.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya amathathu ahlukile (p, q) ezinombolo zemvelo (1≤p, q≤40) ukuze i^p+i^q=0, futhi uwafake.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amanani ka-i¹ kuya ku-i⁸ futhi uthole amapheya amanani amabili anesamba esingu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Uma usuthole ipheya, hlola ukuthi ukwengeza u-4 ku-exponent kunika amanani afanayo yini, futhi ushintshe ama-exponent ukwenza amapheya amasha.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c1: U-p no-q kufanele babe yizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-40.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.ok.c2: U-i^p no-i^q bayiphambene, ngakho isamba singu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c2: U-i^p+i^q akangu-0. Bhala amanani amabili ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.explain: i¹+i³=i+(−i)=0, i²+i⁸=−1+1=0, i¹⁰+i⁴=−1+1=0. Uma okusele kwe-p−q kuhlukaniswe ngo-4 kungu-2, amanani amabili ayiphambene.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.prompt: Sho okusele uma u-p−q ehlukaniswa ngo-4 emapheya owenzile, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani u-i^p+i^q ungu-0 ngaleso sikhathi, ngokukhipha u-i^q njengesici.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Emapheya amathathu owenzile, thola u-p−q, bhala okusele ngakunye ekuhlukaniseni ngo-4, futhi uthole lokho abahlangana ngakho.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala u-i^p njengomphumela ka-i^q no-i^(p−q), futhi usebenze ukuthi u-i^(p−q) unani liphi.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Njengoba okusele kwe-p−q ehlukaniswe ngo-4 kungu-..., ...
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubale u-p−q ngqo emapheya amathathu owenzile?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi u-i^p ungabhalwa ngefomu u-i^q·i^(p−q)?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.0: Okusele kwe-p−q ehlukaniswe ngo-4 kungu-2. Ku-i^p+i^q=i^q(i^(p−q)+1), u-i^(p−q) ulingana no-i²=−1, ngakho ngaphakathi kwamabhrekhethi kungu-−1+1=0 futhi isamba singu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.1: Umehluko ka-p no-q uyasala u-2 uma uhlukaniswa ngo-4. Bese u-i^p ungu-i^q izikhathi u-i²=−1, ngakho unophawu oluphambene no-i^q, futhi ukwengeza kokubili kunika u-0.

n-m-h1-eq-09.title: Uma kungekho kubagqugquzeli bezimpande ezigcwele okuyimpande, ingabe akukho mpande yangempela nakho?
n-m-h1-eq-09.topic: Izibalo zebanga eliphezulu: ukuhlola abagqugquzeli bezimpande ezigcwele nokuba khona kwezimpande zangempela
n-m-h1-eq-09.goal: Hlukanisa lokho umphumela wokuhlola bonke abagqugquzeli bezimpande ezigcwele okusitshela khona nokungasitsheli khona, futhi ukhombise ukuthi impande yangempela ikhona usebenzisa ushintsho lophawu emanani omsebenzi.
n-m-h1-eq-09.material: UJiwon wazama ukuxazulula isibalo u-f(x)=0 ku-f(x)=x³−3x−1. Impande egcwele yesibalo esinama-coefficient aphelele ene-coefficient ehamba phambili u-1 ingenye yezihlukanisi zethemu elingaguquki u-−1. UJiwon wafaka abagqugquzeli u-1, −1 futhi wahlola ukuthi u-f(1)=−3 no-f(−1)=1 bobabili abayona u-0, futhi waphetha ngokuthi "lesi sibalo asinazo izimpande zangempela." UDaeun wathi, "Uma ucabanga ngegrafu yesibalo se-cubic, isiphetho sikaJiwon sibukeka singanqwabelana."
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.1: Thola isikhawu lapho uphawu lushintsha khona
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi kungani kukhona impande yangempela noma kungekho mpande egcwele
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.0: Umthetho wesici nabagqugquzeli bezimpande ezigcwele (izihlukanisi zethemu elingaguquki)
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.1: Ukubala amanani omsebenzi nesimo esiqhubekayo segrafu
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo esifanele kakhulu mayelana nokuhlola nesiphetho sikaJiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi umphumela wokuhlola abagqugquzeli bezimpande ezigcwele ukhuluma ngezinombolo zohlobo luni.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukuhlola kuqukethe isisekelo sokukhipha ithuba lokuthi inombolo ethile engeyona egcwele inelisa u-f(x)=0 yini.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile: uma kungekho kubagqugquzeli okuyimpande, akukho mpande yangempela nakho
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe izimpande ezigcwele nezimpande zangempela njengento efanayo. Cabanga ukuthi ezinye izinombolo zangempela ezingezona ezigcwele zingaba yizimpande zesibalo yini.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.b: Kuphosile: uma abagqugquzeli u-±1 bengezona izimpande, kusho ukuthi akukho mpande egcwele
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.c: f(1)=1−3−1=−3 no-f(−1)=−1+3−1=1, ngakho ukubala kulungile. Bheka ukuthi inkinga isesiphethweni, hhayi ekubaleni.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.d: Akwaziwa: umthetho wesici awukwazi ukusetshenziswa kusibalo se-cubic
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.d: Umthetho wesici ungasetshenziswa nasezinkulumweni ze-cubic. Inkinga yilokho ositshela khona uma umgqugquzeli engeyona impande.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.explain: Uma bonke abagqugquzeli behlolwe, singasho kuphela "akukho mpande egcwele." Kungase kube nempande yangempela engeyona egcwele, ngakho isiphetho esithi "azikho izimpande zangempela" asisekelwa ukuhlola.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.prompt: Ku-f(x)=x³−3x−1, thola futhi ufake amapheya amathathu ahlukile (m, n) ukuze f(m)<0, f(n)>0, futhi u-m no-n bayizinombolo ezigcwele ezihluka ngo-1 (−5≤m, n≤5).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bala u-f(m) ngokulandelana ku-m kusuka ku-−5 kuya ku-5, ubhale ethebuleni, futhi umake izimpawu kuphela.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ethebuleni, thola yonke indawo lapho iseli eliphozithivu lisondele eliphozithivu eliphoqayo...
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.ok.c1: U-m no-n bayizinombolo ezigcwele eziseduze ohleni.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c1: U-m no-n kufanele babe yizinombolo ezigcwele kusuka ku-−5 kuya ku-5 ezihluka ngo-1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c3: U-f(n) akahlali muhle. Bala u-f(n) ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.explain: f(−2)=−3, f(−1)=1, f(0)=−1, f(1)=−3, f(2)=1. Amapheya aseduze lapho uphawu lushintsha khona angu-(−2, −1), (0, −1), (1, 2).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani, kuma-(m, n) anamanani omsebenzi ka-f(m) no-f(n) anezimpawu eziphambene, kunempande yangempela ye-f(x)=0 phakathi kwawo, nokuthi kungani leyo mpande yangempela ihlukile kubantu abangase babe yimpande uJiwon abahlolile.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba igrafu bese ucabanga ukuthi, uma ingaphuki ngenkathi ihamba isuka ohlangothini olubi iya kolunhle, kumele inqamule i-x-axis yini.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi impande oyithole iphakathi kwezinombolo eziphelele ezimbili ziphi, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi leli nani lingalingana no-±1 yini.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale kokubili ukuthi uphawu lwenani lomsebenzi luyashintsha nokuthi igrafu ixhumene?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi impande yangempela oyithole iphakathi kwezinombolo eziphelele futhi ngakho akusona isiphakamiso ±1?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.0: Igrafu ka-y=f(x) ixhumene ngaphandle kokuphuka, ngakho uma f(m)<0 no-f(n)>0, inqamula i-x-axis phakathi kuka-m no-n. U-x kuleyo ndawo uyimpande. Leyo mpande iyinombolo ephakathi kuka-m no-n, ngakho ayiyona inombolo ephelele, futhi ihlukile kuzisiphakamiso 1, −1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.1: Njengoba igrafu ka-f iqhubeka, inani kumele libe ngu-0 phakathi kwebanga lapho lishintsha khona lisuka kokubi liye kokuhle. Le mpande iphakathi kwezinombolo eziphelele ezimbili eziseduze, ngakho ayiyona inombolo ephelele, futhi ngakho ayikwazi ukutholakala ngokuhlola izisiphakamiso zezimpande eziphelele.

n-m-h1-logic-06.title: Ukubhala umyalezo wokuchazela umfowethu noma udadewethu omncane ngokuthi "isimo esidingekayo" siyini
n-m-h1-logic-06.goal: Thola lapho isixazululo somngane sahlulekile ngokufunda isiqondiso sesimo esidingekayo ngokuphambene, bese ubhala umyalezo ochaza isiqondiso ngesibonelo sansuku zonke, ngaphandle kwezimpawu.
n-m-h1-logic-06.material: Umthetho wethala lezincwadi uthi "Ngaphandle kwekhadi lomfundi, awukwazi ukuboleka izincwadi." USubin usebenzise lo mthetho ukuze azi ukuthi "ukuba nekhadi lomfundi" kuyisimo esidingekayo se-"ukukwazi ukuboleka izincwadi" yini. p ithi "unekhadi lomfundi" futhi q ithi "ukwazi ukuboleka izincwadi."
n-m-h1-logic-06.thinking.0: Ukuthola lapho isiqondiso saphendulwa khona esixazululweni
n-m-h1-logic-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha ngaphandle kwezimpawu kumlaleli othile
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala emsebenzini kaSubin lapho kuhamba khona kabi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kabusha umugqa ngamunye ngesimo esithi "Uma □, bese □," usebenzisa izimpawu p no-q, bese uwuqhathanisa nomthetho.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chaza ngomusho ukuthi iyiphi isimo sesiphi lapho sithi "isimo esidingekayo."
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.0: Umthetho uthi 'Ngaphandle kwekhadi lomfundi, awukwazi ukuboleka izincwadi.'
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.1: Kulotshwe ngo-p no-q, lo mthetho uyi-~p→~q.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.3: Njengoba i-q→p iyiqiniso, p isimo esidingekayo se-q.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.4: Njengoba kuyisimo esidingekayo, uma unekhadi lomfundi, ungaboleka izincwadi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 5. "p isimo esidingekayo se-q" kusho i-q→p, okungukuthi, uma ukwazi ukuboleka izincwadi, bese unekhadi lomfundi. Isitatimende p→q, "uma unekhadi lomfundi, ungaboleka izincwadi," asilandeli emthethweni. Isibonelo, ungaba nekhadi lomfundi kodwa ungakwazi ukuboleka ngoba incwadi isidlulile isikhathi. Imigqa 1 kuya ku-4 yonke ilungile.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umyalezo ongasiza uSubin kakhulu. (Sebenzisa indlela yokulinganisa yokusiza uSubin alungise yedwa, hhayi ukumtshela impendulo nje.)
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kumyalezo ngamunye, bhala ngomugqa owodwa ukuthi uSubin wenzani ngokulandelayo ngemva kokuwuthola.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umyalezo uyakuvuma yini lokho uSubin akwenze kahle futhi unikeza indlela yokuhlola okusele.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.a: Umugqa 5 awulungile. Shintsha i-"isimo esidingekayo" ibe yi-"isimo esanele" bese ukwenza kabusha
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.a: Utshele uSubin ukuthi uwuphi umugqa onephutha, kodwa ucebise iphutha elisha, elithi "isimo esanele." Futhi awunikezi indlela yokuhlola uziphendulele wedwa.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.b: Konke kuze kube umugqa 4 kulungile. Cabanga ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini izimo lapho unekhadi lomfundi kodwa usabe ungakwazi ukuboleka incwadi, bese uwufunda kabusha umugqa 5
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.c: Izimo ezidingekayo ziyadida ngenxa yesiqondiso, ngakho kungcono manje ukuthi ufunde ngekhanda izimo ezanele kuphela
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.c: Ucebise ukugwema umqondo owudidayo. Awukhombisanga ukuthi kungakanani kwalesi sixazululo okwakulungile.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.d: Bala kabusha konke kusuka emugqeni 1 kuya kowesi-4 bese ubhala konke kabusha kusuka ekuqaleni
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.d: Ubeke umthwalo kuSubin wokwenza kabusha imigqa eyayivele ilungile. Futhi awushongo ukuthi ahlole kuphi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.explain: Impendulo enhle iyakuvuma okwakulungile futhi inikeza indlela yokuhlola okusele ngokwakho. Inketho b ibiza imigqa elungile futhi yenza uSubin afune isibonelo esiphikisayo. Inketho a ifundisa iphutha elisha, c yenza uSubin agweme umqondo, futhi d yenza uSubin enze kabusha ngisho nemigqa elungile.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela umfowenu noma udadewenu omncane, osebangeni lesi-7, imisho emibili noma emithathu echaza ukuthi "ukuba nekhadi lomfundi kuyisimo esidingekayo sokuboleka izincwadi" kusho ukuthini, usebenzisa esinye isibonelo sansuku zonke. Ungasebenzisi izimpawu (p, q, →).
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ucabange isimo esisodwa sansuku zonke lapho kukhona okungenakwenziwa ngaphandle kwakho, bese ukubhala phansi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Esimweni esifanayo, funa icala lapho ukuba nakho kungeneli, bese ukufaka emisho yakho.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Ukuboleka incwadi, kumele ube ne-..., kodwa ...
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlukanise phakathi kwe-"kumele ube nakho" ne-"ukuba nakho kuyanele"?
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise isibonelo esivela esimweni esaziwa ngumfowenu noma udadewenu (ipaki lemidlalo, isivivinyo, njll.)?
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uchaze isiqondiso ngamagama kuphela, ngaphandle kwezimpawu?
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma ungenaso isikhathi sokungena, awukwazi ukugibela imidlalo epakini lemidlalo. Ngakho ithikithi yilokho okumele ube nakho ukuze ugibele. Kodwa naphezu kokuba nethikithi, ungase ungakwazi ukugibela uma ungephakeme ngokwanele. Lokho kuyisimo esidingekayo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.model.1: Ukuze ubhale isivivinyo, kumele ube nekhadi lakho lokungena esivivinyweni. Ngaphandle kwalo, awukwazi ukubhala isivivinyo. Kodwa ukuba nekhadi akusho ukuthi uzokwenza kahle noma uphase. Okumele ube nakho kuyisimo esidingekayo.

n-m-h1-logic-05.title: Yini enye esidinga ukuyazi uma sazi kuphela "Uma imvula, kukhanselwa"?
n-m-h1-logic-05.goal: Uma "uma p, khona-ke q" iyiqiniso, cubungula ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukuphetha ngokuqinisekile ukuthi "uma q, khona-ke p," bese uchaza usebenzisa i-contrapositive ukuthi kungani lolo lwazi lwanele.
n-m-h1-logic-05.material: Umthetho wesikole uthi, "Uma imvula, isifundo sangaphandle siyakhanselwa," futhi lo mthetho ulandelwa ngaphandle kokuhlukile. U-Mina ufuna ukusho, njalo futhi ngaphandle kokuhlukile, isiphetho esithi "Uma isifundo sangaphandle sikhanselwe, kwakuyilanga lemvula." Emthethweni, p ithi "Imvula" futhi q ithi "Isifundo sangaphandle siyakhanselwa."
n-m-h1-logic-05.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho esivele sikwazi nezimpendulo ezintsha
n-m-h1-logic-05.thinking.1: Ukuqonda ukuthi i-converse ne-inverse ihlobene kanjani
n-m-h1-logic-05.prereq.1: I-contrapositive inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesitatimende sokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha iqiniso, ngaphandle komthetho, elidingekayo ukuqiniseka ngesiphetho sika-Mina njalo.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale isiphetho u-Mina afuna ukusisho ngefomu elithi "Uma □, khona-ke □," usebenzisa p no-q.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala kabusha ukukhetha ngakunye ngefomu elifanayo, bese unquma ukuthi sesivele silandela emthethweni noma yilwazi olusha.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.a: Ezinsukwini lapho kuba nesifundo sangaphandle, imvula ayana
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.a: Leli state i-contrapositive ye-"Uma kuna imvula, ikilasi liyakhanselwa." Selivele lilandela emthethweni, ngakho akuyona ulwazi olusha.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.b: Phakathi nenyanga edlule, usuku ngalunye olwakhanselwa belwuyilanga lemvula
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.b: Okubonwe ezikhathini ezimbalwa zokugcina akuqinisekisi ukuthi kuzohlala kunjalo esikhathini esizayo. Sidinga umthetho ohlala uyiqiniso njalo.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.c: Uma kungana mvula, ikilasi elingaphandle alikhanselwa
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.d: Azikho izinsuku zemvula ezingaphezu kweshumi enyangeni
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.d: Inani lezinsuku zemvula alinasixhumanisi na-"Uma likhanselwe, bese kunemvula."
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.explain: Isiphetho sikaMina siyi-q→p (i-converse). "Uma kungana mvula, ikilasi alikhanselwa" yi-~p→~q (i-inverse), futhi i-contrapositive yayo iyi-q→p ncamashi. Ngakho uma i-inverse ihlala iyiqiniso, i-converse nayo ihlala iyiqiniso. Inketho a iyi-contrapositive nje yomthetho wokuqala futhi ayinikezi lwazi olusha, kanti b no-d azimithetho ehlala iyiqiniso noma azinasixhumanisi.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa iqiniso olikhethile, chaza ngemisho emibili noma emithathu ukuthi kungani isiphetho sikaMina sihlala siyiqiniso. Sebenzisa igama elithi "contrapositive."
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Loba iqiniso olikhethile ngesimo esithi "Uma □, bese □," bese ushintshanisa isisusa nesiphetho futhi uphike zombili.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa umusho owenzile nesiphetho sikaMina ukuze ubone ukuthi bufana yini.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.placeholder: isb., I-contrapositive ye-"Uma kungana mvula, ikilasi alikhanselwa" yi-...
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ulobe iqiniso olikhethile ngesimo se-~p→~q, usebenzisa izimpawu p no-q?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Lapho wenza i-contrapositive, ingabe ushintshe i-"~" ezingxenyeni zombili?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uphinde wathi umthetho wokuqala wedwa awukwazi ukuqinisekisa leso siphetho?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.model.0: I-contrapositive ye-"Uma kungana mvula, ikilasi alikhanselwa" ithi "Uma likhanselwe, bese kunemvula." I-contrapositive ihlala inenani lweqiniso elifanayo nesitatimende sokuqala, ngakho isiphetho sikaMina sihlala siyiqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.model.1: Leli qiniso lisho ukuthi uma ~p, bese ~q, futhi i-contrapositive yalo ithi: uma q, bese p, okungukuthi, uma ikilasi likhanselwe, bekungulolu suku lwemvula. I-contrapositive inenani lweqiniso elifanayo nesitatimende sokuqala, ngakho isiphetho siyaqinisekiswa.

n-m-h1-logic-07.title: Ukuthola izinombolo ezimbili lapho ukuhlangana kwamasethi azo ezikhuphulelwa kunezinto eziyi-12
n-m-h1-logic-07.goal: Bala izinto zokuhlangana kwamasethi ezikhuphulelwa zezinombolo ezimbili ngokufakwa nokukhishwa, bese usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi izinto ezifanayo ziyizikhuphulelwa zesikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu ukuze uthole izinombolo ezimbili ezifeza isimo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.material: Phakathi kwezinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-60, vumela i-A ibe yisethi yezikhuphulelwa ze-a ne-B yisethi yezikhuphulelwa ze-b. Isibonelo, uma a=4, A={4, 8, 12, …, 60}.
n-m-h1-logic-07.thinking.0: Ukubhala kabusha inani lezinto zokuhlangana usebenzisa inani lezinto zesiphambuko
n-m-h1-logic-07.prereq.1: Izikhuphulelwa, izikhuphulelwa ezivamile, nesikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.prompt: Uma a=6 no-b=15, khetha isitatimende esichaza ngokuqondile izinto ze-A∩B.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezimbalwa wena, uqale ngencane kakhulu, eziyizikhuphulelwa zombili ze-6 no-15.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka izinombolo osuzitholile bese ubona ukuthi zakha izikhuphulelwa zayiphi inombolo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.a: Ziyizikhuphulelwa ze-90, ngakho azikho kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.a: Ithathe umphumela we-6×15 njengesisekelo sezikhuphulelwa ezivamile. Ayihlolanga ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini isikhuphulelo esivamile esincane.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.b: Lilingana nelincane phakathi kwenani lezikhuphulelwa ze-6 nenani lezikhuphulelwa ze-15
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.b: Ithathe elincane phakathi kobukhulu bamasethi amabili ezikhuphulelwa njengobukhulu besiphambuko. Ayizitholanga ngqo izinombolo ezigudlayo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.d: Isebenzise u-3, isihlukanisi esivamile se-6 no-15, njengesisekelo. Ukuba isikhuphulelo se-3 akwenzi inombolo ibe yisikhuphulelo se-6 no-15.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.explain: Izinombolo eziyizikhuphulelwa zombili ze-6 no-15 ziyizikhuphulelwa zesikhuphulelo sazo esivamile esincane kakhulu, u-30. Kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-60, zimbili: 30 no-60. Uma uzibala njengezikhuphulelwa ze-6×15=90, uthola ngephutha ukuthi azikho.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya amabili ahlukene ezinombolo zemvelo a, b lapho n(A∪B)=12. Izimiso: 2≤a<b≤20, a no-b abayona ama-coprime, futhi b akuyona isikhuphulelo se-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ku-a ngayinye, qala uthole n(A)=⌊60÷a⌋, bese uhlola ukuthi ukufaka ubukhulu bamasethi amabili bese ukhipha ukugudlana kunikeza u-12 yini.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ukugudlana usebenzisa isikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu. Khetha ama-(a, b) ambalwa angenzeka bese wenza ithebula lokubala ukuze uqhathanise.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Abayona ama-coprime, futhi b akuyona isikhuphulelo se-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Akumele babe ama-coprime, futhi b akumele ibe yisikhuphulelo se-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.explain: (6, 15): 10+4−2=12, (6, 16): 10+3−1=12, (6, 20): 10+3−1=12, (8, 10): 7+6−1=12. Kule ranji, la mapheya amane kuphela ayiwo. Uma ubala ukugudlana njengezikhuphulelwa ze-a×b, bese (6, 15) unikeza 10+4−0=14, okungalungile.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Ku-(a, b)=(6, 15), chaza ukuthi kungani akumele ubale izinto ezifanayo njengezikhuphulelwa ze-6×15=90.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala izikhuphulelwa ze-6 nezika-15 kuze kufike ku-60 bese uthola izinombolo ezabelanayo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi lezo zinombolo zincane noma zinkulu kunga-90.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.placeholder: isb., Izikhuphulelwa ezivamile ze-6 no-15 ziyi-..., ngakho ...
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uzitholele wena isikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu se-6 no-15?
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthe u-90 uyesinye nje sezikhuphulelwa ezivamile, hhayi esincane kakhulu?
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Isikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu se-6 no-15 yi-30. Ngakho no-30 no-60 bayizikhuphulelwa zombili futhi, futhi uma ubala izikhuphulelwa ze-90 kuphela, ukhohlwa lezi ezimbili bese uphutha.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Inombolo eyisikhuphulelo sombili se-6 no-15 iyisikhuphulelo sesikhuphulelo esivamile esincane kakhulu, u-30. U-90 uyesinye nje sazo, ngakho uma sisebenzisa yena kuphela, u-30 no-60 ababalwa njengezinto ezifanayo.

n-m-h1-logic-08.title: Siphetha kanjani ukuthi isitatimende esithi "kuwo wonke u-x" siyiqiniso noma asilona?
n-m-h1-logic-08.goal: Nquma ukuthi isitatimende esiqala ngo-"kuwo wonke u-x" siyiqiniso noma asilona usebenzisa isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo noma ukuphikisana okuphelele, hhayi amanani ambalwa; loba ukuphika kwaso kahle; futhi cabangela amanani omkhawulo.
n-m-h1-logic-08.material:
Isitatimende P: "Kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x, x²−4x+k>0." (k ingqikithi eqondile) Abangane abathathu banqume ukuthi P iyiqiniso noma asilona uma k=4, kanje.
- Jiho: Ngifake u-x=0, 1, 3, 5 futhi onke amanani abe makhulu kuno-0, ngakho kuyiqiniso.
- Seoyeon: x²−4x+4=(x−2)², futhi isikwele sisemkhulu noma silingana no-0, ngakho sihlala sikhulu kuno-0. Kuyiqiniso.
- Daeun: Uma ngifaka u-x=2, inani liyi-0, elingekho likhulu kuno-0. Akulona iqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-08.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa amanani ambalwa owahloliwe namanani wonke
n-m-h1-logic-08.thinking.2: Ukunquma ukuthi amanani omkhawulo afakiwe yini
n-m-h1-logic-08.prereq.1: Izisho zezikwele eziphelele nenani elincane le-quadratic
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.prompt: Uma k=4, khetha inani leqiniso elilungile le-P kanye nesizathu salo esilungile.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi ukucabanga komngane ngamunye "kuhlole amanani ambalwa" noma "kuhlanganisa wonke amanani."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.1: Thola inani elincane kakhulu lesisho esibhalwe nguSeoyeon, bese ulithelekisa ne-"likhulu kuno-0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.a: Iqiniso: ngoba lalikhona kuwo wonke amanani ambalwa engiwazamile
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.a: Ishintshe i-"zonke izinombolo zangempela" ngamanani ambalwa ahloliwe. Kusekhona amanani angahloliwe.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.b: Iqiniso: isikwele sihlala sisemkhulu noma silingana no-0, ngakho inani lesisho likhulu kuno-0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.b: Ishintshe i-"semkhulu noma silingana no-0" yaba yi-"likhulu kuno-0." Ikhohliwe icala lapho kulingana khona.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.c: Akulona iqiniso: kukhona inombolo yangempela lapho isisho silingana no-0, okophula i-"likhulu kuno-0 kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela"
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.d: Akwaziwa: kunezinombolo zangempela ezingenamkhawulo, ngakho akunakwenzeka ukuzihlola zonke
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.d: Icabange ukuthi ungaphetha kuphela ngokuhlola amanani ngamunye. Ungaphetha usebenzisa isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo noma ukwakheka kwesisho.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.explain: Isitatimende sesimo esithi "kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x" asilona iqiniso uma ngisho no-x oyedwa (isibonelo esiphikisayo) ehluleka. Uma k=4, isisho siyi-(x−2)², futhi ku-x=2 siyi-0, ngakho "likhulu kuno-0" alihlali; ngakho P asilona iqiniso. Indlela kaJiho ngamanani ambalwa ahloliwe nje, futhi uSeoyeon waxhumanise "semkhulu noma silingana no-0" ne-"likhulu kuno-0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi mangaki amanani ka-x adinga ukuhluleka ukuze "kuwo wonke …, …" kungabi yiqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukuphika kokungalingani okuthi ">" kuyini, nokuthi icala lokulingana no-0 liya ohlangothini luni.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.a: Kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x, x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.a: Ishiye i-"kuwo wonke" injengoba injalo, futhi ibhale ukuphika kwe-">" njenge-"<" kuphela. Zombili izingxenye azilungile.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.b: Kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x, x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.b: Ishiye i-"kuwo wonke" njengokuphika kwe-"kuwo wonke" futhi yashintsha uphawu lokungalingani kuphela ngemva kwalokho. Ikhohliwe ukuthi isitatimende asilona iqiniso ngokushesha lapho ngisho icala elilodwa lihluleka.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.c: Kukhona inombolo yangempela x enjengokuthi x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.c: Ibhale ukuphika kwe-">" njenge-"<" kuphela. Icala lapho inani liyi-0 alikho.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.d: Kukhona inombolo yangempela x enjengokuthi x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.explain: Ukuphika kwe-"kuwo wonke x, A" kuyi-"kukhona x onjengokuthi hhayi A." Ukuphika kwe->0" kuyi-"≤0" (okungenani u-0), ngakho ukuphika ukuthi: kukhona inombolo yangempela x enjengokuthi x²−4x+k≤0. Uma k=4, lokhu kuphika kuyiqiniso ku-x=2, okuvumelana nesinqumo sokuthi P asilona iqiniso.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala uhla lwamanani ka-k lapho P iyiqiniso khona, bese uchaza ngomusho owodwa ukuthi kungani k=4 ingekho kuleso sikhala.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala kabusha i-x²−4x+k ngesimo lapho (x−2)² ibonakala khona, bese uveza inani elincane ngo-k.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa nesimo esithi ">0" ukuze unqume ukuthi leli nani elincane kumele likhulu kuno-0 noma lisemkhulu nje noma lilingana no-0.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Uhla lwe-k lu-..., futhi uma k=4, bese x=...
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale kabusha isisho njenge-(x−2)²+k−4 bese uthola inani elincane?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe unqume uhla usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi inani elincane kumele likhulu kuno-0?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukhombise ngenani lika-x ukuthi kungani i-">" ihluleka ekuphelisweni komkhawulo?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.0: x²−4x+k=(x−2)²+k−4 futhi elincane liyi-k−4, ngakho kuhlala kukhulu kuno-0 uma k>4. Uma k=4, inani liyi-0 ku-x=2, ngakho alikhulu kuno-0 futhi k=4 ayifakiwe.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.1: I-discriminant 16−4k kumele ibe ngaphansi kuka-0, ngakho k kumele ibe likhulu kuno-4. Uma k=4, i-discriminant iyi-0, ngakho inani lesisho liyi-0 ku-x=2, futhi P asilona iqiniso.
